or.explanation: ମାଇକ୍ରୋଟିଚିଂ ଚକ୍ରର ପ୍ରାମାଣିକ କ୍ରମ ହେଉଛି: ଯୋଜନା (Plan) -> ଶିକ୍ଷାଦାନ (Teach) -> ପ୍ରତିପୋଷଣ (Feedback) -> ପୁନଃ-ଯୋଜନା (Re-plan) -> ପୁନଃ-ଶିକ୍ଷାଦାନ (Re-teach) -> ପୁନଃ-ପ୍ରତିପୋଷଣ (Re-feedback)।

questions.question: Which type of isomerism is exhibited by the pair of coordination complexes [Co(NH3)5(SO4)]Br and [Co(NH3)5Br]SO4?
questions.explanation: Ionisation isomerism occurs when a coordination compound yields different ions in solution despite having the same overall formula. Here, [Co(NH3)5(SO4)]Br releases Br- ions in aqueous solution, whereas [Co(NH3)5Br]SO4 releases SO4(2-) ions.

or.question: [Co(NH3)5(SO4)]Br ଏବଂ [Co(NH3)5Br]SO4 ସମନ୍ୱୟ ଯୌଗିକ ଯୁଗଳ ଦ୍ୱାରା କେଉଁ ପ୍ରକାରର ଆଇସୋମେରିଜମ୍ (ସମାବୟବତା) ଦର୍ଶାଯାଏ?
or.explanation: ଆୟନୀକରଣ ଆଇସୋମେରିଜମ୍ ସେତେବେଳେ ଘଟେ ଯେତେବେଳେ ଏକ ସମନ୍ୱୟ ଯୌଗିକ ଜଳୀୟ ଦ୍ରବଣରେ ଭିନ୍ନ ଭିନ୍ନ ଆୟନ ପ୍ରଦାନ କରେ। ଏଠାରେ, [Co(NH3)5(SO4)]Br ଦ୍ରବଣରେ Br- ଆୟନ ଦେଉଥିବା ବେଳେ [Co(NH3)5Br]SO4 ଦ୍ରବଣରେ SO4(2-) ଆୟନ ପ୍ରଦାନ କରେ।

questions.question: What is the correct thermodynamic relationship defining the chemical potential (μi) of component i in a mixture in terms of partial molar Gibbs free energy (Ḡi) at constant temperature (T) and pressure (P)?
questions.explanation: Chemical potential μi of component i is mathematically defined as the partial molar Gibbs free energy, Ḡi = (∂G / ∂ni)_{T, P, nj≠i}. Expressing μi in terms of U, H, or A requires different independent variables to be held constant (e.g., S and V for U; S and P for H; T and V for A).

or.question: ସ୍ଥିର ତାପମାତ୍ରା (T) ଏବଂ ଚାପ (P) ରେ ଏକ ମିଶ୍ରଣରେ ଥିବା ଉପାଦାନ i ର ରାସାୟନିକ ପୋଟେନ୍ସିଆଲ୍ (μi) ଏବଂ ଏହାର ଆଂଶିକ ମୋଲାର ଗିବ୍ସ ମୁକ୍ତ ଶକ୍ତି (Ḡi) ମଧ୍ୟରେ ସଠିକ୍ ତାପଗତିଜ ସମ୍ପର୍କ କ’ଣ?
or.explanation: ରାସାୟନିକ ପୋଟେନ୍ସିଆଲ୍ (μi) କୁ ସ୍ଥିର ତାପମାତ୍ରା (T) ଏବଂ ଚାପ (P) ରେ ଗିବ୍ସ ମୁକ୍ତ ଶକ୍ତିର ପରିବର୍ତ୍ତନ ହାର ଭାବରେ ସଂଜ୍ଞାୟିତ କରାଯାଏ, ଯାହା ଆଂଶିକ ମୋଲାର ଗିବ୍ସ ମୁକ୍ତ ଶକ୍ତି Ḡi = (∂G / ∂ni)_{T, P, nj≠i} ସହିତ ସମାନ।

questions.question: According to Jean Piaget's theory of cognitive development, a preoperational child's tendency to link two specific events that occur close together in time, reasoning from particular to particular rather than using logical induction or deduction, is known as:
questions.explanation: In Piagetian theory, transductive reasoning is characteristic of the preoperational stage (ages 2–7). Children connect two individual events causally simply because they happen close together, rather than reasoning from general to specific (deductive) or specific to general (inductive).

or.question: ଜିନ୍ ପିଆଜେଙ୍କ ଜ୍ଞାନାତ୍ମକ ବିକାଶ ସିଦ୍ଧାନ୍ତ ଅନୁସାରେ, ପ୍ରାକ୍-କାର୍ଯ୍ୟକାରୀ (Preoperational) ପର୍ଯ୍ୟାୟରେ ଥିବା ଜଣେ ଶିଶୁ କୌଣସି ଯୁକ୍ତିଯୁକ୍ତ ଆଗମନାତ୍ମକ କିମ୍ବା ନିଗମନାତ୍ମକ ତର୍କ ବ୍ୟବହାର ନକରି, ପାଖାପାଖି ଘଟୁଥିବା ଦୁଇଟି ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦିଷ୍ଟ ଘଟଣାକୁ ଯୋଡ଼ି ତର୍କ କରିବାର ପ୍ରବୃତ୍ତିକୁ କ’ଣ କୁହାଯାଏ?
or.explanation: ପିଆଜେଙ୍କ ସିଦ୍ଧାନ୍ତ ଅନୁଯାୟୀ, ପ୍ରାକ୍-କାର୍ଯ୍ୟକାରୀ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟାୟରେ (୨-୭ ବର୍ଷ) ଶିଶୁମାନେ 'ଟ୍ରାନ୍ସଡକ୍ଟିଭ୍ ରିଜନିଂ' ବ୍ୟବହାର କରନ୍ତି, ଯେଉଁଥିରେ ସେମାନେ ଦୁଇଟି ସ୍ୱତନ୍ତ୍ର ଘଟଣାକୁ କାରଣ-ପ୍ରଭାବ ଭାବରେ ଯୋଡ଼ିଥାନ୍ତି।

questions.question: According to David Elkind's theory of adolescent egocentrism, the cognitive belief wherein an adolescent falsely assumes that everyone around them is constantly watching, analyzing, and evaluating their appearance and actions is known as:
questions.explanation: David Elkind identified two components of adolescent egocentrism: the 'imaginary audience' (the belief that others are intensely focused on oneself) and the 'personal fable' (the belief in one's unique uniqueness and invulnerability).

or.question: ଡେଭିଡ୍ ଏଲକାଇଣ୍ଡଙ୍କ କିଶୋର ଅହଂକେନ୍ଦ୍ରିକତା (adolescent egocentrism) ସିଦ୍ଧାନ୍ତ ଅନୁସାରେ, ଯେଉଁ ଜ୍ଞାନାତ୍ମକ ଧାରଣା ଯୋଗୁଁ ଜଣେ କିଶୋର ଭୁଲ୍‌ଭାବେ ବିଶ୍ୱାସ କରେ ଯେ ତା’ ଚାରିପାଖରେ ଥିବା ସମସ୍ତ ଲୋକ ନିରନ୍ତର ତା’ର ରୂପ ଏବଂ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟକଳାପକୁ ଲକ୍ଷ୍ୟ କରୁଛନ୍ତି ଓ ମୂଲ୍ୟାଙ୍କନ କରୁଛନ୍ତି, ତାହାକୁ କ’ଣ କୁହାଯାଏ?
or.explanation: ଡେଭିଡ୍ ଏଲକାଇଣ୍ଡଙ୍କ ଅନୁଯାୟୀ, 'ଇମାଜିନାରୀ ଅଡିଏନ୍ସ' (Imaginary audience) ହେଉଛି କିଶୋରାବସ୍ଥାର ଏକ ମାନସିକ ସ୍ଥିତି, ଯେଉଁଥିରେ କିଶୋରମାନେ ମନେକରନ୍ତି ଯେ ସମସ୍ତଙ୍କ ଧ୍ୟାନ କେବଳ ସେମାନଙ୍କ ଉପରେ ହିଁ ନିବଦ୍ଧ ଅଛି।

questions.question: Which type of evaluation is primarily conducted during the ongoing instructional process to monitor student learning and provide continuous feedback?
questions.explanation: Formative evaluation takes place during the instructional process. Its main purpose is to monitor student learning and provide ongoing feedback that can be used by instructors to improve their teaching and by students to improve their learning.

or.question: ନିମ୍ନଲିଖିତ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ କେଉଁ ମୂଲ୍ୟାଙ୍କନ ପ୍ରକାରଟି ମୁଖ୍ୟତଃ ଶିକ୍ଷଣ ପ୍ରକ୍ରିୟା ଚାଲିଥିବା ସମୟରେ ଛାତ୍ରଛାତ୍ରୀଙ୍କ ଶିକ୍ଷଣକୁ ନିରୀକ୍ଷଣ କରିବା ଏବଂ କ୍ରମାଗତ ଫିଡବ୍ୟାକ୍ (ପ୍ରତିପୋଷଣ) ପ୍ରଦାନ କରିବା ପାଇଁ ପରିଚାଳିତ ହୋଇଥାଏ?
or.explanation: ଫର୍ମେଟିଭ୍ ମୂଲ୍ୟାଙ୍କନ ଶିକ୍ଷଣ-ଶିକ୍ଷାଦାନ ପ୍ରକ୍ରିୟା ଚାଲିଥିବା ସମୟରେ ଛାତ୍ରଛାତ୍ରୀଙ୍କ ଅଗ୍ରଗତି ନିରୀକ୍ଷଣ କରିବା ଏବଂ ଶିକ୍ଷକ ଓ ଛାତ୍ରଛାତ୍ରୀ ଉଭୟଙ୍କୁ ନିରନ୍ତର ପ୍ରତିପୋଷଣ ଯୋଗାଇବା ପାଇଁ କରାଯାଏ।

questions.question: According to Robert Gagné's Nine Events of Instruction, which event immediately follows 'Presenting the Content/Stimulus' in the standard pedagogical sequence?
questions.explanation: In Gagné's Nine Events of Instruction, the sequence is: 1. Gain attention, 2. Inform learners of objectives, 3. Stimulate recall of prior learning, 4. Present the content, 5. Provide learning guidance, 6. Elicit performance, 7. Provide feedback, 8. Assess performance, 9. Enhance retention and transfer. Therefore, 'Providing learning guidance' immediately follows 'Presenting the Content'.

or.question: ରାବର୍ଟ ଗାଗ୍ନେ (Robert Gagné) ଙ୍କ ନଅଟି ଶିକ୍ଷାଦାନ ସୋପାନ (Nine Events of Instruction) ଅନୁଯାୟୀ, ମାନକ ଶିକ୍ଷାଦାନ କ୍ରମରେ 'ବିଷୟବସ୍ତୁ/ଉଦ୍ଦୀପକ ପ୍ରସ୍ତୁତି (Presenting the Content)' ର ତୁରନ୍ତ ପରେ କେଉଁ ସୋପାନଟି ଆସିଥାଏ?
options: ଶିକ୍ଷଣ ମାର୍ଗଦର୍ଶନ ପ୍ରଦାନ କରିବା (Providing learning guidance)
ପୂର୍ବ ଜ୍ଞାନର ସ୍ମରଣକୁ ଉଦ୍ଦୀପିତ କରିବା (Stimulating recall of prior learning)
or.explanation: ରାବର୍ଟ ଗାଗ୍ନେଙ୍କ ନଅଟି ଶିକ୍ଷାଦାନ ସୋପାନ ଅନୁସାରେ, 'ବିଷୟବସ୍ତୁ ପ୍ରସ୍ତୁତି' (୪ର୍ଥ ସୋପାନ) ର ତୁରନ୍ତ ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ ୫ମ ସୋପାନ ହେଉଛି 'ଶିକ୍ଷଣ ମାର୍ଗଦର୍ଶନ ପ୍ରଦାନ କରିବା' (Providing learning guidance)।

questions.question: Which of the following aromatic compounds undergoes electrophilic aromatic substitution at the fastest rate?
questions.explanation: Anisole contains a methoxy group (-OCH3), which acts as a strong electron-donating group through resonance (+M effect). This significantly increases electron density on the benzene ring, making it react much faster than toluene (+I and hyperconjugation), chlorobenzene (deactivating overall due to -I), and nitrobenzene (strongly deactivating -M and -I).

or.question: ନିମ୍ନଲିଖିତ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ କେଉଁ ଆରୋମାଟିକ୍ ଯୌଗିକଟି ସବୁଠାରୁ ଦ୍ରୁତ ହାରରେ ଇଲେକ୍ଟ୍ରୋଫିଲିକ୍ ଆରୋମାଟିକ୍ ପ୍ରତିସ୍ଥାପନ ପ୍ରତିକ୍ରିୟା କରେ?
or.explanation: ଆନିସୋଲରେ ମେଥୋକ୍ସି ଗ୍ରୁପ୍ (-OCH3) ଥାଏ, ଯାହା ରେଜୋନାନ୍ସ (+M ପ୍ରଭାବ) ମାଧ୍ୟମରେ ଏକ ଶକ୍ତିଶାଳୀ ଇଲେକ୍ଟ୍ରନ୍-ଦାତା ଗ୍ରୁପ୍ ଭାବରେ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟ କରେ। ଏହା ବେଞ୍ଜିନ୍ ରିଂରେ ଇଲେକ୍ଟ୍ରନ୍ ଘନତା ବୃଦ୍ଧି କରେ, ଯାହା ଟୋଲୁଇନ୍, କ୍ଲୋରୋବେଞ୍ଜିନ୍ ଏବଂ ନାଇଟ୍ରୋବେଞ୍ଜିନ୍ ତୁଳନାରେ ଏହାକୁ ଅଧିକ ଦ୍ରୁତ ପ୍ରତିକ୍ରିୟାଶୀଳ କରାଏ।

questions.question: For a second-order reaction with rate law rate = k[A]^2, what is the expression for the time required (t_3/4) for the concentration of reactant A to decrease to one-fourth of its initial concentration [A]_0?
questions.explanation: The integrated rate law for a second-order reaction is 1/[A]_t - 1/[A]_0 = kt. When the concentration decreases to one-fourth of the initial value, [A]_t = [A]_0 / 4. Substituting this into the equation gives: 1/([A]_0 / 4) - 1/[A]_0 = k * t_3/4 => 4/[A]_0 - 1/[A]_0 = 3/[A]_0 = k * t_3/4. Solving for t_3/4 yields t_3/4 = 3 / (k[A]_0).

or.question: ହାର ନିୟମ rate = k[A]^2 ବିଶିଷ୍ଟ ଏକ ଦ୍ଵିତୀୟ-କ୍ରମ ପ୍ରତିକ୍ରିୟା ପାଇଁ, ପ୍ରତିକାରକ A ର ଗାଢ଼ତା ଏହାର ପ୍ରାରମ୍ଭିକ ଗାଢ଼ତା [A]_0 ର ଏକ-ଚତୁର୍ଥାଂଶକୁ ହ୍ରାସ ପାଇବା ପାଇଁ ଆବଶ୍ୟକ ସମୟ (t_3/4) ର ସୂତ୍ର କେଉଁଟି?
or.explanation: ଏକ ଦ୍ଵିତୀୟ-କ୍ରମ ପ୍ରତିକ୍ରିୟା ପାଇଁ ସମାକଳିତ ହାର ନିୟମ ହେଉଛି 1/[A]_t - 1/[A]_0 = kt। ଯେତେବେଳେ ଗାଢ଼ତା ପ୍ରାରମ୍ଭିକ ମୂଲ୍ୟର ଏକ-ଚତୁର୍ଥାଂଶକୁ ହ୍ରାସ ପାଏ, [A]_t = [A]_0 / 4। ଏହି ମୂଲ୍ୟକୁ ସମୀକରଣରେ ସ୍ଥାପନ କଲେ: 1/([A]_0 / 4) - 1/[A]_0 = k * t_3/4 => 4/[A]_0 - 1/[A]_0 = 3/[A]_0 = k * t_3/4। ତେଣୁ t_3/4 = 3 / (k[A]_0)।

questions.question: In Urie Bronfenbrenner's Ecological Systems Theory, which system refers to the linkages and processes taking place between two or more settings containing the developing person (such as the relationship between a child's home and school)?
questions.explanation: The mesosystem comprises the interrelations among two or more settings in which the developing person actively participates, such as the interactions between a child's family and school, or family and peer group.

or.question: ୟୁରି ବ୍ରୋନଫେନ୍‌ବ୍ରେନରଙ୍କ ପାରିପାର୍ଶ୍ୱିକ ବ୍ୟବସ୍ଥା ସିଦ୍ଧାନ୍ତ (Ecological Systems Theory) ଅନୁଯାୟୀ, କେଉଁ ପ୍ରଣାଳୀ ବିକାଶଶୀଳ ବ୍ୟକ୍ତି ଥିବା ଦୁଇ କିମ୍ବା ଅଧିକ ପରିବେଶ ମଧ୍ୟରେ ଘଟୁଥିବା ସଂଯୋଗ ଏବଂ ପ୍ରକ୍ରିୟାକୁ ଦର୍ଶାଏ (ଯେପରିକି ଶିଶୁର ଘର ଏବଂ ବିଦ୍ୟାଳୟ ମଧ୍ୟରେ ଥିବା ସମ୍ପର୍କ)?
or.explanation: ମେସୋସିଷ୍ଟମ୍‌ରେ (Mesosystem) ଦୁଇ କିମ୍ବା ଅଧିକ ପରିବେଶ (ସେଟିଂ) ମଧ୍ୟରେ ସମ୍ପର୍କ ଅନ୍ତର୍ଭୁକ୍ତ, ଯେଉଁଥିରେ ବିକାଶଶୀଳ ଶିଶୁ ସକ୍ରିୟ ଭାବରେ ଅଂଶଗ୍ରହଣ କରେ, ଯେପରିକି ଘର ଏବଂ ବିଦ୍ୟାଳୟ ମଧ୍ୟରେ ସମ୍ପର୍କ।

questions.question: According to John Flavell, metacognitive knowledge consists of three primary categories of awareness. Which of the following correctly identifies these three categories?
options: Person variables, task variables, and strategy variables
Declarative variables, procedural variables, and conditional variables
Planning variables, monitoring variables, and evaluating variables
Assimilation variables, accommodation variables, and equilibration variables
questions.explanation: John Flavell (1979) categorized metacognitive knowledge into three categories: person variables (knowledge about oneself and others as cognitive processors), task variables (knowledge about the nature and demands of the task), and strategy variables (knowledge about strategies to achieve cognitive goals).

or.question: ଜନ୍ ଫ୍ଲାଭେଲ୍‌ଙ୍କ (John Flavell) ଅନୁଯାୟୀ, ମେଟାକୋଗ୍ନିଟିଭ୍ ଜ୍ଞାନ (ସଂଜ୍ଞାନାତ୍ମକ ସଚେତନତା) ତିନୋଟି ମୁଖ୍ୟ ବର୍ଗକୁ ନେଇ ଗଠିତ। ନିମ୍ନଲିଖିତ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ କେଉଁଟି ଏହି ତିନୋଟି ବର୍ଗକୁ ସଠିକ୍ ଭାବରେ ଚିହ୍ନଟ କରେ?
options: ବ୍ୟକ୍ତି ଚଳ (Person variables), କାର୍ଯ୍ୟ ଚଳ (Task variables), ଏବଂ କୌଶଳ ଚଳ (Strategy variables)
ଘୋଷଣାତ୍ମକ ଚଳ (Declarative variables), ପ୍ରକ୍ରିୟାତ୍ମକ ଚଳ (Procedural variables), ଏବଂ ସର୍ତ୍ତମୂଳକ ଚଳ (Conditional variables)
ଯୋଜନା ଚଳ (Planning variables), ନିରୀକ୍ଷଣ ଚଳ (Monitoring variables), ଏବଂ ମୂଲ୍ୟାଙ୍କନ ଚଳ (Evaluating variables)
ଆତ୍ମସାତକରଣ ଚଳ (Assimilation variables), ସମାୟୋଜନ ଚଳ (Accommodation variables), ଏବଂ ସନ୍ତୁଳନ ଚଳ (Equilibration variables)
or.explanation: ଜନ୍ ଫ୍ଲାଭେଲ୍ (୧୯୭୯) ମେଟାକୋଗ୍ନିଟିଭ୍ ଜ୍ଞାନକୁ ତିନୋଟି ବର୍ଗରେ ବିଭକ୍ତ କରିଥିଲେ: ବ୍ୟକ୍ତି ଚଳ (ବ୍ୟକ୍ତିଙ୍କ ନିଜର ଓ ଅନ୍ୟମାନଙ୍କ ଜ୍ଞାନ ବିଷୟରେ), କାର୍ଯ୍ୟ ଚଳ (କାର୍ଯ୍ୟର ଜଟିଳତା ଓ ପ୍ରକୃତି ବିଷୟରେ), ଏବଂ କୌଶଳ ଚଳ (କାର୍ଯ୍ୟ ସମ୍ପାଦନ ପାଇଁ ବ୍ୟବହୃତ ହେଉଥିବା କୌଶଳ ବିଷୟରେ)।

questions.question: Which Article of the Constitution of India provides for the abolition or creation of Legislative Councils in States?
questions.explanation: Article 169 of the Constitution of India deals with the abolition or creation of Legislative Councils in States. Parliament can create or abolish a Legislative Council if the Legislative Assembly of the concerned State passes a resolution to that effect by a special majority.

or.question: ଭାରତୀୟ ସମ୍ବିଧାନର କେଉଁ ଧାରାରେ ରାଜ୍ୟଗୁଡ଼ିକରେ ବିଧାନ ପରିଷଦର ଉଚ୍ଛେଦ କିମ୍ବା ସୃଷ୍ଟି ପାଇଁ ବ୍ୟବସ୍ଥା ରହିଛି?
or.explanation: ଭାରତୀୟ ସମ୍ବିଧାନର ଧାରା ୧୬୯ ରାଜ୍ୟଗୁଡ଼ିକରେ ବିଧାନ ପରିଷଦର ଉଚ୍ଛେଦ କିମ୍ବା ସୃଷ୍ଟି ସହିତ ସମ୍ବନ୍ଧିତ। ଯଦି ସମ୍ପୃକ୍ତ ରାଜ୍ୟର ବିଧାନସଭା ଏକ ସ୍ୱତନ୍ତ୍ର ବହୁମତ ଦ୍ୱାରା ପ୍ରସ୍ତାବ ପାରିତ କରେ, ତେବେ ସଂସଦ ବିଧାନ ପରିଷଦ ସୃଷ୍ଟି କିମ୍ବା ଉଚ୍ଛେଦ କରିପାରିବ।

questions.question: Who among the following presided over the historic 1907 Surat Session of the Indian National Congress, where the party split into Moderates and Extremists?
questions.explanation: Dr. Rash Behari Ghosh presided over the 1907 Surat Session of the Indian National Congress. This session witnessed the famous 'Surat Split' between the Moderates and the Extremists.

or.question: ୧୯୦୭ ର ଐତିହାସିକ ସୁରଟ ଅଧିବେଶନରେ ଭାରତୀୟ ଜାତୀୟ କଂଗ୍ରେସର ଅଧ୍ୟକ୍ଷତା କିଏ କରିଥିଲେ, ଯେଉଁଥିରେ ଦଳ ନରମପନ୍ଥୀ ଏବଂ ଗରମପନ୍ଥୀରେ ବିଭାଜିତ ହୋଇଥିଲା?
or.explanation: ଡକ୍ଟର ରାସ ବିହାରୀ ଘୋଷ ଭାରତୀୟ ଜାତୀୟ କଂଗ୍ରେସର ୧୯୦୭ ସୁରଟ ଅଧିବେଶନର ଅଧ୍ୟକ୍ଷତା କରିଥିଲେ। ଏହି ଅଧିବେଶନରେ ନରମପନ୍ଥୀ ଏବଂ ଗରମପନ୍ଥୀଙ୍କ ମଧ୍ୟରେ ପ୍ରସିଦ୍ଧ 'ସୁରଟ ବିଭାଜନ' ହୋଇଥିଲା।

questions.question: In B.F. Skinner's theory of operant conditioning, which schedule of reinforcement produces the highest rate of response and the greatest resistance to extinction?
questions.explanation: A variable-ratio schedule provides reinforcement after an unpredictable number of responses. This schedule yields a very high, steady rate of responding and is extremely resistant to extinction.

or.question: ବି.ଏଫ୍. ସ୍କିନର୍‌ଙ୍କ (B.F. Skinner) ଅପରେଣ୍ଟ କଣ୍ଡିସନିଂ ତତ୍ତ୍ୱରେ, କେଉଁ ପୁନର୍ବଳନ ସୂଚୀ (schedule of reinforcement) ସବୁଠାରୁ ଅଧିକ ପ୍ରତିକ୍ରିୟା ହାର ଏବଂ ବିଲୋପନ ପ୍ରତି ସବୁଠାରୁ ଅଧିକ ପ୍ରତିରୋଧ ସୃଷ୍ଟି କରେ?
or.explanation: ପରିବର୍ତ୍ତନଶୀଳ-ଅନୁପାତ ସୂଚୀରେ (Variable-ratio schedule) ଅନିଶ୍ଚିତ ସଂଖ୍ୟକ ପ୍ରତିକ୍ରିୟା ପରେ ପୁନର୍ବଳନ ଦିଆଯାଏ, ଯାହା ଅତି ଉଚ୍ଚ ପ୍ରତିକ୍ରିୟା ହାର ଏବଂ ବିଲୋପନ ପ୍ରତି ସର୍ବାଧିକ ପ୍ରତିରୋଧ ସୃଷ୍ଟି କରେ।

questions.question: In the revised Bloom's Taxonomy proposed by Lorin Anderson and David Krathwohl (2001), which of the following correctly represents the ascending order of cognitive process complexity?
options: Remember, Understand, Apply, Analyze, Evaluate, Create
Remember, Understand, Apply, Evaluate, Analyze, Create
Knowledge, Comprehension, Application, Analysis, Synthesis, Evaluation
Remember, Apply, Understand, Analyze, Create, Evaluate
questions.explanation: The revised Bloom's Taxonomy (2001) changes the categories from nouns to verbs and arranges them in ascending order of complexity as: Remember -> Understand -> Apply -> Analyze -> Evaluate -> Create.

or.question: ଲୋରିନ୍ ଆଣ୍ଡରସନ୍ ଏବଂ ଡେଭିଡ୍ କ୍ରାଥୱୋଲ୍ (୨୦୦୧) ଙ୍କ ଦ୍ୱାରା ପ୍ରସ୍ତାବିତ ସଂଶୋଧିତ ବ୍ଲୁମ୍‌ଙ୍କ ଟ୍ୟାକ୍ସୋନୋମି (Bloom's Taxonomy) ରେ, ନିମ୍ନଲିଖିତ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ କେଉଁଟି ଜ୍ଞାନାତ୍ମକ ପ୍ରକ୍ରିୟା ଜଟିଳତାର ସଠିକ୍ ଆରୋହୀ କ୍ରମ (ascending order) ଦର୍ଶାଏ?
options: ମନେରଖିବା (Remember), ବୁଝିବା (Understand), ପ୍ରୟୋଗ କରିବା (Apply), ବିଶ୍ଳେଷଣ କରିବା (Analyze), ମୂଲ୍ୟାଙ୍କନ କରିବା (Evaluate), ସୃଷ୍ଟି କରିବା (Create)
ମନେରଖିବା (Remember), ବୁଝିବା (Understand), ପ୍ରୟୋଗ କରିବା (Apply), ମୂଲ୍ୟାଙ୍କନ କରିବା (Evaluate), ବିଶ୍ଳେଷଣ କରିବା (Analyze), ସୃଷ୍ଟି କରିବା (Create)
ଜ୍ଞାନ (Knowledge), ବୋଧଗମ୍ୟତା (Comprehension), ପ୍ରୟୋଗ (Application), ବିଶ୍ଳେଷଣ (Analysis), ସଂଶ୍ଳେଷଣ (Synthesis), ମୂଲ୍ୟାଙ୍କନ (Evaluation)
ମନେରଖିବା (Remember), ପ୍ରୟୋଗ କରିବା (Apply), ବୁଝିବା (Understand), ବିଶ୍ଳେଷଣ କରିବା (Analyze), ସୃଷ୍ଟି କରିବା (Create), ମୂଲ୍ୟାଙ୍କନ କରିବା (Evaluate)
or.explanation: ୨୦୦୧ ରେ ପ୍ରସ୍ତାବିତ ସଂଶୋଧିତ ବ୍ଲୁମ୍‌ଙ୍କ ଟ୍ୟାକ୍ସୋନୋମିରେ ବର୍ଗଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ବିଶେଷ୍ୟ ପରିବର୍ତ୍ତେ କ୍ରିୟାପଦରେ ରଖାଯାଇଛି ଏବଂ ଜଟିଳତାର ଆରୋହୀ କ୍ରମ ହେଉଛି: ମନେରଖିବା -> ବୁଝିବା -> ପ୍ରୟୋଗ କରିବା -> ବିଶ୍ଳେଷଣ କରିବା -> ମୂଲ୍ୟାଙ୍କନ କରିବା -> ସୃଷ୍ଟି କରିବା।

questions.question: Which of the following ligands is classified as a bidentate ligand?
questions.explanation: Ethylenediamine (en) contains two nitrogen donor atoms, each having a lone pair of electrons capable of coordinating to a central metal ion, making it a bidentate ligand. Ammonia, pyridine, and water each possess only one donor atom and are monodentate ligands.

or.question: ନିମ୍ନଲିଖିତ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ କେଉଁ ଲିଗାଣ୍ଡଟି ଏକ ଦ୍ୱି-ଦନ୍ତୁର (bidentate) ଲିଗାଣ୍ଡ ଭାବରେ ବର୍ଗୀକୃତ?
or.explanation: ଏଥିଲିନ୍‌ଡାଏଆମିନ୍ (en) ରେ ଦୁଇଟି ନାଇଟ୍ରୋଜେନ୍ ଦାତା ପରମାଣୁ ଥାଏ, ଯାହା ଏହାକୁ ଏକ ଦ୍ୱି-ଦନ୍ତୁର (bidentate) ଲିଗାଣ୍ଡ କରିଥାଏ। ଆମୋନିଆ, ପାଇରିଡିନ୍ ଏବଂ ଜଳ ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ଗୋଟିଏ ଲେଖାଏଁ ଦାତା ପରମାଣୁ ଧାରଣ କରିଥିବାରୁ ଏକ-ଦନ୍ତୁର (monodentate) ଲିଗାଣ୍ଡ ଅଟନ୍ତି।

questions.question: In the base-catalyzed Claisen-Schmidt condensation between benzaldehyde and acetophenone, what is the major organic product formed after dehydration?
questions.explanation: The Claisen-Schmidt reaction between benzaldehyde (which lacks alpha-hydrogens) and acetophenone in the presence of a strong base forms a beta-hydroxy ketone intermediate, which readily undergoes dehydration to give the alpha,beta-unsaturated ketone 1,3-diphenylprop-2-en-1-one, commonly known as chalcone.

or.question: କ୍ଷାର-ଉତ୍ପ୍ରେରିତ କ୍ଲାଇସେନ୍-ସ୍ମିଟ୍ (Claisen-Schmidt) ସଂଘନନରେ ବେଞ୍ଜାଲଡିହାଇଡ୍ ଏବଂ ଏସିଟୋଫେନୋନ୍ ମଧ୍ୟରେ ନିର୍ଜଳୀକରଣ ପରେ ଗଠିତ ହେଉଥିବା ପ୍ରଧାନ ଜୈବ ଉତ୍ପାଦ କ'ଣ?
or.explanation: କ୍ଷାରର ଉପସ୍ଥିତିରେ ବେଞ୍ଜାଲଡିହାଇଡ୍ (ଯାହାର ଆଲଫା-ହାଇଡ୍ରୋଜେନ୍ ନାହିଁ) ଏବଂ ଏସିଟୋଫେନୋନ୍ ମଧ୍ୟରେ କ୍ଲାଇସେନ୍-ସ୍ମିଟ୍ ପ୍ରତିକ୍ରିୟା ଘଟି ଏକ ବିଟା-ହାଇଡ୍ରୋକ୍ସି କିଟୋନ୍ ମଧ୍ୟବର୍ତ୍ତୀ ଯୌଗିକ ଗଠିତ ହୁଏ, ଯାହା ନିର୍ଜଳୀକରଣ ହୋଇ ଆଲଫା,ବିଟା-ଅସଂପୃକ୍ତ କିଟୋନ୍ 1,3-ଡାଇଫେନିଲପ୍ରୋପ୍-2-ଏନ୍-1-ଓନ୍ (ଚାଲକୋନ୍) ପ୍ରଦାନ କରେ।

questions.question: In Lawrence Kohlberg's theory of moral development, an individual who makes moral decisions primarily to gain social approval and maintain harmonious relationships with peers is operating at which stage?
options: Stage 3: Interpersonal Concordance Orientation ('Good Boy / Nice Girl')
questions.explanation: Stage 3 of Kohlberg's moral development theory belongs to the Conventional Level. At this stage, morality is driven by social expectations, desire for approval, and maintaining good interpersonal relationships.

or.question: ଲରେନ୍ସ କୋହଲବର୍ଗଙ୍କ ନୈତିକ ବିକାଶ ସିଦ୍ଧାନ୍ତ ଅନୁଯାୟୀ, ଅନ୍ୟମାନଙ୍କଠାରୁ ସାମାଜିକ ଅନୁମୋଦନ ପାଇବା ଏବଂ ସାଥୀମାନଙ୍କ ସହିତ ସୌହାର୍ଦ୍ଦ୍ୟପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ସମ୍ପର୍କ ବଜାୟ ରଖିବା ପାଇଁ ନୈତିକ ନିଷ୍ପତ୍ତି ନେଉଥିବା ବ୍ୟକ୍ତି କେଉଁ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟାୟରେ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟ କରନ୍ତି?
options: ପର୍ଯ୍ୟାୟ ୩: ଆନ୍ତଃବ୍ୟକ୍ତିକ ସମ୍ମତି ମନୋଭାବ ('ଭଲ ବାଳକ / ଭଲ ବାଳିକା')
or.explanation: କୋହଲବର୍ଗଙ୍କ ନୈତିକ ବିକାଶ ସିଦ୍ଧାନ୍ତର ପର୍ଯ୍ୟାୟ ୩ ପାରମ୍ପରିକ ସ୍ତରର ଅନ୍ତର୍ଭୁକ୍ତ। ଏହି ପର୍ଯ୍ୟାୟରେ ନୈତିକତା ସାମାଜିକ ପ୍ରତ୍ୟାଶା, ଅନୁମୋଦନ ପାଇବାର ଇଚ୍ଛା ଏବଂ ଭଲ ଆନ୍ତଃବ୍ୟକ୍ତିକ ସମ୍ପର୍କ ରଖିବା ଦ୍ୱାରା ପରିଚାଳିତ ହୋଇଥାଏ।

questions.question: René Baillargeon used the 'violation-of-expectation' paradigm to challenge Jean Piaget's timeline regarding infant cognitive development. Which cognitive capacity did her findings demonstrate that infants possess significantly earlier than Piaget proposed?
questions.explanation: René Baillargeon's violation-of-expectation research demonstrated that infants as young as 3.5 to 4.5 months show awareness of hidden objects (object permanence), challenging Piaget's claim that object permanence only fully develops around 8 to 12 months.

or.question: ଶିଶୁର ଜ୍ଞାନାତ୍ମକ ବିକାଶ ସମ୍ପର୍କରେ ଜିନ୍ ପିଆଜେଙ୍କ ସମୟସୀମାକୁ ଚ୍ୟାଲେଞ୍ଜ କରିବା ପାଇଁ ରେନେ ବାଏଆର୍ଜନ୍ 'ପ୍ରତ୍ୟାଶା-ଉଲ୍ଲଂଘନ' (violation-of-expectation) ପଦ୍ଧତିର ବ୍ୟବହାର କରିଥିଲେ। ତାଙ୍କ ଗବେଷଣା ଅନୁଯାୟୀ ଶିଶୁମାନଙ୍କଠାରେ ପିଆଜେଙ୍କ ଆକଳନଠାରୁ ବହୁ ପୂର୍ବରୁ କେଉଁ ଜ୍ଞାନାତ୍ମକ ଦକ୍ଷତା ବିକଶିତ ହୋଇଥାଏ?
or.explanation: ରେନେ ବାଏଆର୍ଜନ୍ 'ପ୍ରତ୍ୟାଶା-ଉଲ୍ଲଂଘନ' ପଦ୍ଧତି ବ୍ୟବହାର କରି ଦର୍ଶାଇଥିଲେ ଯେ ୩.୫ ରୁ ୪.୫ ମାସର ଶିଶୁମାନଙ୍କଠାରେ ମଧ୍ୟ 'ବସ୍ତୁ ସ୍ଥାୟିତ୍ୱ' (object permanence) ର ସଚେତନତା ଥାଏ, ଯାହା ପିଆଜେଙ୍କ ଆକଳିତ ସମୟ (୮ ରୁ ୧୨ ମାସ) ଠାରୁ ଯଥେଷ୍ଟ ପୂର୍ବରୁ ଅଟେ।

questions.question: What is the primary foundation and core medium of instruction in Mahatma Gandhi's Wardha Scheme of Basic Education (Nai Talim) proposed in 1937?
options: Rote learning of classical Sanskrit texts
Purely academic instruction in English medium
questions.explanation: Mahatma Gandhi's Nai Talim (Basic Education) proposed that education should center around a productive craft (like spinning, weaving, agriculture) and be imparted in the student's mother tongue.

questions.question: Rabindranath Tagore established 'Sriniketan' in 1922 primarily to focus on which critical aspect of his educational philosophy?
options: Rural reconstruction, community welfare, and vocational crafts
Vedic scriptural research and monastic living
Advanced theoretical physics and modern mathematics
Western classical music and performing arts
questions.explanation: Sriniketan (Institute of Rural Reconstruction) was founded by Tagore alongside Leonard Elmhirst to bring education closer to village life through rural welfare, agriculture, and handicrafts.

questions.question: In John Dewey's pragmatic philosophy of education, how is learning fundamentally defined?
options: Passive absorption of facts transmitted by the teacher
Reconstruction of experience through active social participation ('Learning by Doing')
Rote memorization of timeless classical literature
Isolated sensory exercises detached from real-world utility
questions.explanation: John Dewey advocated pragmatism and progressivism, defining education as the continuous reconstruction of experience through action, problem-solving, and social interaction.

questions.question: In Friedrich Froebel's Kindergarten system, what distinguishes a 'Gift' from an 'Occupation'?
options: Gifts are for teachers, while Occupations are given to parents.
Gifts retain their original form after play (e.g., wooden cubes), whereas Occupations involve altering materials (e.g., clay modelling, paper folding).
Gifts develop physical fitness, while Occupations develop spiritual awareness.
Gifts are introduced at age 10, whereas Occupations are introduced at age 3.
questions.explanation: Froebel's 'Gifts' (like balls and blocks) lead the child to discover form and concept without permanently changing the material, whereas 'Occupations' (like weaving and clay work) transform materials to cultivate creative construction.

questions.question: What is the primary role of the educator in a traditional Montessori classroom setting?
options: A direct lecturer controlling all classroom pace and activities
A directress who prepares the environment and observes child-directed autonomous learning
A strict disciplinarian enforcing uniform group tasks
A passive observer who never intervenes under any circumstances
questions.explanation: In Maria Montessori's method, the teacher is known as a 'Directress' or guide who prepares a structured environment and observes individual children as they engage with self-correcting materials.

questions.question: Which specific specific learning disability (SLD) affects a learner's ability to understand numbers, learn math facts, and process numerical symbols?
questions.explanation: Dyscalculia is a specific learning difficulty that causes individuals to struggle with understanding numbers, mathematical concepts, and calculations.

questions.question: A student exhibits normal cognitive intelligence but experiences persistent difficulty with fine motor coordination, spatial planning, and physical tasks like buttoning a shirt or holding a pencil correctly. Which condition does this reflect?
questions.explanation: Dyspraxia, also known as Developmental Coordination Disorder (DCD), affects motor skill coordination, planning, and execution of physical movements.

questions.question: Under the Rights of Persons with Disabilities (RPwD) Act, 2016 in India, how many total categories of specified benchmark disabilities are recognized?
questions.explanation: The RPwD Act 2016 increased the recognized categories of disabilities from 7 (under the 1995 Act) to 21 categories.

questions.question: In inclusive education policy, what is the core mandate of the 'Least Restrictive Environment' (LRE) principle?
options: Placing all children with special needs in separate specialized residential institutions
Educating students with disabilities alongside non-disabled peers in general education settings to the maximum extent appropriate
Exempting special needs students from taking standardized academic examinations
Providing separate home tutoring for all students with benchmark disabilities
questions.explanation: Least Restrictive Environment (LRE) requires that children with disabilities be educated with children who are non-disabled to the maximum extent appropriate, resorting to special classes only when severity demands.

questions.question: Under the Indian Government's SWAYAM portal for Massive Open Online Courses (MOOCs), what are the four designated structural quadrants of learning delivery?
options: e-Tutorial (video), e-Content (reading), Self-Assessment (tests), and Online Discussion Forum
Live Broadcast, Radio Lessons, Physical Textbooks, and Lab Manuals
Primary, Upper Primary, Secondary, and Higher Secondary content
Registration, Attendance, Term Examinations, and Certification
questions.explanation: SWAYAM courses are structured into 4 quadrants: Quadrant I (e-Tutorial - Video/Audio), Quadrant II (e-Content - Reading material/e-Books), Quadrant III (Self-Assessment - Tests/Quizzes), and Quadrant IV (Discussion Forum - Doubts).

questions.question: In the TPACK framework developed by Mishra and Koehler for effective technology integration in instruction, what does 'TPACK' stand for?
options: Technical, Pedagogical, and Applied Content Knowledge
Teaching, Planning, Assessment, and Communication Knowledge
Technological Process and Administrative Curriculum Knowledge
questions.explanation: TPACK stands for Technological Pedagogical Content Knowledge, describing the complex interaction between technology, pedagogy, and content knowledge required for effective tech-based teaching.

questions.question: Which systematic 10-step instructional design framework relies heavily on a systems approach involving instructional goals, performance objectives, criterion-referenced test items, and formative/summative evaluations?
questions.explanation: The Dick and Carey Model (Systems Approach Model) is a well-known 10-step instructional design framework that views instruction as a systematic process with interconnected components.

questions.question: In Ralph Tyler's classical model of curriculum construction ('Tyler Rationale'), what is the correct logical starting point for curriculum design?
options: Defining educational goals and learning objectives
questions.explanation: Ralph Tyler's four fundamental questions begin with defining clear educational objectives, followed by selecting learning experiences, organizing experiences, and evaluating outcomes.

questions.question: Who introduced the concept of the 'Spiral Curriculum', which asserts that any subject can be taught effectively in some intellectually honest form to any child at any stage of development?
questions.explanation: Jerome Bruner introduced the 'Spiral Curriculum' in his 1960 book 'The Process of Education', proposing that foundational concepts should be revisited at progressively higher levels of complexity.

questions.question: Carl Rogers established Person-Centred (Non-Directive) Therapy. Which of the following is NOT one of Rogers' three necessary and sufficient core conditions for therapeutic change?
questions.explanation: Carl Rogers identified three core conditions: Congruence (genuineness), Unconditional Positive Regard (acceptance), and Empathic Understanding. Directive/diagnostic interpretation is explicitly avoided in non-directive counselling.

questions.question: According to Lev Vygotsky's Socio-Cultural Theory of Cognitive Development, what does the term 'Scaffolding' refer to in an instructional context?
options: Permanent structural support provided by the teacher throughout the student's entire schooling
Temporary support given by a More Knowledgeable Other (MKO) that is gradually withdrawn as the learner gains independence
A behavioral system of extrinsic rewards given to students for completing difficult tasks
The physical arrangement of classroom seating to facilitate peer interaction
questions.explanation: In Vygotsky's theory (popularized by Jerome Bruner in an instructional context), 'Scaffolding' is tailored, temporary support provided by a teacher or More Knowledgeable Other (MKO) within the Zone of Proximal Development (ZPD). This assistance is progressively removed (faded) as the learner achieves mastery and independence.

or.question: ଲେଭ ଭିଗୋଟ୍ସ୍କିଙ୍କ (Lev Vygotsky) ସାମାଜିକ-ସାଂସ୍କୃତିକ ବିକାଶ ସିଦ୍ଧାନ୍ତ ଅନୁଯାୟୀ, ଶିକ୍ଷାଦାନ ପରିବେଶରେ 'ସ୍କାଫୋଲ୍ଡିଂ' (Scaffolding) ଶବ୍ଦଟି କାହାକୁ ସୂଚିତ କରେ?
options: ଛାତ୍ରଙ୍କ ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଶିକ୍ଷା ଗ୍ରହଣ କାଳରେ ଶିକ୍ଷକଙ୍କ ଦ୍ୱାରା ପ୍ରଦତ୍ତ ସ୍ଥାୟୀ ସଂରଚନାତ୍ମକ ସହାୟତା
ଜଣେ ଅଧିକ ଜ୍ଞାନୀ ବ୍ୟକ୍ତି (MKO) ଙ୍କ ଦ୍ୱାରା ଦିଆଯାଉଥିବା ଅସ୍ଥାୟୀ ସହାୟତା, ଯାହା ଶିକ୍ଷାର୍ଥୀ ଆତ୍ମନିର୍ଭରଶୀଳ ହେବା ସହିତ ଧୀରେ ଧୀରେ ହ୍ରାସ କରାଯାଏ
କଠିନ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟ ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ କରିବା ପାଇଁ ଛାତ୍ରମାନଙ୍କୁ ଦିଆଯାଉଥିବା ବାହ୍ୟ ଆଚରଣଗତ ପୁରସ୍କାରର ଏକ ବ୍ୟବସ୍ଥା
ସାଥୀମାନଙ୍କ ମଧ୍ୟରେ କଥାବାର୍ତ୍ତାକୁ ସହଜ କରିବା ପାଇଁ ଶ୍ରେଣୀଗୃହର ଆସବାବପତ୍ରର ଭୌତିକ ସଜ୍ଜିକରଣ
or.explanation: ଭିଗୋଟ୍ସ୍କିଙ୍କ ସିଦ୍ଧାନ୍ତ ଅନୁଯାୟୀ, 'ସ୍କାଫୋଲ୍ଡିଂ' ହେଉଛି ଜଣେ ଅଧିକ ଜ୍ଞାନୀ ବ୍ୟକ୍ତିଙ୍କ ଦ୍ୱାରା ପ୍ରଦତ୍ତ ଅସ୍ଥାୟୀ ସହାୟତା, ଯାହା ଶିକ୍ଷାର୍ଥୀ ନିଜେ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟ କରିବାକୁ ସମର୍ଥ ହେବା ସହିତ ପ୍ରତ୍ୟାହାର କରାଯାଇଥାଏ।

questions.question: In educational evaluation and measurement, which level of scale (as classified by S.S. Stevens) possesses a true, absolute zero point, allowing for meaningful numerical ratios between measurements?
questions.explanation: S.S. Stevens classified measurement into four levels: Nominal, Ordinal, Interval, and Ratio. The Ratio scale is the highest level of measurement and possesses a non-arbitrary, true absolute zero point (representing the complete absence of the property being measured), which allows for valid statements about ratios (e.g., 'twice as much').

or.question: ଶିକ୍ଷାଗତ ମୂଲ୍ୟାଙ୍କନ ଏବଂ ମାପରେ, ଏସ.ଏସ. ଷ୍ଟିଭେନ୍ସ (S.S. Stevens) ଙ୍କ ଦ୍ୱାରା ବର୍ଗୀକୃତ କେଉଁ ମାପକ ସ୍କେଲ୍‌ରେ (level of scale) ଏକ ପ୍ରକୃତ/ନିଶ୍ଚିତ ଶୂନ୍ୟ ବିନ୍ଦୁ (absolute zero point) ଥାଏ, ଯାହା ମାପଗୁଡ଼ିକ ମଧ୍ୟରେ ଅର୍ଥପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଗାଣିତିକ ଅନୁପାତ ସମ୍ଭବ କରିଥାଏ?
or.explanation: ଏସ.ଏସ. ଷ୍ଟିଭେନ୍ସଙ୍କ ଚାରୋଟି ମାପକ ସ୍କେଲ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ 'ଅନୁପାତ ସ୍କେଲ୍' (Ratio Scale) ହେଉଛି ସବୁଠାରୁ ଉଚ୍ଚ ସ୍ତରର, ଯେଉଁଥିରେ ଏକ ପ୍ରକୃତ/ନିଶ୍ଚିତ ଶୂନ୍ୟ ବିନ୍ଦୁ ଥାଏ ଏବଂ ଏହା ଗାଣିତିକ ଅନୁପାତ ମାପିବାକୁ ସକ୍ଷମ କରିଥାଏ।

questions.question: Which of the following coordination complexes is paramagnetic?
questions.explanation: [Fe(H2O)6]3+ contains Fe3+, which has a d5 electronic configuration. Since H2O is a weak-field ligand, it forms a high-spin complex with 5 unpaired electrons, making it strongly paramagnetic. On the other hand, [Ni(CN)4]2- (d8, square planar), [Fe(CN)6]4- (low-spin d6), and [Zn(NH3)4]2+ (d10) are all diamagnetic.

or.question: ନିମ୍ନଲିଖିତ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ କେଉଁ କୋଅର୍ଡିନେସନ୍ କମ୍ପ୍ଲେକ୍ସଟି ପାରାମ୍ୟାଗ୍ନେଟିକ୍ (paramagnetic) ଅଟେ?
or.explanation: [Fe(H2O)6]3+ ରେ Fe3+ ରହିଛି, ଯାହାର d5 ଇଲେକ୍ଟ୍ରୋନିକ୍ କନ୍ଫିଗୁରେସନ୍ ଅଛି। H2O ଏକ ଦୁର୍ବଳ ଫିଲ୍ଡ ଲିଗାଣ୍ଡ ହୋଇଥିବାରୁ, ଏହା 5ଟି ଅଯୁଗ୍ମ ଇଲେକ୍ଟ୍ରନ୍ ସହିତ ଏକ ହାଇ-ସ୍ପିନ୍ କମ୍ପ୍ଲେକ୍ସ ଗଠନ କରେ, ଯାହା ଏହାକୁ ପାରାମ୍ୟାଗ୍ନେଟିକ୍ କରିଥାଏ। ଅନ୍ୟପକ୍ଷରେ, [Ni(CN)4]2-, [Fe(CN)6]4- ଏବଂ [Zn(NH3)4]2+ ସମସ୍ତେ ଡାୟାମ୍ୟାଗ୍ନେଟିକ୍ ଅଟନ୍ତି।

questions.question: Under thermal conditions, the electrocyclic ring-opening of trans-3,4-dimethylcyclobutene proceeds via a conrotatory pathway to predominantly yield which of the following products?
questions.explanation: According to the Woodward-Hoffmann rules, thermal electrocyclic reactions of 4n π-electron systems (here, n=1, giving 4 π-electrons) occur via a conrotatory mode. For trans-3,4-dimethylcyclobutene, conrotatory motion causes both methyl groups to rotate outward into E positions to minimize steric hindrance, predominantly yielding (2E,4E)-hexa-2,4-diene.

or.question: ତାପୀୟ ପରିସ୍ଥିତିରେ (thermal conditions), trans-3,4-dimethylcyclobutene ର ଇଲେକ୍ଟ୍ରୋସାଇକ୍ଲିକ୍ ରିଙ୍ଗ-ଓପନିଂ କନ୍‌ରୋଟେଟରୀ (conrotatory) ପାଥୱେ ଦ୍ୱାରା ପ୍ରମୁଖ ଭାବରେ ନିମ୍ନଲିଖିତ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ କେଉଁ ଉତ୍ପାଦ ପ୍ରଦାନ କରେ?
or.explanation: ୱୁଡୱାର୍ଡ-ହଫମ୍ୟାନ୍ (Woodward-Hoffmann) ନିୟମ ଅନୁସାରେ, 4n π-ଇଲେକ୍ଟ୍ରୋନ୍ ସିଷ୍ଟମର ତାପୀୟ ଇଲେକ୍ଟ୍ରୋସାଇକ୍ଲିକ୍ ପ୍ରତିକ୍ରିୟା କନ୍‌ରୋଟେଟରୀ ମୋଡ୍ ଦ୍ୱାରା ଘଟିଥାଏ। trans-3,4-dimethylcyclobutene ପାଇଁ, କନ୍‌ରୋଟେଟରୀ ଗତି ଦ୍ୱାରା ଦୁଇଟି ମିଥାଇଲ୍ ଗ୍ରୁପ୍ ବାହାରକୁ E ପୋଜିସନ୍‌କୁ ଘୁରିଯାଆନ୍ତି, ଯାହା ମୁଖ୍ୟତଃ (2E,4E)-hexa-2,4-diene ଉତ୍ପନ୍ନ କରେ।

questions.question: According to Erik Erikson's theory of psychosocial development, what is the primary developmental crisis faced by children during the early childhood stage (ages 3 to 5 years)?
questions.explanation: During early childhood (preschool years, ages 3-5), children enter the stage of 'Initiative vs. Guilt'. In this stage, children attempt to assert control and power over their environment by planning activities, accomplishing tasks, and facing challenges.

or.question: ଏରିକ୍ ଏରିକସନ୍‌ଙ୍କ ମନୋସାମାଜିକ ବିକାଶ ସିଦ୍ଧାନ୍ତ ଅନୁଯାୟୀ, ପ୍ରାରମ୍ଭିକ ଶୈଶବାବସ୍ଥା (୩ ରୁ ୫ ବର୍ଷ) ମଧ୍ୟରେ ଶିଶୁମାନେ କେଉଁ ମୁଖ୍ୟ ବିକାଶମୂଳକ ସଙ୍କଟର ସମ୍ମୁଖୀନ ହୁଅନ୍ତି?
options: ସ୍ୱାୟତ୍ତତା ବନାମ ଲଜ୍ଜା ଓ ସନ୍ଦେହ (Autonomy vs. Shame and Doubt)
or.explanation: ପ୍ରାରମ୍ଭିକ ଶୈଶବାବସ୍ଥାରେ (୩ ରୁ ୫ ବର୍ଷ), ଶିଶୁମାନେ 'ଆତ୍ମ-ପ୍ରଚେଷ୍ଟା ବନାମ ଦୋଷୀଭାବ' (Initiative vs. Guilt) ସଙ୍କଟର ସମ୍ମୁଖୀନ ହୁଅନ୍ତି। ଏହି ସମୟରେ ସେମାନେ ନିଜର ଯୋଜନା ଓ ଖେଳ ମାଧ୍ୟମରେ ପରିବେଶ ଉପରେ ନିୟନ୍ତ୍ରଣ ଓ ନେତୃତ୍ୱ ନେବାର କ୍ଷମତା ବିକଶିତ କରନ୍ତି।

questions.question: According to Robert Siegler's Overlapping Waves Theory of cognitive development, how do children's problem-solving strategies evolve over time?
options: Children replace older, less effective strategies abruptly with a single new strategy in a step-like progression.
Children maintain a repertoire of multiple strategies simultaneously, with the relative frequency of strategy usage shifting gradually based on efficiency and accuracy.
Children strictly follow a fixed sequence of strategies that are biologically hardwired to mature at specific chronological ages.
Children rely exclusively on trial-and-error strategies until formal operational thinking is fully attained.
questions.explanation: Robert Siegler's Overlapping Waves Theory posits that cognitive development is dynamic and non-linear. Rather than moving abruptly from one stage or strategy to another, children possess multiple competing strategies simultaneously. Over time and experience, the frequency of using more efficient and accurate strategies gradually increases while reliance on less effective strategies diminishes.

or.question: ରବର୍ଟ ସିଗଲର୍‌ଙ୍କ ଜ୍ଞାନାତ୍ମକ ବିକାଶର 'ଓଭରଲ୍ୟାପିଂ ୱେଭ୍ସ ସିଦ୍ଧାନ୍ତ' (Overlapping Waves Theory) ଅନୁଯାୟୀ, ସମୟ ସହିତ ଶିଶୁମାନଙ୍କର ସମସ୍ୟା ସମାଧାନ କୌଶଳ କିପରି ପରିବର୍ତ୍ତିତ ହୁଏ?
options: ଶିଶୁମାନେ ହଠାତ୍ ପୁରୁଣା, କମ୍ ପ୍ରଭାବଶାଳୀ କୌଶଳଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ଏକ ନୂତନ କୌଶଳ ଦ୍ୱାରା ଏକ ସୋପାନ ଆକାରରେ ବଦଳାଇଥାନ୍ତି।
ଶିଶୁମାନେ ଏକାସାଙ୍ଗରେ ଏକାଧିକ କୌଶଳ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରନ୍ତି, ଏବଂ ଦକ୍ଷତା ଓ ନିର୍ଭୁଲତା ଆଧାରରେ କୌଶଳ ବ୍ୟବହାରର ପରିମାଣ ଧୀରେ ଧୀରେ ପରିବର୍ତ୍ତିତ ହୁଏ।
ଶିଶୁମାନେ କଠୋର ଭାବରେ କୌଶଳଗୁଡ଼ିକର ଏକ ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦିଷ୍ଟ କ୍ରମ ଅନୁସରଣ କରନ୍ତି ଯାହା ଜୈବିକ ଭାବରେ ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦିଷ୍ଟ ବୟସରେ ବିକଶିତ ହୁଏ।
ଆନୁଷ୍ଠାନିକ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟକାରୀ ଚିନ୍ତନ (Formal operational thinking) ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ନ ହେବା ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ଶିଶୁମାନେ କେବଳ ପରୀକ୍ଷା ଓ ଭୁଲ୍ କୌଶଳ ଉପରେ ନିର୍ଭର କରନ୍ତି।
or.explanation: ରବର୍ଟ ସିଗଲର୍‌ଙ୍କ ଓଭରଲ୍ୟାପିଂ ୱେଭ୍ସ ସିଦ୍ଧାନ୍ତ ଅନୁସାରେ ଜ୍ଞାନାତ୍ମକ ବିକାଶ ଗତିଶୀଳ ଏବଂ ଅସରଳ। ଶିଶୁମାନେ ଏକାସାଙ୍ଗରେ ଏକାଧିକ କୌଶଳ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରନ୍ତି; ଅଭିଜ୍ଞତା ବୃଦ୍ଧି ପାଇବା ସହିତ ଅଧିକ ପ୍ରଭାବଶାଳୀ ଓ ନିର୍ଭୁଲ କୌଶଳର ବ୍ୟବହାର ଧୀରେ ଧୀରେ ବୃଦ୍ଧି ପାଏ ଏବଂ କମ୍ ପ୍ରଭାବଶାଳୀ କୌଶଳର ବ୍ୟବହାର ହ୍ରାସ ପାଏ।

questions.question: Which committee recommended the inclusion of Fundamental Duties in the Constitution of India?
questions.explanation: The Swaran Singh Committee recommended the inclusion of Fundamental Duties in the Constitution of India in 1976, which led to the insertion of Article 51A via the 42nd Constitutional Amendment Act.

or.question: ଭାରତୀୟ ସମ୍ବିଧାନରେ ମୌଳିକ କର୍ତ୍ତବ୍ୟର ଅନ୍ତର୍ଭୁକ୍ତି ପାଇଁ କେଉଁ କମିଟି ସୁପାରିଶ କରିଥିଲା?
or.explanation: ୧୯୭୬ ମସିହାରେ ସ୍ୱରଣ ସିଂ କମିଟି ଭାରତୀୟ ସମ୍ବିଧାନରେ ମୌଳିକ କର୍ତ୍ତବ୍ୟ ଅନ୍ତର୍ଭୁକ୍ତ କରିବାକୁ ସୁପାରିଶ କରିଥିଲା, ଯାହା ୪୨ତମ ସମ୍ବିଧାନ ସଂଶୋଧନ ଅଧିନିୟମ ଦ୍ୱାରା ଧାରା ୫୧A ଭାବରେ ଯୋଡ଼ାଯାଇଥିଲା।

questions.question: Which among the following Biosphere Reserves of India was the FIRST to be included in UNESCO's World Network of Biosphere Reserves under the Man and the Biosphere (MAB) Programme?
questions.explanation: The Nilgiri Biosphere Reserve was designated as a biosphere reserve in 1986 and became the first biosphere reserve from India to be included in UNESCO's World Network of Biosphere Reserves in the year 2000.

or.question: ୟୁନେସ୍କୋର 'ମ୍ୟାନ୍ ଆଣ୍ଡ୍ ଦି ବାୟୋସ୍ଫିୟର୍ (MAB)' କାର୍ଯ୍ୟକ୍ରମ ଅଧୀନରେ ୟୁନେସ୍କୋର ୱାର୍ଲ୍ଡ ନେଟୱାର୍କ ଅଫ୍ ବାୟୋସ୍ଫିୟର୍ ରିଜର୍ଭରେ ଅନ୍ତର୍ଭୁକ୍ତ ହୋଇଥିବା ଭାରତର ପ୍ରଥମ ଜୈବମଣ୍ଡଳ ସଂରକ୍ଷିତ ଅଞ୍ଚଳ କେଉଁଟି?
or.explanation: ନୀଳଗିରି ଜୈବମଣ୍ଡଳ ସଂରକ୍ଷିତ ଅଞ୍ଚଳ ୧୯୮୬ ମସିହାରେ ପ୍ରତିଷ୍ଠିତ ହୋଇଥିଲା ଏବଂ ୨୦୦୦ ମସିହାରେ ୟୁନେସ୍କୋର ୱାର୍ଲ୍ଡ ନେଟୱାର୍କ ଅଫ୍ ବାୟୋସ୍ଫିୟର୍ ରିଜର୍ଭରେ ଅନ୍ତର୍ଭୁକ୍ତ ହୋଇଥିବା ଭାରତର ପ୍ରଥମ ଜୈବମଣ୍ଡଳ ଅଞ୍ଚଳ ଥିଲା।

questions.question: According to the standard model of Microteaching developed by the National Council of Educational Research and Training (NCERT), what is the total prescribed duration for one complete microteaching cycle?
questions.explanation: The NCERT model of microteaching prescribes a total duration of 36 minutes for a complete cycle: Teach (6 min), Feedback (6 min), Re-plan (12 min), Re-teach (6 min), and Re-feedback (6 min).

or.question: ଜାତୀୟ ଶିକ୍ଷା ଗବେଷଣା ଓ ପ୍ରଶିକ୍ଷଣ ପରିଷଦ (NCERT) ଦ୍ୱାରା ବିକଶିତ ମାଇକ୍ରୋଟିଚିଂ (ସୂକ୍ଷ୍ମ ଶିକ୍ଷଣ) ର ମାନକ ମଡେଲ ଅନୁଯାୟୀ, ଗୋଟିଏ ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ମାଇକ୍ରୋଟିଚିଂ ଚକ୍ର ପାଇଁ ମୋଟ କେତେ ସମୟ ନିର୍ଦ୍ଧାରିତ ହୋଇଛି?
or.explanation: NCERT ର ମାଇକ୍ରୋଟିଚିଂ ମଡେଲରେ ଗୋଟିଏ ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଚକ୍ର ପାଇଁ ମୋଟ 36 ମିନିଟ୍ ସମୟ ନିର୍ଦ୍ଧାରିତ: ଶିକ୍ଷଣ (6 ମିନିଟ୍), ପ୍ରତିପୋଷଣ/ଫିଡବ୍ୟାକ୍ (6 ମିନିଟ୍), ପୁନଃ-ଯୋଜନା (12 ମିନିଟ୍), ପୁନଃ-ଶିକ୍ଷଣ (6 ମିନିଟ୍) ଏବଂ ପୁନଃ-ପ୍ରତିପୋଷଣ (6 ମିନିଟ୍)।

questions.question: According to David Ausubel's Subsumption Theory of Meaningful Verbal Learning, which type of subsumption takes place when new instructional material is acquired as a direct specific example or illustrative instance of an already established concept in the learner's cognitive structure?
questions.explanation: In David Ausubel's theory, derivative subsumption occurs when new information is learned as a direct illustrative instance or specific example of a concept already established in the learner's cognitive structure. Correlative subsumption occurs when new material alters, extends, or elaborates an existing concept.

or.question: ଡେଭିଡ୍ ଆସୁବେଲଙ୍କ 'ଅର୍ଥପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଶାବ୍ଦିକ ଶିକ୍ଷଣ ସିଦ୍ଧାନ୍ତ' (Subsumption Theory) ଅନୁଯାୟୀ, ଯେତେବେଳେ ନୂତନ ଶିକ୍ଷଣୀୟ ବିଷୟବସ୍ତୁ ଶିକ୍ଷାର୍ଥୀଙ୍କ ସଂଜ୍ଞାନାତ୍ମକ ସଂରଚନାରେ ପୂର୍ବରୁ ଥିବା ଏକ ଧାରଣାର ସିଧାସଳଖ ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦିଷ୍ଟ ଉଦାହରଣ ଭାବରେ ଆହରଣ କରାଯାଏ, ସେତେବେଳେ କେଉଁ ପ୍ରକାରର 'ସବସମ୍ପସନ୍' (ସମାବେଶ) ଘଟିଥାଏ?
or.explanation: ଡେଭିଡ୍ ଆସୁବେଲଙ୍କ ସିଦ୍ଧାନ୍ତ ଅନୁସାରେ, ଡେରିଭେଟିଭ୍ ସବସମ୍ପସନ୍ (Derivative subsumption) ସେତେବେଳେ ଘଟେ ଯେତେବେଳେ ନୂତନ ତଥ୍ୟ ଶିକ୍ଷାର୍ଥୀ ଜାଣିଥିବା ଏକ ଧାରଣାର ସିଧାସଳଖ ଉଦାହରଣ ଭାବରେ ଶିକ୍ଷା କରାଯାଏ। କୋରିଲେଟିଭ୍ ସବସମ୍ପସନ୍ ପୂର୍ବରୁ ଥିବା ଧାରଣାକୁ ବିସ୍ତାରିତ କିମ୍ବା ପରିବର୍ତ୍ତିତ କରିଥାଏ।

questions.question: According to the longitudinal study on temperament conducted by Alexander Thomas and Stella Chess, which temperament constellation is characterized by regular biological functions, a positive approach to new stimuli, high adaptability, and a predominantly mild-to-moderate positive mood?
questions.explanation: Alexander Thomas and Stella Chess categorized infant temperament into three primary clusters: Easy (40%), Difficult (10%), and Slow-to-Warm-Up (15%). The 'Easy child' quickly establishes regular routines in infancy, is generally cheerful, and adapts easily to new experiences.

or.question: ଆଲେକ୍ସଜାଣ୍ଡାର୍ ଥୋମାସ୍ ଏବଂ ଷ୍ଟେଲା ଚେସ୍‌ଙ୍କ ଦ୍ୱାରା ଶିଶୁର ବ୍ୟବହାର (temperament) ଉପରେ କରାଯାଇଥିବା ଅନୁଧ୍ୟାନ ଅନୁସାରେ, ନିୟମିତ ଜୈବିକ ପ୍ରକ୍ରିୟା, ନୂତନ ଉଦ୍ଦୀପକ ପ୍ରତି ସକାରାତ୍ମକ ମନୋଭାବ, ଉଚ୍ଚ ଅଭିଯୋଜନ କ୍ଷମତା ଏବଂ ସାଧାରଣତଃ ମୃଦୁ-ମଧ୍ୟମ ସକାରାତ୍ମକ ମାନସିକ ସ୍ଥିତି କେଉଁ ପ୍ରକାରର ଶିଶୁ ବ୍ୟବହାରର ଲକ୍ଷଣ?
or.explanation: ଆଲେକ୍ସଜାଣ୍ଡାର୍ ଥୋମାସ୍ ଏବଂ ଷ୍ଟେଲା ଚେସ୍ ଶିଶୁର ବ୍ୟବହାରକୁ ତିନୋଟି ମୁଖ୍ୟ ଶ୍ରେଣୀରେ ବିଭକ୍ତ କରିଥିଲେ: ଇଜି (୪୦%), ଡିଫିକଲ୍ଟ (୧୦%) ଏବଂ ସ୍ଲୋ-ଟୁ-ୱାର୍ମ-ଅପ୍ (୧୫%)। 'ଇଜି ଶିଶୁ' ସହଜରେ ନିୟମିତ ଅଭ୍ୟାସ ଗଠନ କରେ, ସାଧାରଣତଃ ହସଖୁସି ରହେ ଏବଂ ନୂତନ ଅନୁଭୂତି ସହିତ ଶୀଘ୍ର ଖାପଖୁଆଇ ନିଏ।

questions.question: In Eleanor and James Gibson's ecological theory of perceptual development, what does the term 'affordance' specifically refer to?
options: The cognitive schema constructed by infants to interpret sensory inputs through assimilation.
The action possibilities that a given object or environment offers to an organism, perceived directly without complex cognitive processing.
The learned association between a neutral stimulus and an unconditioned stimulus during infancy.
The innate biological timetable that determines the sequence of visual acuity maturation.
questions.explanation: According to Eleanor and James Gibson's ecological model, 'affordances' are the actionable properties of objects and environments relative to the individual (e.g., a flat surface affords walking, a handle affords grasping). Perception involves directly detecting these opportunities for action in the surrounding world.

or.question: ଏଲିନୋର ଏବଂ ଜେମ୍ସ ଗିବସନଙ୍କ ପ୍ରତ୍ୟକ୍ଷାତ୍ମକ ବିକାଶର ପାରିସ୍ଥିତିକ ସିଦ୍ଧାନ୍ତ (ecological theory of perceptual development) ରେ, 'ଆଫୋର୍ଡାନ୍ସ' (affordance) ଶବ୍ଦଟି ବିଶେଷ ଭାବରେ କାହାକୁ ସୂଚାଏ?
options: ସଂବେଦନଶୀଳ ଇନପୁଟଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ଆତ୍ମସାତକରଣ ମାଧ୍ୟମରେ ବୁଝିବା ପାଇଁ ଶିଶୁମାନଙ୍କ ଦ୍ୱାରା ଗଠିତ ଜ୍ଞାନାତ୍ମକ ସ୍କିମା।
ଏକ ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦିଷ୍ଟ ବସ୍ତୁ କିମ୍ବା ପରିବେଶ ଏକ ଜୀବକୁ ପ୍ରଦାନ କରୁଥିବା କାର୍ଯ୍ୟର ସମ୍ଭାବନା, ଯାହା ଜଟିଳ ଜ୍ଞାନାତ୍ମକ ପ୍ରକ୍ରିୟା ବିନା ପ୍ରତ୍ୟକ୍ଷ ଭାବରେ ଅନୁଭୂତ ହୁଏ।
ଶୈଶବାବସ୍ଥାରେ ଏକ ନିରପେକ୍ଷ ଉଦ୍ଦୀପକ ଏବଂ ଅନୁବନ୍ଧିତ-ବିହୀନ ଉଦ୍ଦୀପକ ମଧ୍ୟରେ ଶିଖାଯାଇଥିବା ସମ୍ପର୍କ।
ଜନ୍ମଗତ ଜୈବିକ ସମୟସାରଣୀ ଯାହା ଦୃଷ୍ଟିଶକ୍ତିର ପରିପକ୍ୱତା କ୍ରମ ନିର୍ଦ୍ଧାରଣ କରେ।
or.explanation: ଏଲିନୋର ଏବଂ ଜେମ୍ସ ଗିବସନଙ୍କ ପାରିସ୍ଥିତିକ ମୋଡେଲ ଅନୁସାରେ, 'ଆଫୋର୍ଡାନ୍ସ' ହେଉଛି ଜଣେ ବ୍ୟକ୍ତିଙ୍କ ତୁଳନାରେ ବସ୍ତୁ ଏବଂ ପରିବେଶର କାର୍ଯ୍ୟକ୍ଷମ ଗୁଣ (ଯେପରିକି, ଏକ ସମତଳ ପୃଷ୍ଠ ଚାଲିବାର ସୁଯୋଗ ଦିଏ, ଏକ ହ୍ୟାଣ୍ଡେଲ ଧରିବାର ସୁଯୋଗ ଦିଏ)। ପ୍ରତ୍ୟକ୍ଷୀକରଣରେ ପରିବେଶରୁ ଏହିସବୁ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟ ସମ୍ଭାବନାଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ସିଧାସଳଖ ଚିହ୍ନଟ କରିବା ଅନ୍ତର୍ଭୁକ୍ତ।

questions.question: Which of the following rivers flows through the Silent Valley National Park in Kerala?
questions.explanation: The Kunthipuzha River originates in the Silent Valley National Park in Kerala and flows through its entire length before eventually merging into the Bharathapuzha River.

or.question: ନିମ୍ନଲିଖିତ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ କେଉଁ ନଦୀ କେରଳର ସାଇଲେଣ୍ଟ ଭ୍ୟାଲି ଜାତୀୟ ଉଦ୍ୟାନ ମଧ୍ୟଦେଇ ପ୍ରବାହିତ ହୁଏ?
or.explanation: କୁନ୍ତିପୁଝା ନଦୀ କେରଳର ସାଇଲେଣ୍ଟ ଭ୍ୟାଲି ଜାତୀୟ ଉଦ୍ୟାନରୁ ଉତ୍ପନ୍ନ ହୋଇ ଏହାର ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଦୈର୍ଘ୍ୟ ଦେଇ ପ୍ରବାହିତ ହୁଏ ଏବଂ ପରେ ଭାରତପୁଝା ନଦୀ ସହିତ ମିଶିଥାଏ।

questions.question:
Which of the following committees of the Lok Sabha is/are chaired ex-officio by the Speaker of the Lok Sabha?
1. Business Advisory Committee
2. Rules Committee
3. Committee on Privileges
4. General Purposes Committee

Select the correct answer using the code given below:
questions.explanation: The Speaker of the Lok Sabha is the ex-officio Chairman of the Business Advisory Committee, the Rules Committee, and the General Purposes Committee. The Chairman of the Committee on Privileges is nominated by the Speaker from among its members.

or.question:
ଲୋକସଭାର ନିମ୍ନଲିଖିତ କମିଟିଗୁଡ଼ିକ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ କେଉଁଟି/କେଉଁଗୁଡ଼ିକର ଅଧ୍ୟକ୍ଷତା ସ୍ୱୟଂ ଲୋକସଭା ବାଚସ୍ପତି ପଦବୀଗତ (ex-officio) ଭାବେ କରନ୍ତି?
୧. ବ୍ୟବସାୟ ପରାମର୍ଶଦାତା କମିଟି (Business Advisory Committee)
୨. ନିୟମାବଳୀ କମିଟି (Rules Committee)
୩. ବିଶେଷାଧିକାର କମିଟି (Committee on Privileges)
୪. ସାଧାରଣ ଉଦ୍ଦେଶ୍ୟ କମିଟି (General Purposes Committee)

ତଳେ ଦିଆଯାଇଥିବା ସଙ୍କେତ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରି ସଠିକ୍ ଉତ୍ତର ବାଛନ୍ତୁ:
or.explanation: ଲୋକସଭା ବାଚସ୍ପତି ସ୍ୱୟଂ ବ୍ୟବସାୟ ପରାମର୍ଶଦାତା କମିଟି, ନିୟମାବଳୀ କମିଟି ଏବଂ ସାଧାରଣ ଉଦ୍ଦେଶ୍ୟ କମିଟିର ପଦବୀଗତ (ex-officio) ଅଧ୍ୟକ୍ଷ ଅଟନ୍ତି। ବିଶେଷାଧିକାର କମିଟିର ଅଧ୍ୟକ୍ଷ ବାଚସ୍ପତିଙ୍କ ଦ୍ୱାରା ମନୋନୀତ ହୁଅନ୍ତି।

questions.question: Which branch of psychology focuses specifically on the scientific study of human learning processes, pedagogical interventions, and psychological aspects of educational settings?
questions.explanation: Educational Psychology is the branch of psychology concerned with how human beings learn in educational settings, evaluating instructional techniques, and understanding individual differences in learning.

questions.question: According to developmental psychology, the 'Cephalocaudal' trend of physical development dictates that motor control and growth proceed from:
options: The center of the body outward to extremities
General motor responses to specific responses
questions.explanation: The cephalocaudal principle states that development proceeds from top to bottom; a child gains control over head and facial movements before legs and feet.

questions.question: Which developmental principle states that physical growth and development proceed outward from the central longitudinal axis of the body toward the extremities?
questions.explanation: The proximodistal principle of development asserts that growth proceeds from the center of the body outward (e.g., control over arms before fingers).

questions.question: In Jean Piaget's theory, when a child understands that the quantity of a liquid remains the same despite being poured into a tall, narrow glass from a short, wide beaker, the child has developed:
questions.explanation: Conservation is the realization that fundamental physical properties (mass, volume, quantity) remain constant even when outward appearance changes, achieved in the Concrete Operational stage.

questions.question: According to Piaget's preoperational stage analysis, a young child's belief that non-living physical objects (such as the Sun or a doll) possess intentions, emotions, and life-like qualities is known as:
questions.explanation: Animism is the tendency of preoperational children to attribute human feelings, intentions, and consciousness to inanimate objects.

questions.question: In Lev Vygotsky's Sociocultural Theory, what does the acronym 'ZPD' stand for?
questions.explanation: ZPD stands for the Zone of Proximal Development, defined as the distance between actual independent problem-solving ability and potential development under guidance.

questions.question: In Vygotskyian pedagogy, temporary instructional support given by a teacher or more competent peer, which is gradually removed as the student gains autonomy, is termed:
questions.explanation: Scaffolding (a term popularized by Jerome Bruner in connection with Vygotsky's work) refers to tailored support provided to learners within their ZPD.

questions.question: According to Lawrence Kohlberg's theory, an individual who obeys rules purely to avoid physical punishment is operating at which level of moral development?
questions.explanation: Stage 1 (Punishment and Obedience Orientation) falls under the Pre-conventional level, where moral decisions are determined by direct physical consequences.

questions.question: In Lawrence Kohlberg's stage model, Stage 5 (Social Contract and Individual Rights) belongs to which broader level of moral reasoning?
questions.explanation: Stage 5 (Social Contract and Individual Rights) and Stage 6 (Universal Ethical Principles) comprise Level III: Post-conventional Morality.

questions.question: In Ivan Pavlov's classical conditioning experiments, before any conditioning took place, the sound of the bell initially served as a/an:
questions.explanation: Before association with meat powder, the sound of the bell elicited no salivation response and acted strictly as a Neutral Stimulus (NS).

questions.question: In B.F. Skinner's Operant Conditioning framework, removing an unpleasant stimulus (such as exempting a student from a hated chore) after a desired behavior occurs is an application of:
questions.explanation: Negative Reinforcement involves strengthening a behavior by removing or suppressing an aversive or unpleasant stimulus.

questions.question: In Atkinson and Shiffrin's stage model of memory, which memory structure has an virtually unlimited capacity and can retain information over extended periods?
questions.explanation: Long-Term Memory (LTM) is considered to have unlimited capacity and long duration, storing information across days, years, or a lifetime.

questions.question: In Sweller's Cognitive Load Theory, which type of cognitive load refers specifically to the inherent complexity and internal structure of the instructional material itself?
questions.explanation: Intrinsic Cognitive Load is generated by the inherent difficulty and element interactivity of the material to be learned, independent of instructional design.

questions.question: Which fundamental principle best defines Ernst von Glasersfeld's perspective of Radical Constructivism?
options: Knowledge is passively received from external reality through direct observation
Knowledge is actively built up by the cognizing subject, not passively received from the environment
Learning is driven exclusively by observable stimulus-response contingencies
Cognitive development is entirely predetermined by genetic maturation
questions.explanation: Radical Constructivism, formulated by von Glasersfeld, posits that knowledge is actively constructed by the learner rather than passively absorbed from an objective reality.

questions.question: In the widely adopted 5E Constructivist Instructional Model (Engage, Explore, Explain, Elaborate, Evaluate), which phase explicitly aims to uncover prior knowledge and activate curiosity?
questions.explanation: The 'Engage' phase is the first step of the 5E Model, designed to spark student interest, capture attention, and reveal existing prior conceptions.

questions.question: According to Howard Gardner's Theory of Multiple Intelligences, which type of intelligence involves the capacity to analyze problems logically, carry out mathematical operations, and investigate issues scientifically?
questions.explanation: Logical-Mathematical intelligence in Howard Gardner's framework refers to the ability to analyze problems logically, perform mathematical operations, and investigate issues scientifically.

or.question: ହୋୱାର୍ଡ ଗାର୍ଡନରଙ୍କ ବହୁବିଧ ବୁଦ୍ଧିମତ୍ତା (Multiple Intelligences) ସିଦ୍ଧାନ୍ତ ଅନୁଯାୟୀ, କେଉଁ ପ୍ରକାରର ବୁଦ୍ଧିମତ୍ତାରେ ସମସ୍ୟାଗୁଡ଼ିକର ଯୁକ୍ତିଯୁକ୍ତ ବିଶ୍ଲେଷଣ, ଗାଣିତିକ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟ ସମ୍ପାଦନ ଏବଂ ବୈଜ୍ଞାନିକ ଅନୁସନ୍ଧାନ କରିବାର କ୍ଷମତା ଅନ୍ତର୍ଭୁକ୍ତ?
or.explanation: ହୋୱାର୍ଡ ଗାର୍ଡନରଙ୍କ ଅନୁଯାୟୀ, ଲଜିକାଲ୍-ମ୍ୟାଥମେଟିକାଲ୍ ବୁଦ୍ଧିମତ୍ତା ସମସ୍ୟାର ଯୁକ୍ତିଯୁକ୍ତ ବିଶ୍ଲେଷଣ, ଗାଣିତିକ ହିସାବ ଏବଂ ବୈଜ୍ଞାନିକ ଅନୁସନ୍ଧାନ କରିବାର ଦକ୍ଷତାକୁ ଦର୍ଶାଏ।

questions.question: In Sigmund Freud's psychosexual theory of development, during which stage does the child experience the Oedipus or Electra complex, leading to identification with the same-sex parent?
questions.explanation: The phallic stage (roughly ages 3 to 6 years) is characterized by the Oedipus complex in boys and Electra complex in girls, where children develop unconscious sexual desires for the opposite-sex parent and eventually resolve this conflict by identifying with the same-sex parent.

or.question: ସିଗମଣ୍ଡ ଫ୍ରଏଡଙ୍କ ମନୋଲିଙ୍ଗିକ (psychosexual) ବିକାଶ ସିଦ୍ଧାନ୍ତରେ, କେଉଁ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟାୟରେ ଶିଶୁ ଇଡିପସ୍ (Oedipus) କିମ୍ବା ଇଲେକ୍ଟ୍ରା (Electra) ଜଟିଳତାର ସମ୍ମୁଖୀନ ହୋଇ ସମାନ ଲିଙ୍ଗର ପିତାମାତାଙ୍କ ସହ ନିଜକୁ ଚିହ୍ନଟ କରେ?
or.explanation: ଫାଲିକ୍ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟାୟ (ପ୍ରାୟ ୩ ରୁ ୬ ବର୍ଷ) ରେ ବାଳକମାନଙ୍କଠାରେ ଇଡିପସ୍ କମ୍ପ୍ଲେକ୍ସ ଏବଂ ବାଳିକାମାନଙ୍କଠାରେ ଇଲେକ୍ଟ୍ରା କମ୍ପ୍ଲେକ୍ସ ଦେଖାଯାଏ, ଯାହା ଶେଷରେ ସମାନ ଲିଙ୍ଗର ପିତାମାତାଙ୍କ ସହ ଆତ୍ମସାତ୍ କିମ୍ବା ପରିଚୟ ସୃଷ୍ଟି କରି ସମାଧାନ ହୋଇଥାଏ।

questions.question: The Heuristic Method of teaching, which emphasizes learning through self-discovery and problem-solving, was originally proposed by which educational scholar?
questions.explanation: The Heuristic Method of teaching was advocated by Henry Edward Armstrong (H.E. Armstrong). Under this student-centered method, pupils are placed in the role of independent discoverers and investigators to acquire knowledge through their own efforts.

or.question: ଶିକ୍ଷାଦାନର 'ହିଉରିଷ୍ଟିକ୍ ପଦ୍ଧତି' (Heuristic Method), ଯାହା ଆତ୍ମ-ଆବିଷ୍କାର ଏବଂ ସମସ୍ୟା ସମାଧାନ ମାଧ୍ୟମରେ ଶିକ୍ଷଣ ଉପରେ ଗୁରୁତ୍ୱ ଦିଏ, ତାହା ମୂଳତଃ କେଉଁ ଶିକ୍ଷାବିତ୍‌ଙ୍କ ଦ୍ୱାରା ପ୍ରସ୍ତାବିତ ହୋଇଥିଲା?
or.explanation: ଶିକ୍ଷାଦାନର ହିଉରିଷ୍ଟିକ୍ ପଦ୍ଧତି ହେନରୀ ଏଡୱାର୍ଡ ଆର୍ମଷ୍ଟ୍ରଙ୍ଗ (H.E. Armstrong) ଙ୍କ ଦ୍ୱାରା ପ୍ରବର୍ତ୍ତିତ ହୋଇଥିଲା। ଏହି ଶିକ୍ଷାର୍ଥୀ-କେନ୍ଦ୍ରିକ ପଦ୍ଧତିରେ, ଛାତ୍ରଛାତ୍ରୀମାନଙ୍କୁ ନିଜ ଉଦ୍ୟମରେ ଜ୍ଞାନ ଆହରଣ କରିବା ପାଇଁ ସ୍ୱାଧୀନ ଆବିଷ୍କାରକ ଭାବରେ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟ କରିବାର ସୁଯୋଗ ଦିଆଯାଏ।

questions.question: In Robert Sternberg's Triarchic Theory of Intelligence, which specific mental process under the Componential Subtheory is responsible for executive planning, monitoring, and evaluating problem-solving activities?
questions.explanation: In Sternberg's Triarchic Theory, Componential (Analytical) Intelligence involves three information-processing components: Metacomponents (executive processes that direct mental planning, monitoring, and decision-making), Performance components (non-executive processes that carry out instructions), and Knowledge-acquisition components (processes used in learning new information).

or.question: ରବର୍ଟ ଷ୍ଟର୍ନବର୍ଗଙ୍କ ବୁଦ୍ଧିମତ୍ତାର ତ୍ରିପାକ୍ଷିକ ତତ୍ତ୍ୱ (Triarchic Theory of Intelligence) ରେ, କମ୍ପୋନେଣ୍ଟିଆଲ୍ ସବ୍-ଥେଓରୀ ଅଧୀନରେ କେଉଁ ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦିଷ୍ଟ ମାନସିକ ପ୍ରକ୍ରିୟା ନିର୍ବାହୀ ଯୋଜନା, ନିରୀକ୍ଷଣ ଏବଂ ସମସ୍ୟା ସମାଧାନ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟର ମୂଲ୍ୟାଙ୍କନ ପାଇଁ ଉତ୍ତରଦାୟୀ?
or.explanation: ଷ୍ଟର୍ନବର୍ଗଙ୍କ ତ୍ରିପାକ୍ଷିକ ତତ୍ତ୍ୱରେ, କମ୍ପୋନେଣ୍ଟିଆଲ୍ (ବିଶ୍ଳେଷଣାତ୍ମକ) ସବ୍-ଥେଓରୀ ତିନୋଟି ସୂଚନା-ପ୍ରସେସିଂ ଉପାଦାନକୁ ନେଇ ଗଠିତ: ମେଟାକମ୍ପୋନେଣ୍ଟସ (ଯୋଜନା ଓ ନିଷ୍ପତ୍ତି ନେବା ପରି ନିର୍ବାହୀ ପ୍ରକ୍ରିୟା), ପରଫରମାନ୍ସ ଉପାଦାନ (ଯୋଜନାକୁ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟକାରୀ କରୁଥିବା ପ୍ରକ୍ରିୟା), ଏବଂ ନଲେଜ୍-ଆକ୍ୱିଜିସନ୍ ଉପାଦାନ (ନୂତନ ଜ୍ଞାନ ଆହରଣ ପାଇଁ ବ୍ୟବହୃତ ପ୍ରକ୍ରିୟା)।

questions.question: Which of the following neutral ligands acts as a pi-acid (pi-acceptor) ligand?
questions.explanation: Carbon monoxide (CO) is a classic pi-acid (pi-acceptor) ligand because it possesses low-energy, empty pi* antibonding molecular orbitals that accept electron density back-donated from filled metal d-orbitals.

or.question: ନିମ୍ନଲିଖିତ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ କେଉଁ ନିରପେକ୍ଷ ଲିଗାଣ୍ଡଟି ଏକ pi-ଅମ୍ଳ (pi-ଗ୍ରହୀତା) ଲିଗାଣ୍ଡ ଭାବରେ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟ କରେ?
or.explanation: କାର୍ବନ୍ ମୋନୋକ୍ସାଇଡ୍ (CO) ହେଉଛି ଏକ ଶକ୍ତିଶାଳୀ pi-ଗ୍ରହୀତା (pi-ଅମ୍ଳ) ଲିଗାଣ୍ଡ, କାରଣ ଏହାର ଖାଲି pi* ଆଣ୍ଟିବଣ୍ଡିଂ ଅରବିଟାଲ୍ ଧାତୁ d-ଅରବିଟାଲରୁ ଇଲେକ୍ଟ୍ରନ୍ ଗ୍ରହଣ କରିପାରେ।

questions.question: In the Michaelis-Menten mechanism for enzyme catalysis, E + S <==> ES -> P + E (with rate constants k1 for forward ES formation, k-1 for reverse, and k2 for product formation), what is the correct expression for the Michaelis constant (Km) under the steady-state approximation?
questions.explanation: Applying the steady-state approximation to the intermediate enzyme-substrate complex [ES], d[ES]/dt = k1[E][S] - (k-1 + k2)[ES] = 0. Solving for [E][S]/[ES] defines the Michaelis constant Km = (k-1 + k2) / k1.

or.question: ଏଞ୍ଜାଇମ୍ ଉତ୍ପ୍ରେରଣ ପାଇଁ ମାଇକେଲିସ୍-ମେଣ୍ଟେନ୍ କ୍ରିୟାବିଧି E + S <==> ES -> P + E (ଯେଉଁଠାରେ ସମ୍ମୁଖ ES ଗଠନ ପାଇଁ ହାର ସ୍ଥିରାଙ୍କ k1, ପଶ୍ଚାତ୍ ପାଇଁ k-1, ଏବଂ ଉତ୍ପାଦ ଗଠନ ପାଇଁ k2) ରେ, ସ୍ଥିର-ଅବସ୍ଥା ଆନୁମାନିକ ଅଧୀନରେ ମାଇକେଲିସ୍ ସ୍ଥିରାଙ୍କ (Km) ର ସୂତ୍ର କ’ଣ?
or.explanation: ମଧ୍ୟବର୍ତ୍ତୀ ଏଞ୍ଜାଇମ୍-ସବଷ୍ଟ୍ରେଟ୍ କମ୍ପ୍ଲେକ୍ସ [ES] ଉପରେ ସ୍ଥିର-ଅବସ୍ଥା ଆନୁମାନିକ ପ୍ରୟୋଗ କଲେ, d[ES]/dt = k1[E][S] - (k-1 + k2)[ES] = 0 ମିଳେ। ଏଥିରୁ [E][S]/[ES] ନିର୍ଣ୍ଣୟ କଲେ ମାଇକେଲିସ୍ ସ୍ଥିରାଙ୍କ Km = (k-1 + k2) / k1 ପ୍ରାପ୍ତ ହୁଏ।

questions.question: According to James Marcia's theory of adolescent identity statuses, which status is characterized by high commitment to an identity without having experienced prior exploration or identity crisis?
questions.explanation: Identity Foreclosure occurs when an adolescent commits to an identity, role, or goal (often chosen by parents or societal figures) without having personally engaged in exploration or experienced an identity crisis.

or.question: ଜେମ୍ସ ମାର୍ସିଆଙ୍କ କିଶୋର ପରିଚୟ ସ୍ଥିତି (Identity Status) ତତ୍ତ୍ୱ ଅନୁଯାୟୀ, ପୂର୍ବ ଅନୁସନ୍ଧାନ କିମ୍ବା ସଙ୍କଟର ସମ୍ମୁଖୀନ ନ ହୋଇ ଗୃହୀତ କୌଣସି ପରିଚୟ ପ୍ରତି ଉଚ୍ଚ ପ୍ରତିବଦ୍ଧତା (commitment) ଦର୍ଶାଉଥିବା ସ୍ଥିତିକୁ କ'ଣ କୁହାଯାଏ?
or.explanation: ମାର୍ସିଆଙ୍କ ଅନୁଯାୟୀ, 'ଆଇଡେଣ୍ଟିଟି ଫୋରକ୍ଲୋଜର' (Identity Foreclosure) ସେତେବେଳେ ଘଟେ ଯେତେବେଳେ ଜଣେ କିଶୋର କୌଣସି ବିକଳ୍ପର ଅନୁସନ୍ଧାନ କିମ୍ବା ସଙ୍କଟ ଦେଇ ନ ଯାଇ, ମୁଖ୍ୟତଃ ପିତାମାତା କିମ୍ବା ସମାଜର ପ୍ରଭାବରେ ଏକ ପରିଚୟ କିମ୍ବା ଲକ୍ଷ୍ୟ ପ୍ରତି ପ୍ରତିବଦ୍ଧ ହୋଇଯାଏ।

questions.question: According to Robert Selman's developmental model of social perspective-taking, at which stage does an individual first acquire the ability to step outside a two-person interaction and view the relationship from the objective perspective of a neutral third party?
questions.explanation: In Selman's Stage 3 (Mutual / Third-person perspective-taking, typically around ages 10–12), children can step outside a two-person interaction and view themselves and the interaction from the perspective of a neutral, objective third person.

or.question: ରୋବର୍ଟ ସେଲମ୍ୟାନ୍‌ଙ୍କ ସାମାଜିକ ଦୃଷ୍ଟିକୋଣ-ଗ୍ରହଣ (Social Perspective-Taking) ମୋଡେଲ ଅନୁଯାୟୀ, କେଉଁ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟାୟରେ ଜଣେ ବ୍ୟକ୍ତି ଦୁଇ-ଜଣିଆ ପାରସ୍ପରିକ କ୍ରିୟାରୁ ବାହାରି ଏକ ନିରପେକ୍ଷ ତୃତୀୟ ପକ୍ଷର ବସ୍ତୁନିଷ୍ଠ ଦୃଷ୍ଟିକୋଣରୁ ସମ୍ପର୍କକୁ ଦେଖିବାର ଦକ୍ଷତା ହାସଲ କରେ?
options: ପର୍ଯ୍ୟାୟ ୩: ପାରସ୍ପରିକ / ତୃତୀୟ-ପକ୍ଷ ଦୃଷ୍ଟିକୋଣ-ଗ୍ରହଣ (Mutual / Third-person perspective-taking)
ପର୍ଯ୍ୟାୟ ୪: ସାମାଜିକ / ଗଭୀର ଦୃଷ୍ଟିକୋଣ-ଗ୍ରହଣ (Societal / In-depth perspective-taking)
or.explanation: ସେଲମ୍ୟାନ୍‌ଙ୍କ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟାୟ ୩ (ପାରସ୍ପରିକ / ତୃତୀୟ-ପକ୍ଷ ଦୃଷ୍ଟିକୋଣ-ଗ୍ରହଣ, ବୟସ ୧୦-୧୨ ବର୍ଷ) ରେ, ଶିଶୁମାନେ ଦୁଇଜଣଙ୍କ ଆଲୋଚନା ବା କ୍ରିୟାକଳାପକୁ ଏକ ନିରପେକ୍ଷ ତୃତୀୟ-ପକ୍ଷ ପ୍ରେକ୍ଷାପଟରୁ ସମସାମୟିକ ଭାବେ ଅବଲୋକନ ଏବଂ ମୂଲ୍ୟାଙ୍କନ କରିବାର କ୍ଷମତା ହାସଲ କରନ୍ତି।

questions.question: Who was the Governor-General of India when the Vernacular Press Act was enacted in 1878?
questions.explanation: The Vernacular Press Act was passed in 1878 during the viceroyalty of Lord Lytton (1876–1880) to curtail the freedom of the Indian-language press. It was later repealed by Lord Ripon in 1882.

or.question: ୧୮୭୮ ମସିହାରେ ବର୍ଣ୍ଣାକ୍ୟୁଲାର ପ୍ରେସ ଆକ୍ଟ (Vernacular Press Act) ପାରିତ ହେବା ସମୟରେ ଭାରତର ଗଭର୍ଣ୍ଣର-ଜେନେରାଲ କିଏ ଥିଲେ?
or.explanation: ୧୮୭୮ ମସିହାରେ ଲର୍ଡ ଲିଟନଙ୍କ ଗଭର୍ଣ୍ଣର-ଜେନେରାଲସିପ୍ ସମୟରେ ଭାରତୀୟ ଭାଷାର ସମ୍ବାଦପତ୍ରଗୁଡ଼ିକର ସ୍ୱାଧୀନତାକୁ ନିୟନ୍ତ୍ରଣ କରିବା ପାଇଁ ବର୍ଣ୍ଣାକ୍ୟୁଲାର ପ୍ରେସ ଆକ୍ଟ ପାରିତ ହୋଇଥିଲା। ୧୮୮୨ ମସିହାରେ ଲର୍ଡ ରିପନ୍ ଏହାକୁ ରଦ୍ଦ କରିଥିଲେ।

questions.question: Which of the following mountain passes is situated at the tri-junction of India, China, and Myanmar borders in Arunachal Pradesh?
questions.explanation: Diphu Pass is a strategic mountain pass located in eastern Arunachal Pradesh at the tri-junction area of the borders between India, China, and Myanmar.

or.question: ଅରୁଣାଚଳ ପ୍ରଦେଶରେ ଭାରତ, ଚୀନ୍ ଏବଂ ମ୍ୟାଁମାର ସୀମାର ତ୍ରି-ସଙ୍ଗମ (tri-junction) ନିକଟରେ ନିମ୍ନଲିଖିତ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ କେଉଁ ଗିରିପଥ ଅବସ୍ଥିତ?
or.explanation: ଦିଫୁ ପାସ୍ (Diphu Pass) ଅରୁଣାଚଳ ପ୍ରଦେଶର ପୂର୍ବ ଭାଗରେ ଭାରତ, ଚୀନ୍ ଏବଂ ମ୍ୟାଁମାର ସୀମାର ତ୍ରି-ସଙ୍ଗମ ଅଞ୍ଚଳରେ ଅବସ୍ଥିତ ଏକ ଗୁରୁତ୍ୱପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ କୌଶଳଗତ ଗିରିପଥ।

questions.question: In Ned Flanders' Interaction Analysis Category System (FIACS) used for observing classroom climate, how many categories out of the total ten categories are specifically classified under 'Teacher Talk'?
questions.explanation: Flanders' Interaction Analysis Category System (FIACS) consists of 10 categories: 7 categories dedicated to Teacher Talk (Categories 1–4 for Indirect Influence and Categories 5–7 for Direct Influence), 2 categories for Student Talk (Categories 8–9), and 1 category for Silence or Confusion (Category 10).

or.question: ଶ୍ରେଣୀଗୃହ ପରିବେଶ ଅନୁଧ୍ୟାନ ପାଇଁ ବ୍ୟବହୃତ ନେଡ୍ ଫ୍ଲାଣ୍ଡର୍ସଙ୍କ ଇଣ୍ଟରାକ୍ସନ୍ ଆନାଲିସିସ୍ କ୍ୟାଟେଗୋରୀ ସିଷ୍ଟମ୍ (FIACS) ରେ, ମୋଟ ୧୦ଟି ବର୍ଗ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ କେତୋଟି ବର୍ଗ ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦିଷ୍ଟ ଭାବରେ 'ଶିକ୍ଷକଙ୍କ କଥାବାର୍ତ୍ତା' (Teacher Talk) ଅନ୍ତର୍ଗତ?
or.explanation: FIACS ରେ ମୋଟ ୧୦ଟି ବର୍ଗ ରହିଛି: ଯେଉଁଥିରୁ ୭ଟି ବର୍ଗ ଶିକ୍ଷକଙ୍କ କଥାବାର୍ତ୍ତା (୧ ରୁ ୪ ଅପ୍ରତ୍ୟକ୍ଷ ପ୍ରଭାବ ଏବଂ ୫ ରୁ ୭ ପ୍ରତ୍ୟକ୍ଷ ପ୍ରଭାବ), ୨ଟି ବର୍ଗ ଛାତ୍ରଙ୍କ କଥାବାର୍ତ୍ତା (୮-୯) ଏବଂ ୧ଟି ବର୍ଗ ନୀରବତା କିମ୍ବା ଦ୍ୱନ୍ଦ୍ୱ (୧୦) ପାଇଁ ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦିଷ୍ଟ।

questions.question: In Daniel Stufflebeam's CIPP Evaluation Model, which specific evaluation component focuses primarily on monitoring, documenting, and assessing the implementation of a program to identify operational defects and guide execution?
questions.explanation: In Stufflebeam's CIPP (Context, Input, Process, Product) model, Process Evaluation checks the continuous implementation of the plan, provides feedback about the execution of activities, documents procedural defects, and guides ongoing operations.

or.question: ଡାନିଏଲ୍ ଷ୍ଟଫଲବିମ୍‌ଙ୍କ CIPP ମୂଲ୍ୟାଙ୍କନ ମଡେଲରେ, କାର୍ଯ୍ୟାନ୍ୱୟନରେ ଥିବା ତ୍ରୁଟି ଚିହ୍ନଟ କରିବା ଏବଂ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟକାରିତାକୁ ମାର୍ଗଦର୍ଶନ କରିବା ପାଇଁ ଚାଲୁଥିବା କାର୍ଯ୍ୟକ୍ରମର ଅନୁଧ୍ୟାନ, ନଥିକରଣ ଓ ଆକଳନ କରୁଥିବା ମୂଲ୍ୟାଙ୍କନ ଉପାଦାନଟି କ'ଣ?
or.explanation: ଷ୍ଟଫଲବିମ୍‌ଙ୍କ CIPP ମଡେଲରେ, 'ପ୍ରକ୍ରିୟା ମୂଲ୍ୟାଙ୍କନ' (Process Evaluation) ଚାଲୁଥିବା କାର୍ଯ୍ୟକ୍ରମର କାର୍ଯ୍ୟାନ୍ୱୟନକୁ ଅନୁଧ୍ୟାନ ଓ ନଥିକରଣ କରେ, ଯାହା ଦ୍ୱାରା ପ୍ରକ୍ରିୟାଗତ ତ୍ରୁଟିଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ଚିହ୍ନଟ କରି ସୁଧାରାଯାଇପାରିବ।

questions.question: What is the primary product formed when phenol is treated with chloroform and aqueous sodium hydroxide, followed by acidification?
questions.explanation: The reaction of phenol with chloroform (CHCl3) in the presence of aqueous sodium hydroxide (NaOH) is known as the Reimer-Tiemann reaction. It introduces a formyl group (-CHO) ortho to the hydroxyl group, yielding salicylaldehyde as the major product.

or.question: ଫିନୋଲ୍ କୁ କ୍ଲୋରୋଫର୍ମ ଏବଂ ଜଳୀୟ ସୋଡିୟମ୍ ହାଇଡ୍ରୋକ୍ସାଇଡ୍ ସହିତ ପ୍ରତିକ୍ରିୟା କରାଇ, ପରେ ଅମ୍ଳୀକରଣ କଲେ ମୁଖ୍ୟତଃ କେଉଁ ଉତ୍ପାଦ ମିଳିଥାଏ?
or.explanation: ଫିନୋଲ୍ ସହିତ କ୍ଲୋରୋଫର୍ମ ଏବଂ ଜଳୀୟ ସୋଡିୟମ୍ ହାଇଡ୍ରୋକ୍ସାଇଡର ପ୍ରତିକ୍ରିୟାକୁ ରାଇମର୍-ଟିମ୍ୟାନ୍ (Reimer-Tiemann) ପ୍ରତିକ୍ରିୟା କୁହାଯାଏ, ଯାହା ମୁଖ୍ୟ ଉତ୍ପାଦ ଭାବରେ ସାଲିସିଲାଲ୍ଡିହାଇଡ୍ ପ୍ରଦାନ କରେ।

questions.question: According to the Stark-Einstein law of photochemical equivalence, what is the total light energy absorbed per mole of a substance undergoing a photochemical reaction at wavelength λ?
questions.explanation: According to the Stark-Einstein law, each molecule undergoing a photochemical reaction absorbs one quantum (photon) of radiation. For one mole of molecules, the total absorbed energy (known as one einstein) is E = N_A h ν = N_A hc / λ, where N_A is Avogadro's number, h is Planck's constant, c is the speed of light, and λ is the wavelength.

or.question: ଫୋଟୋକେମିକାଲ୍ ସମତୁଲ୍ୟତାର ଷ୍ଟାର୍କ-ଆଇନ୍‌ଷ୍ଟାଇନ୍ (Stark-Einstein) ନିୟମ ଅନୁସାରେ, λ ତରଙ୍ଗଦୈର୍ଘ୍ୟରେ ଫୋଟୋକେମିକାଲ୍ ପ୍ରତିକ୍ରିୟା କରୁଥିବା ଗୋଟିଏ ମୋଲ୍ ପଦାର୍ଥ ଦ୍ୱାରା ଶୋଷିତ ହେଉଥିବା ମୋଟ ଶକ୍ତିର ପରିମାଣ କେତେ?
or.explanation: ଷ୍ଟାର୍କ-ଆଇନ୍‌ଷ୍ଟାଇନ୍ ନିୟମ ଅନୁଯାୟୀ, ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ଅଣୁ ଗୋଟିଏ ଫୋଟନ୍ ଶୋଷଣ କରେ | ଗୋଟିଏ ମୋଲ୍ ଅଣୁ ପାଇଁ, ଶୋଷିତ ମୋଟ ଶକ୍ତି (୧ ଆଇନ୍‌ଷ୍ଟାଇନ୍) E = N_A h ν = N_A hc / λ ଅଟେ, ଯେଉଁଠାରେ N_A ହେଉଛି ଆଭୋଗାଡ୍ରୋ ସଂଖ୍ୟା, h ହେଉଛି ପ୍ଲାଙ୍କଙ୍କ ସ୍ଥିରାଙ୍କ, c ହେଉଛି ଆଲୋକର ବେଗ ଏବଂ λ ହେଉଛି ତରଙ୍ଗଦୈର୍ଘ୍ୟ |

questions.question: Who among the following established the 'Mukti Mission' in Pune in 1889 to aid destitute women and young widows?
questions.explanation: Pandita Ramabai established the Mukti Mission in 1889 at Kedgaon near Pune as a refuge and learning center for young widows and destitute women.

or.question: 1889 ମସିହାରେ ପୁଣେଠାରେ ନିରାଶ୍ରୟା ମହିଳା ଏବଂ ଯୁବ ବିଧବାମାନଙ୍କ ସହାୟତା ପାଇଁ ନିମ୍ନଲିଖିତ ମାନଙ୍କ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ କିଏ 'ମୁକ୍ତି ମିଶନ' ପ୍ରତିଷ୍ଠା କରିଥିଲେ?
or.explanation: ପଣ୍ଡିତା ରମାବାଈ 1889 ମସିହାରେ ପୁଣେ ନିକଟସ୍ଥ କେଡ଼ଗାଓଁଠାରେ ଯୁବ ବିଧବା ଏବଂ ନିରାଶ୍ରୟା ମହିଳାମାନଙ୍କ ରହିବା ଓ ଶିକ୍ଷା ପାଇଁ 'ମୁକ୍ତି ମିଶନ' ପ୍ରତିଷ୍ଠା କରିଥିଲେ।

questions.question: With reference to the Ramsar Wetlands in India, which of the following is the largest Ramsar Site in terms of total surface area?
questions.explanation: Sundarbans Wetland in West Bengal covers an area of approximately 4,230 square kilometers, making it the largest Ramsar site in India.

or.question: ଭାରତର ରାମସର ଆର୍ଦ୍ରଭୂମି ସନ୍ଦର୍ଭରେ, ମୋଟ ପୃଷ୍ଠଭୂମି କ୍ଷେତ୍ରଫଳ ଦୃଷ୍ଟିରୁ ନିମ୍ନଲିଖିତ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ କେଉଁଟି ଭାରତର ସବୁଠାରୁ ବଡ଼ ରାମସର ସାଇଟ୍?
or.explanation: ପଶ୍ଚିମବଙ୍ଗର ସୁନ୍ଦରବନ ଆର୍ଦ୍ରଭୂମି ପ୍ରାୟ 4,230 ବର୍ଗ କିଲୋମିଟର କ୍ଷେତ୍ରଫଳ ପରିବ୍ୟାପ୍ତ, ଯାହା ଏହାକୁ ଭାରତର ସବୁଠାରୁ ବଡ଼ ରାମସର ସାଇଟ୍ କରିଥାଏ।

questions.question: Which leadership style in classroom management involves giving complete freedom to students with minimal teacher intervention or direct instruction?
questions.explanation: The Laissez-faire leadership style allows students complete freedom to make decisions without direct guidance, structure, or intervention from the teacher.

questions.question: Which term was coined by educational theorist Jacob Kounin to describe a teacher's skill in communicating to students that they are aware of everything occurring in the classroom at all times?
questions.explanation: Jacob Kounin introduced 'Withitness' to describe a teacher's acute awareness of classroom activities and prompt addressing of misbehavior.

questions.question: What is the correct sequential order of the four fundamental steps in the Action Research cycle?
questions.explanation: The standard Action Research cycle follows a continuous spiral process of Plan, Act, Observe, and Reflect.

questions.question: Which methodological feature is LEAST appropriate for a classroom-based Action Research project carried out by a school teacher?
options: Immediate application to local classroom problems
Complex multi-stage probability sampling for external generalization
Use of qualitative observational checklists and diagnostic tests
questions.explanation: Action Research aims at immediate local context problem-solving, not large-scale generalization that requires complex multi-stage probability sampling.

questions.question: Under the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020, what is the new pedagogical and curricular structure replacing the former 10+2 system?
questions.explanation: NEP 2020 restructures school education into 5 years (Foundational) + 3 years (Preparatory) + 3 years (Middle) + 4 years (Secondary).

questions.question: Under NEP 2020, what does the acronym 'PARAKH' stand for in the context of student assessment?
options: Performance Assessment, Review, and Analysis of Knowledge for Holistic Development
Program for Academic Assessment, Review, and Knowledge Enhancement
Pedagogical Assessment, Rating, and Analysis of Knowledge for Higher Education
Performance Appraisal, Recognition, and Assessment of Knowledge for High-schools
questions.explanation: PARAKH stands for Performance Assessment, Review, and Analysis of Knowledge for Holistic Development, set up as a National Assessment Centre.

questions.question: According to the Schedule of the Right of Children to Free and Compulsory Education (RTE) Act 2009, what is the prescribed Pupil-Teacher Ratio (PTR) for primary schools (Classes I to V) with enrollment up to 200 children?
questions.explanation: The RTE Act 2009 prescribes a Pupil-Teacher Ratio (PTR) of 30:1 for primary schools for an enrollment up to 200 students.

questions.question: Which specific section of the Right to Education (RTE) Act 2009 explicitly prohibits physical punishment and mental harassment of children in schools?
questions.explanation: Section 17 of the RTE Act 2009 prohibits physical punishment and mental harassment of children and makes it a punishable offense.

questions.question: The National Curriculum Framework 2005 (NCF 2005) was prepared under the chairmanship of which eminent academician?
questions.explanation: NCF 2005 was drafted by the National Steering Committee under the leadership of renowned physicist and educationist Prof. Yash Pal.

questions.question: Which measure of central tendency represents the score that occurs with the highest frequency in a given distribution?
questions.explanation: The mode is defined as the most frequently occurring score in a set of data.

questions.question: In a standard normal distribution curve, approximately what percentage of the total observations falls within one standard deviation above and below the mean (±1 SD)?
questions.explanation: Under a normal curve, approximately 68.26% of the values fall within ±1 standard deviation of the mean.

questions.question: When a test score distribution is negatively skewed (skewed to the left), what is the correct relative magnitude relationship among Mean, Median, and Mode?
questions.explanation: In a negatively skewed distribution, extreme low scores pull the Mean to the left, making Mean < Median < Mode (or Mode > Median > Mean).

questions.question: Who proposed the Nativist theory of language acquisition featuring the concept of an innate Language Acquisition Device (LAD)?
questions.explanation: Noam Chomsky proposed that humans possess an innate capacity for language acquisition through a hypothetical Language Acquisition Device (LAD).

questions.question: In Stephen Krashen's theory of second language acquisition, which hypothesis argues that language learning occurs best when input is one step beyond the learner's current stage of competence (i + 1)?
questions.explanation: The Input Hypothesis states that language acquisition takes place when a learner receives 'comprehensible input' that is slightly above their current level (i + 1).

questions.question: What form of memory interference occurs when newly learned material interferes with the recall of previously stored information?
questions.explanation: Retroactive interference happens when new information acts backward to disrupt the retrieval of previously learned information.

questions.question: According to Lev Vygotsky's Social Development Theory, the distance between the actual developmental level as determined by independent problem solving and the level of potential development as determined through problem solving under adult guidance is known as the:
questions.explanation: Lev Vygotsky defined the Zone of Proximal Development (ZPD) as the distance between the actual developmental level determined by independent problem solving and the level of potential development determined through problem solving under adult guidance or in collaboration with more capable peers.

or.question: ଲେଭ୍ ଭିଗୋଟ୍ସ୍କିଙ୍କ (Lev Vygotsky) ସାମାଜିକ ବିକାଶ ସିଦ୍ଧାନ୍ତ ଅନୁଯାୟୀ, ସ୍ୱାଧୀନ ସମସ୍ୟା ସମାଧାନ ଦ୍ୱାରା ନିର୍ଦ୍ଧାରିତ ପ୍ରକୃତ ବିକାଶ ସ୍ତର ଏବଂ ବୟସ୍କଙ୍କ ମାର୍ଗଦର୍ଶନରେ ସମସ୍ୟା ସମାଧାନ ଦ୍ୱାରା ନିର୍ଦ୍ଧାରିତ ସମ୍ଭାବ୍ୟ ବିକାଶ ସ୍ତର ମଧ୍ୟରେ ଥିବା ବ୍ୟବଧାନକୁ କ’ଣ କୁହାଯାଏ?
options: ସାମୀପ୍ୟ ବିକାଶର କ୍ଷେତ୍ର (Zone of Proximal Development)
or.explanation: ଲେଭ୍ ଭିଗୋଟ୍ସ୍କି ସାମୀପ୍ୟ ବିକାଶର କ୍ଷେତ୍ର (Zone of Proximal Development) କୁ ସ୍ୱାଧୀନ ସମସ୍ୟା ସମାଧାନ ଦ୍ୱାରା ନିର୍ଦ୍ଧାରିତ ପ୍ରକୃତ ବିକାଶ ସ୍ତର ଏବଂ ବୟସ୍କ କିମ୍ବା ଅଧିକ ଦକ୍ଷ ସାଥୀଙ୍କ ମାର୍ଗଦର୍ଶନରେ ହାସଲ ହୋଇପାରୁଥିବା ସମ୍ଭାବ୍ୟ ବିକାଶ ସ୍ତର ମଧ୍ୟରେ ଥିବା ପାର୍ଥକ୍ୟ ଭାବରେ ସଂଜ୍ଞାୟିତ କରିଛନ୍ତି।

questions.question: In David Ausubel's Subsumption Theory of Meaningful Verbal Learning, which specific type of subsumption occurs when new material is learned as an extension, elaboration, or modification of a previously learned concept?
questions.explanation: Correlative Subsumption occurs when new learning material is an extension, elaboration, or qualification of previously learned concepts, requiring the higher-level concept in the cognitive structure to be modified or expanded to incorporate the new knowledge.

or.question: ଡେଭିଡ୍ ଆସୁବେଲଙ୍କ (David Ausubel) ସାର୍ଥକ ମୌଖିକ ଶିକ୍ଷଣର ସବ୍‌ସମ୍ପସନ୍ ସିଦ୍ଧାନ୍ତ (Subsumption Theory) ଅନୁଯାୟୀ, ଯେତେବେଳେ ନୂତନ ବିଷୟବସ୍ତୁ ପୂର୍ବରୁ ଶିଖାଯାଇଥିବା ଧାରଣାର ଏକ ବିସ୍ତାର, ପରିବର୍ଦ୍ଧନ କିମ୍ବା ସଂଶୋଧନ ଭାବରେ ଶିଖାଯାଏ, ତାହାକୁ କେଉଁ ପ୍ରକାରର ସବ୍‌ସମ୍ପସନ୍ କୁହାଯାଏ?
or.explanation: କୋରିଲେଟିଭ୍ ସବ୍‌ସମ୍ପସନ୍ (Correlative Subsumption) ସେତେବେଳେ ଘଟିଥାଏ ଯେତେବେଳେ ନୂତନ ଶିକ୍ଷଣ ବିଷୟବସ୍ତୁ ପୂର୍ବରୁ ଶିଖାଯାଇଥିବା ଧାରଣାର ଏକ ବିସ୍ତାର କିମ୍ବା ପରିବର୍ଦ୍ଧନ ହୋଇଥାଏ, ଯାହା ନୂତନ ଜ୍ଞାନକୁ ଅନ୍ତର୍ଭୁକ୍ତ କରିବା ପାଇଁ ଜ୍ଞାନାତ୍ମକ ସଂରଚନାରେ ଥିବା ଉଚ୍ଚ-ସ୍ତରର ଧାରଣାକୁ ସଂଶୋଧିତ କିମ୍ବା ବିସ୍ତାରିତ କରିବାକୁ ଦାବି କରେ।

questions.question: Which of the following mononuclear transition metal carbonyl complexes obeys the 18-electron rule?
questions.explanation: Chromium (Cr) is a Group 6 element with 6 valence electrons. Each of the 6 carbon monoxide (CO) ligands donates 2 electrons, giving a total valence electron count of 6 + (6 × 2) = 18. Thus, [Cr(CO)6] obeys the 18-electron rule. In contrast, [V(CO)6] has 17 electrons, [Mn(CO)5] has 17 electrons, and [Fe(CO)4] has 16 electrons.

or.question: ନିମ୍ନଲିଖିତ ଏକକ-କେନ୍ଦ୍ରୀୟ ସଂକ୍ରମଣ ଧାତୁ କାର୍ବୋନିଲ୍ କମ୍ପ୍ଲେକ୍ସଗୁଡ଼ିକ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ କେଉଁଟି ୧୮-ଇଲେକ୍ଟ୍ରନ୍ ନିୟମ ପାଳନ କରେ?
or.explanation: କ୍ରୋମିଅମ୍ (Cr) ହେଉଛି ଗ୍ରୁପ୍ ୬ ର ଏକ ମୌଳିକ, ଯାହାର ୬ଟି ଭାଲେନ୍ସ ଇଲେକ୍ଟ୍ରନ୍ ଅଛି | ୬ଟି କାର୍ବନ୍ ମୋନୋକ୍ସାଇଡ୍ (CO) ଲିଗାଣ୍ଡରୁ ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ୨ଟି ଇଲେକ୍ଟ୍ରନ୍ ଦାନ କରନ୍ତି, ଯାହା ମୋଟ ଭାଲେନ୍ସ ଇଲେକ୍ଟ୍ରନ୍ ସଂଖ୍ୟା ୬ + (୬ × ୨) = ୧୮ ଦିଏ | ତେଣୁ, [Cr(CO)6] ୧୮-ଇଲେକ୍ଟ୍ରନ୍ ନିୟମ ପାଳନ କରେ | [V(CO)6] ରେ ୧୭ଟି, [Mn(CO)5] ରେ ୧୭ଟି ଏବଂ [Fe(CO)4] ରେ ୧୬ଟି ଇଲେକ୍ଟ୍ରନ୍ ଥାଏ |

questions.question: In the 1H-NMR spectrum of an AB spin system, four line positions are observed at 460 Hz, 490 Hz, 510 Hz, and 540 Hz. What are the values of the spin-spin coupling constant (J_AB) and the chemical shift difference (Δν) between the two nuclei?
questions.explanation: For an AB spin system with line frequencies ν1 = 460 Hz, ν2 = 490 Hz, ν3 = 510 Hz, and ν4 = 540 Hz, the coupling constant J_AB = ν2 - ν1 = 490 - 460 = 30 Hz. The quantity 2C is given by (ν4 - ν1 + ν3 - ν2)/2 = (80 + 20)/2 = 50 Hz. Since (2C)^2 = (Δν)^2 + (J_AB)^2, we have 50^2 = (Δν)^2 + 30^2, which gives (Δν)^2 = 2500 - 900 = 1600, so Δν = 40 Hz.

or.question: ଏକ AB ସ୍ପିନ୍ ସିଷ୍ଟମର 1H-NMR ସ୍ପେକ୍ଟ୍ରମ୍ରେ, ଚାରୋଟି ଲାଇନ୍ ସ୍ଥିତି 460 Hz, 490 Hz, 510 Hz, ଏବଂ 540 Hz ରେ ଦେଖାଯାଏ | ଦୁଇଟି ନ୍ୟୁକ୍ଲିଅସ୍ ମଧ୍ୟରେ ସ୍ପିନ୍-ସ୍ପିନ୍ କପଲିଂ କନଷ୍ଟାଣ୍ଟ (J_AB) ଏବଂ କେମିକାଲ୍ ସିଫ୍ଟ ପାର୍ଥକ୍ୟ (Δν) ର ମୂଲ୍ୟ କେତେ?

questions.question: According to the Indian NCERT model of Microteaching, what is the standard total duration prescribed for one complete microteaching cycle?
questions.explanation: The standard Microteaching cycle developed by NCERT in India consists of 6 specific phases: Teaching (6 min), Feedback (6 min), Re-planning (12 min), Re-teaching (6 min), and Re-feedback (6 min), taking a total duration of 36 minutes.

or.question: ଭାରତୀୟ NCERT ର ମାଇକ୍ରୋଟିଚିଂ (ସୂକ୍ଷ୍ମ ଅଧ୍ୟାପନା) ମଡେଲ୍ ଅନୁଯାୟୀ, ଗୋଟିଏ ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ମାଇକ୍ରୋଟିଚିଂ ଚକ୍ର ପାଇଁ ନିର୍ଦ୍ଧାରିତ ମାନକ ସମୋଟ ସମୟ କେତେ?
or.explanation: ଭାରତରେ NCERT ଦ୍ୱାରା ବିକଶିତ ମାନକ ମାଇକ୍ରୋଟିଚିଂ ଚକ୍ରରେ ୬ ଟି ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦିଷ୍ଟ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟାୟ ରହିଛି: ଶିକ୍ଷାଦାନ (୬ ମିନିଟ୍), ପ୍ରତିପୋଷଣ/ଫିଡବ୍ୟାକ୍ (୬ ମିନିଟ୍), ପୁନଃ-ଯୋଜନା (୧୨ ମିନିଟ୍), ପୁନଃ-ଶିକ୍ଷାଦାନ (୬ ମିନିଟ୍), ଏବଂ ପୁନଃ-ଫିଡବ୍ୟାକ୍ (୬ ମିନିଟ୍), ଯାହା ସମୋଟ ୩୬ ମିନିଟ୍ ସମୟ ନେଇଥାଏ।

questions.question: According to Jerome Bruner's theory of cognitive growth, in which mode of representation do learners represent objects and events predominantly through direct, physical action and motor responses?
questions.explanation: Jerome Bruner proposed three modes of cognitive representation: Enactive (action-based, learning through direct physical movement), Iconic (image-based, learning through visual models), and Symbolic (language-based, learning through abstract symbols).

or.question: ଜେରୋମ୍ ବ୍ରୁନରଙ୍କ ଜ୍ଞାନାତ୍ମକ ବିକାଶ ତତ୍ତ୍ୱ ଅନୁଯାୟୀ, କେଉଁ ପ୍ରତିନିଧିତ୍ୱ ରୂପ (mode of representation) ରେ ଶିକ୍ଷାର୍ଥୀମାନେ ପ୍ରତ୍ୟକ୍ଷ ଶାରୀରିକ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟ ଏବଂ ମୋଟର ପ୍ରତିକ୍ରିୟା ମାଧ୍ୟମରେ ବସ୍ତୁ ଏବଂ ଘଟଣାଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ପ୍ରଦର୍ଶିତ କରିଥାନ୍ତି?
or.explanation: ଜେରୋମ୍ ବ୍ରୁନର୍ ଜ୍ଞାନାତ୍ମକ ପ୍ରତିନିଧିତ୍ୱର ତିନୋଟି ପର୍ଯ୍ୟାୟ ପ୍ରସ୍ତାବ କରିଛନ୍ତି: ଏନାକ୍ଟିଭ୍ (କାର୍ଯ୍ୟ-ଆଧାରିତ, ଶାରୀରିକ ଗତିବିଧି ମାଧ୍ୟମରେ ଶିଖିବା), ଆଇକନିକ୍ (ଚିତ୍ର-ଆଧାରିତ, ଦୃଶ୍ୟମାନ ପ୍ରତିବିମ୍ବ ମାଧ୍ୟମରେ ଶିଖିବା), ଏବଂ ସିମ୍ବୋଲିକ୍ (ଭାଷା-ଆଧାରିତ, ବିମୂର୍ତ୍ତ ସଙ୍କେତ ମାଧ୍ୟମରେ ଶିଖିବା)।

questions.question: In Lorin Anderson and David Krathwohl's revised version of Bloom's Taxonomy (2001), which level represents the highest order of the cognitive domain?
questions.explanation: In the 2001 revised version of Bloom's Taxonomy by Anderson and Krathwohl, the highest cognitive level was changed from 'Evaluation' to 'Creating' (putting elements together to form a coherent or functional whole).

or.question: ଲୋରିନ୍ ଆଣ୍ଡରସନ୍ ଏବଂ ଡେଭିଡ୍ କ୍ରାଥୱୋଲଙ୍କ ଦ୍ୱାରା ସଂଶୋଧିତ ବ୍ଲୁମ୍‌ଙ୍କ ଟ୍ୟାକ୍ସୋନୋମି (୨୦୦୧) ରେ, କେଉଁ ସ୍ତରଟି ଜ୍ଞାନାତ୍ମକ କ୍ଷେତ୍ରର (Cognitive Domain) ସର୍ବୋଚ୍ଚ ସ୍ତରକୁ ପ୍ରତିନିଧିତ୍ୱ କରେ?
or.explanation: ଆଣ୍ଡରସନ୍ ଏବଂ କ୍ରାଥୱୋଲଙ୍କ ସଂଶୋଧିତ ବ୍ଲୁମ୍‌ଙ୍କ ଟ୍ୟାକ୍ସୋନୋମି (୨୦୦୧) ରେ 'ସୃଜନ' (Creating) ହେଉଛି ଜ୍ଞାନାତ୍ମକ କ୍ଷେତ୍ରର ସର୍ବୋଚ୍ଚ ସ୍ତର, ଯାହା ମୂଲ୍ୟାଙ୍କନ (Evaluating) ସ୍ତରର ଉପରେ ସ୍ଥାନିତ।

questions.question: In Flanders' Interaction Analysis Categories System (FIACS), which specific category corresponds to indirect teacher talk that involves 'accepting or using ideas of pupils'?
questions.explanation: In FIACS, Category 3 represents 'Accepts or uses ideas of pupils' under Indirect Teacher Talk. Category 1 is 'Accepts feeling', Category 2 is 'Praises or encourages', and Category 4 is 'Asks questions'.

or.question: ଫ୍ଲାଣ୍ଡର୍ସଙ୍କ ଇଣ୍ଟରଆକ୍ସନ୍ ଆନାଲିସିସ୍ କ୍ୟାଟେଗୋରୀ ସିଷ୍ଟମ୍ (FIACS) ରେ, କେଉଁ ବର୍ଗଟି ଛାତ୍ରମାନଙ୍କ ଚିନ୍ତାଧାରାକୁ ଗ୍ରହଣ କରିବା କିମ୍ବା ବ୍ୟବହାର କରିବା ସହ ଜଡ଼ିତ ପରୋକ୍ଷ ଶିକ୍ଷକ କଥୋପକଥନକୁ ଦର୍ଶାଏ?
or.explanation: FIACS ରେ, ବର୍ଗ ୩ (Category 3) 'ଛାତ୍ରମାନଙ୍କ ଚିନ୍ତାଧାରା ଗ୍ରହଣ କିମ୍ବା ବ୍ୟବହାର କରିବା' କୁ ପ୍ରତିନିଧିତ୍ୱ କରେ, ଯାହା ପରୋକ୍ଷ ଶିକ୍ଷକ କଥୋପକଥନ (Indirect Teacher Talk) ର ଅଂଶ ଅଟେ।

questions.question: For a first-order reaction, the time required for 99.9% completion is approximately how many times the half-life period (t_{1/2}) of the reaction?
questions.explanation: For a first-order reaction, t_{99.9%} = (2.303 / k) * log(100 / (100 - 99.9)) = (2.303 * 3) / k = 6.909 / k. Since the half-life period t_{1/2} = 0.693 / k, the ratio t_{99.9%} / t_{1/2} = 6.909 / 0.693 ≈ 10. Thus, the time required for 99.9% completion is approximately 10 times the half-life.

or.question: ଏକ ପ୍ରଥମ-କ୍ରମ ପ୍ରତିକ୍ରିୟା (first-order reaction) ପାଇଁ, 99.9% ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ହେବାକୁ ଲାଗୁଥିବା ସମୟ ଏହାର ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ-ଜୀବନ କାଳ (t_{1/2}) ର ପ୍ରାୟ କେତେ ଗୁଣ?

questions.question: For a particle of mass m confined in a one-dimensional box of length L, what is the probability of finding the particle in the region 0 <= x <= L/4 in its ground state (n = 1)?
questions.explanation: The normalized ground state wave function is ψ_1(x) = sqrt(2/L) * sin(π*x / L). The probability P = ∫_0^(L/4) |ψ_1(x)|^2 dx = (2/L) ∫_0^(L/4) sin^2(π*x / L) dx = (1/L) ∫_0^(L/4) (1 - cos(2*π*x / L)) dx = (1/L) [ x - (L / (2*π)) * sin(2*π*x / L) ]_0^(L/4) = (1/L) [ L/4 - (L / (2*π)) * sin(π/2) ] = 1/4 - 1/(2*π) = (π - 2) / (4*π).

or.question: L ଲମ୍ବର ଏକ-ବିମୀୟ ବାକ୍ସ (one-dimensional box) ରେ ଆବଦ୍ଧ m ଭରର ଏକ କଣିକା ପାଇଁ, ଏହାର ଭୂମି ସ୍ତର (n = 1) ରେ 0 <= x <= L/4 ଅନ୍ତରାଳରେ କଣିକାଟି ମିଳିବାର ସମ୍ଭାବ୍ୟତା (probability) କେତେ?

questions.question: Which stage of pre-linguistic speech development typically occurs around 6 months of age and is characterized by the repetition of consonant-vowel combinations such as "ba-ba" or "da-da"?
questions.explanation: Babbling typically emerges around 6 months of age and involves the rhythmic repetition of consonant-vowel syllables like "ba-ba" or "da-da". Cooing consists mainly of vowel sounds appearing around 6-8 weeks, while holophrastic and telegraphic speech occur later in linguistic development.

or.question: ପ୍ରାକ୍-ଭାଷାଗତ କଥନ ବିକାଶର କେଉଁ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟାୟ ସାଧାରଣତଃ ୬ ମାସ ବୟସ ପାଖାପାଖି ଦେଖାଯାଏ, ଯାହା "ବା-ବା" କିମ୍ବା "ଦା-ଦା" ଭଳି ବ୍ୟଞ୍ଜନ-ସ୍ୱରବର୍ଣ୍ଣର ସଂଯୋଜନାର ପୁନରାବୃତ୍ତି ଦ୍ୱାରା ଚିହ୍ନିତ ହୋଇଥାଏ?
or.explanation: ବ୍ୟାବ୍ଲିଙ୍ଗ୍ (Babbling) ସାଧାରଣତଃ ୬ ମାସ ବୟସରେ ଆରମ୍ଭ ହୋଇଥାଏ ଏବଂ ଏଥିରେ "ବା-ବା" କିମ୍ବା "ଦା-ଦା" ଭଳି ବ୍ୟଞ୍ଜନ-ସ୍ୱରବର୍ଣ୍ଣର ସଂଯୋଜନାର ପୁନରାବୃତ୍ତି ଅନ୍ତର୍ଭୁକ୍ତ।

questions.question: According to Robbie Case's neo-Piagetian theory of cognitive development, what is the primary mechanism responsible for increasing the functional capacity of the Short-Term Storage Space (STSS) as children mature?
options: Structural expansion of total processing space in the prefrontal cortex
Increased operational efficiency and automaticity, which frees up processing resources
Maturation of myelination that specifically increases the capacity of long-term memory
Gradual decline of assimilation mechanisms in favor of accommodation
questions.explanation: Robbie Case proposed that total processing space consists of operating space plus short-term storage space (STSS), and total space remains constant across development. As children gain experience and brain maturation occurs, operational efficiency and automaticity increase, requiring less operating space and thereby freeing up functional STSS capacity.

or.question: ରବି କେସ୍ (Robbie Case) ଙ୍କ ନବ-ପିଆଜେଟିଆନ୍ (neo-Piagetian) ଜ୍ଞାନାତ୍ମକ ବିକାଶ ସିଦ୍ଧାନ୍ତ ଅନୁଯାୟୀ, ଶିଶୁର ବିକାଶ ସହିତ ସ୍ୱଳ୍ପକାଳୀନ ସଂରକ୍ଷଣ ସ୍ଥାନ (STSS) ର କାର୍ଯ୍ୟକାରୀ କ୍ଷମତା ବୃଦ୍ଧି ପାଇଁ ମୁଖ୍ୟ କାରଣ କ’ଣ?
options: ପ୍ରିଫ୍ରଣ୍ଟାଲ୍ କୋର୍ଟେକ୍ସରେ ମୋଟ ପ୍ରକ୍ରିୟାକରଣ ସ୍ଥାନର ଗଠନମୂଳକ ସମ୍ପ୍ରସାରଣ
କାର୍ଯ୍ୟକାରୀ ଦକ୍ଷତା ଏବଂ ସ୍ୱୟଂକ୍ରିୟତାର ବୃଦ୍ଧି, ଯାହା ପ୍ରକ୍ରିୟାକରଣ ସମ୍ବଳକୁ ମୁକ୍ତ କରିଥାଏ
ମାଇଲିନେସନ୍‌ର ପରିପକ୍ୱତା ଯାହା ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦିଷ୍ଟ ଭାବରେ ଦୀର୍ଘକାଳୀନ ସ୍ମୃତିର ଆକାର ବୃଦ୍ଧି କରିଥାଏ
ଆତ୍ମସାତ୍କରଣ ପ୍ରକ୍ରିୟାର କ୍ରମାଗତ ହ୍ରାସ ଏବଂ ସମାୟୋଜନର ବୃଦ୍ଧି
or.explanation: ରବି କେସ୍‌ଙ୍କ ସିଦ୍ଧାନ୍ତ ଅନୁଯାୟୀ, ମୋଟ ପ୍ରକ୍ରିୟାକରଣ ସ୍ଥାନ ସ୍ଥିର ରହିଥାଏ। ଅଭ୍ୟାସ ଏବଂ ପରିପକ୍ୱତା ସହିତ ମାନସିକ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟଗୁଡ଼ିକ ଅଧିକ ଦକ୍ଷ ଏବଂ ସ୍ୱୟଂକ୍ରିୟ ହୋଇଯାଏ, ଯାହା ଦ୍ୱାରା କାର୍ଯ୍ୟକାରୀ ସ୍ଥାନର ଆବଶ୍ୟକତା କମିଯାଏ ଏବଂ ସ୍ୱଳ୍ପକାଳୀନ ସଂରକ୍ଷଣ ସ୍ଥାନ (STSS) ର କ୍ଷମତା ବୃଦ୍ଧି ପାଏ।

questions.question: Which Article of the Constitution of India provides for the creation of All India Services common to both the Union and the States?
questions.explanation: Article 312 of the Constitution of India empowers the Parliament to create All India Services common to both the Union and the States, if the Rajya Sabha passes a resolution supported by not less than two-thirds of the members present and voting.

or.question: ଭାରତୀୟ ସମ୍ବିଧାନର କେଉଁ ଅନୁଚ୍ଛେଦ କେନ୍ଦ୍ର ଏବଂ ରାଜ୍ୟଗୁଡ଼ିକ ପାଇଁ ସାଧାରଣ ସର୍ବଭାରତୀୟ ସେବା (All India Services) ସୃଷ୍ଟି ପାଇଁ ବ୍ୟବସ୍ଥା କରେ?
or.explanation: ଭାରତୀୟ ସମ୍ବିଧାନର ଅନୁଚ୍ଛେଦ ୩୧୨ ଅନୁଯାୟୀ, ଯଦି ରାଜ୍ୟସଭା ଉପସ୍ଥିତ ଏବଂ ମତଦାନ କରୁଥିବା ସଦସ୍ୟଙ୍କ ଅତି କମରେ ଦୁଇ-ତୃତୀୟାଂଶ ବହୁମତରେ ଏକ ପ୍ରସ୍ତାବ ପାରିତ କରେ, ତେବେ ସଂସଦ ଆଇନ ଦ୍ୱାରା ନୂତନ ସର୍ବଭାରତୀୟ ସେବା ସୃଷ୍ଟି କରିପାରିବ।

questions.question: Who among the following founded the 'Satya Shodhak Samaj' in Maharashtra in the year 1873?
questions.explanation: Jyotirao Phule founded the Satya Shodhak Samaj (Truth-seekers' Society) in Pune, Maharashtra, in 1873 to propagate social equality and promote education and social rights for the underprivileged sections of society.
