or.question: ୧୮୭୩ ମସିହାରେ ମହାରାଷ୍ଟ୍ରରେ 'ସତ୍ୟଶୋଧକ ସମାଜ' ନିମ୍ନଲିଖିତ ମାନଙ୍କ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ କିଏ ପ୍ରତିଷ୍ଠା କରିଥିଲେ?
or.explanation: ଜ୍ୟୋତିରାଓ ଫୁଲେ ୧୮୭୩ ମସିହାରେ ମହାରାଷ୍ଟ୍ରର ପୁଣେଠାରେ ସତ୍ୟଶୋଧକ ସମାଜ ପ୍ରତିଷ୍ଠା କରିଥିଲେ। ଏହାର ମୁଖ୍ୟ ଉଦ୍ଦେଶ୍ୟ ଥିଲା ସାମାଜିକ ସମାନତା ପ୍ରଚାର କରିବା ଏବଂ ଅବହେଳିତ ବର୍ଗଙ୍କ ଶିକ୍ଷା ଓ ଅଧିକାର ପାଇଁ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟ କରିବା।

questions.question: Which type of evaluation is conducted continuously during the instructional process to monitor student learning and provide ongoing feedback?
questions.explanation: Formative evaluation takes place during the teaching-learning process. Its primary goal is to monitor student learning and provide continuous feedback that can be used by instructors to improve their teaching and by students to improve their learning.

or.question: ଶିକ୍ଷାଦାନ ପ୍ରକ୍ରିୟା ସମୟରେ ଛାତ୍ରଛାତ୍ରୀଙ୍କ ଶିଖିବା ପ୍ରକ୍ରିୟାକୁ ନିରୀକ୍ଷଣ କରିବା ଏବଂ ନିରନ୍ତର ପ୍ରତିପୋଷଣ (feedback) ପ୍ରଦାନ କରିବା ପାଇଁ କେଉଁ ପ୍ରକାରର ମୂଲ୍ୟାଙ୍କନ କରାଯାଏ?
or.explanation: ଗଠନମୂଳକ ମୂଲ୍ୟାଙ୍କନ (Formative Evaluation) ଶିକ୍ଷଣ ପଦ୍ଧତି ଚାଲୁଥିବା ସମୟରେ ନିରନ୍ତର ଭାବରେ କରାଯାଏ, ଯାହା ଦ୍ୱାରା ଶିକ୍ଷାର୍ଥୀଙ୍କ ଦୁର୍ବଳତା ସୁଧାରିବା ପାଇଁ ଶିକ୍ଷକ ଏବଂ ଛାତ୍ର ଉଭୟଙ୍କୁ ନିୟମିତ ପ୍ରତିପୋଷଣ ମିଳିଥାଏ।

questions.question: According to Robert Gagné's Conditions of Learning, which type of learning occupies the highest level (8th level) in his hierarchy of learning types?
questions.explanation: Robert Gagné proposed an eight-level hierarchy of learning types. From lowest to highest, they are: 1. Signal learning, 2. Stimulus-response learning, 3. Chaining, 4. Verbal association, 5. Multiple discrimination, 6. Concept learning, 7. Rule learning, and 8. Problem solving ( highest level).

or.question: ରବର୍ଟ ଗାଗ୍ନେ (Robert Gagné)ଙ୍କ 'ସର୍ତ୍ତମୂଳକ ଶିକ୍ଷଣ ସିଦ୍ଧାନ୍ତ' (Conditions of Learning) ଅନୁସାରେ, ତାଙ୍କର ଆଠ-ସ୍ତରୀୟ ଶିକ୍ଷଣ କ୍ରମରେ କେଉଁ ସ୍ତରଟି ସବୁଠାରୁ ଉଚ୍ଚ ସ୍ତର (୮ମ ସ୍ତର)ରେ ଅବସ୍ଥିତ?
or.explanation: ଗାଗ୍ନେଙ୍କ ଶିକ୍ଷଣ ଶ୍ରେଣୀବିଭାଗରେ ଆଠଟି ସ୍ତର ରହିଛି। ଏଥିରେ 'ସମସ୍ୟା ସମାଧାନ ଶିକ୍ଷଣ' (Problem Solving) ହେଉଛି ୮ମ ତଥା ସବୁଠାରୁ ଉଚ୍ଚ ସ୍ତରର ଶିକ୍ଷଣ, ଯାହା ପୂର୍ବରୁ ଶିଖିଥିବା ନିୟମଗୁଡ଼ିକର ପ୍ରୟୋଗ ଉପରେ ଆଧାରିତ।

questions.question: In the fluorite crystal structure (CaF2), what are the coordination numbers of Ca2+ and F- ions, respectively?
questions.explanation: In the fluorite (CaF2) structure, Ca2+ ions form a face-centered cubic (fcc) lattice while F- ions occupy all 8 tetrahedral voids. Consequently, each Ca2+ ion is surrounded by 8 F- ions, and each F- ion is surrounded by 4 Ca2+ ions, giving coordination numbers of 8 and 4, respectively.

or.question: ଫ୍ଲୋରାଇଟ୍ ସଫାଟିକ ସଂରଚନାରେ (CaF2), Ca2+ ଏବଂ F- ଆୟନଗୁଡ଼ିକର ସଂଯୋଜକ ସଂଖ୍ୟା (coordination numbers) ଯଥାକ୍ରମେ କେତେ?
or.explanation: ଫ୍ଲୋରାଇଟ୍ ସଂରଚନାରେ (CaF2), Ca2+ ଆୟନଗୁଡ଼ିକ fcc ଜାଲକ ଗଠନ କରନ୍ତି ଏବଂ F- ଆୟନଗୁଡ଼ିକ ସମସ୍ତ 8ଟି ଚତୁଷ୍କୋଣୀୟ ରିକ୍ତ ସ୍ଥାନ (tetrahedral voids) ଦଖଲ କରନ୍ତି। ଫଳରେ, ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ Ca2+ ଆୟନ 8ଟି F- ଆୟନ ଦ୍ୱାରା ଏବଂ ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ F- ଆୟନ 4ଟି Ca2+ ଆୟନ ଦ୍ୱାରା ଘେରି ରହିଥାଏ। ତେଣୁ ସଂଯୋଜକ ସଂଖ୍ୟା ଯଥାକ୍ରମେ 8 ଏବଂ 4 ଅଟେ।

questions.question: For the H2+ molecule ion, using the Linear Combination of Atomic Orbitals (LCAO) approximation with normalized 1s atomic wavefunctions ϕA and ϕB, what is the normalization constant N+ for the bonding molecular orbital ψ+ = N+(ϕA + ϕB), where S = <ϕA|ϕB> is the overlap integral?
questions.explanation: The normalization condition requires <ψ+|ψ+> = 1. Expanding N+^2 <ϕA + ϕB|ϕA + ϕB> = 1 gives N+^2 [<ϕA|ϕA> + <ϕB|ϕB> + 2<ϕA|ϕB>] = 1. Since ϕA and ϕB are normalized (<ϕA|ϕA> = <ϕB|ϕB> = 1) and <ϕA|ϕB> = S, this simplifies to N+^2 (2 + 2S) = 1, leading to N+ = 1 / sqrt(2(1 + S)).

or.question: H2+ ଆଣବିକ ଆୟନ ପାଇଁ, ନର୍ମାଲାଇଜ୍‌ଡ୍ 1s ପାରମାଣବିକ ତରଙ୍ଗ ଫଳନ ϕA ଏବଂ ϕB ସହିତ ଆଣବିକ କକ୍ଷକଗୁଡ଼ିକର ରୈଖିକ ସଂଯୋଜନ (LCAO) ଆନୁମାନିକତା ବ୍ୟବହାର କରି, ବନ୍ଧନକାରୀ ଆଣବିକ କକ୍ଷକ ψ+ = N+(ϕA + ϕB) ର ନର୍ମାଲାଇଜେସନ୍ ସ୍ଥିରାଙ୍କ N+ ର ସୂତ୍ର କ'ଣ, ଯେଉଁଠାରେ S = <ϕA|ϕB> ହେଉଛି ଓଭରଲ୍ୟାପ୍ ଇଣ୍ଟେଗ୍ରାଲ୍?
or.explanation: ବନ୍ଧନକାରୀ ଆଣବିକ କକ୍ଷକ ψ+ = N+(ϕA + ϕB) ର ନର୍ମାଲାଇଜେସନ୍ ସର୍ତ୍ତ ହେଉଛି <ψ+|ψ+> = 1। ଏହାକୁ ବିସ୍ତାର କଲେ N+^2 [<ϕA|ϕA> + <ϕB|ϕB> + 2<ϕA|ϕB>] = 1 ମିଳେ। ଯେହେତୁ ϕA ଏବଂ ϕB ନର୍ମାଲାଇଜ୍‌ଡ୍ (<ϕA|ϕA> = <ϕB|ϕB> = 1) ଏବଂ <ϕA|ϕB> = S, ଏହା N+^2 (2 + 2S) = 1 ରେ ପରିଣତ ହୁଏ, ଯାହାଦ୍ୱାରା N+ = 1 / sqrt(2(1 + S)) ମିଳିଥାଏ।

questions.question: According to Lev Vygotsky's socio-cultural theory, what primary function does 'private speech' (self-talk) serve in young children?
options: It reflects cognitive immaturity and egocentrism, as proposed by Jean Piaget.
It serves as an important tool for self-regulation, helping children guide their own thinking and behavior.
It indicates a developmental delay in social communication skills.
It acts as a mechanism solely designed to seek adult assistance during problem-solving.
questions.explanation: Lev Vygotsky argued that private speech is a critical developmental bridge between external social communication and internal thought. Children use private speech to regulate their own cognitive processes, plan strategies, and guide their behavior during complex tasks.

or.question: ଲେଭ୍ ଭାଇଗୋଟ୍ସ୍କିଙ୍କ (Lev Vygotsky) ସାମାଜିକ-ସାଂସ୍କୃତିକ ସିଦ୍ଧାନ୍ତ ଅନୁଯାୟୀ, ଛୋଟ ପିଲାମାନଙ୍କ ମଧ୍ୟରେ 'ବ୍ୟକ୍ତିଗତ କଥୋପକଥନ' (private speech / ସ୍ୱ-ଆଲୋଚନା) ର ମୁଖ୍ୟ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟ କ’ଣ?
options: ଜାଁ ପିଆଜେଙ୍କ ଦ୍ୱାରା ପ୍ରସ୍ତାବିତ ହୋଇଥିବା ଭଳି ଏହା ଜ୍ଞାନାତ୍ମକ ଅପରିପକ୍ୱତା ଏବଂ ଆତ୍ମକେନ୍ଦ୍ରିକତାକୁ ଦର୍ଶାଏ |
ଏହା ଆତ୍ମ-ନିୟନ୍ତ୍ରଣ ପାଇଁ ଏକ ଗୁରୁତ୍ୱପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ସାଧନ ଭାବରେ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟ କରେ, ଯାହା ପିଲାମାନଙ୍କୁ ସେମାନଙ୍କର ନିଜସ୍ୱ ଚିନ୍ତନ ଏବଂ ବ୍ୟବହାରକୁ ମାର୍ଗଦର୍ଶନ କରିବାରେ ସାହାଯ୍ୟ କରେ |
ଏହା ସାମାଜିକ ଯୋଗାଯୋଗ ଦକ୍ଷତାରେ ବିକାଶମୂଳକ ବିଳମ୍ବକୁ ସୂଚିତ କରେ |
ଏହା କେବଳ ସମସ୍ୟା ସମାଧାନ ସମୟରେ ବୟସ୍କଙ୍କ ସହାୟତା ଲୋଡ଼ିବା ପାଇଁ ଏକ ମାଧ୍ୟମ ଭାବରେ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟ କରେ |
or.explanation: ଲେଭ୍ ଭାଇଗୋଟ୍ସ୍କିଙ୍କ ମତରେ ବ୍ୟକ୍ତିଗତ କଥୋପକଥନ (private speech) ସାମାଜିକ ଯୋଗାଯୋଗ ଏବଂ ଆଭ୍ୟନ୍ତରୀଣ ଚିନ୍ତନ ମଧ୍ୟରେ ଏକ ଗୁରୁତ୍ୱପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ସେତୁ ଅଟେ | ପିଲାମାନେ ନିଜର ବ୍ୟବହାରକୁ ନିୟନ୍ତ୍ରଣ କରିବା, ଯୋଜନା ପ୍ରସ୍ତୁତ କରିବା ଏବଂ ଚିନ୍ତାଧାରାକୁ ମାର୍ଗଦର୍ଶନ କରିବା ପାଇଁ ଏହି ସ୍ୱ-ଆଲୋଚନାର ବ୍ୟବହାର କରନ୍ତି |

questions.question: According to Charles Brainerd and Valerie Reyna's Fuzzy-Trace Theory, how does memory processing shift from early childhood to adolescence?
options: Younger children rely predominantly on gist traces, while adolescents rely almost exclusively on verbatim traces.
Younger children rely more on verbatim traces, whereas older children and adolescents increasingly rely on fuzzy gist traces.
Both verbatim and gist traces develop simultaneously in early infancy and remain unchanged throughout development.
Verbatim traces replace gist traces entirely as working memory capacity expands during adolescence.
questions.explanation: Fuzzy-Trace Theory posits two types of memory representations: verbatim traces (precise, exact literal details) and gist traces (fuzzy, essential semantic meanings). As children mature, there is a developmental shift from relying primarily on verbatim traces toward a greater reliance on gist traces, which are more efficient for reasoning and less susceptible to forgetting.

or.question: ଚାର୍ଲ୍ସ ବ୍ରେନର୍ଡ ଏବଂ ଭାଲେରୀ ରେନାଙ୍କ (Brainerd and Reyna) 'ଫଜି-ଟ୍ରେସ୍ ସିଦ୍ଧାନ୍ତ' (Fuzzy-Trace Theory) ଅନୁଯାୟୀ, ପ୍ରାରମ୍ଭିକ ଶୈଶବରୁ କିଶୋରାବସ୍ଥା ମଧ୍ୟରେ ସ୍ମୃତି ପ୍ରକ୍ରିୟାକରଣ କିପରି ପରିବର୍ତ୍ତିତ ହୋଇଥାଏ?
options: ଛୋଟ ପିଲାମାନେ ମୁଖ୍ୟତଃ ଗିଷ୍ଟ (gist) ଟ୍ରେସ୍ ଉପରେ ନିର୍ଭର କରନ୍ତି, ଯେଉଁଠାରେ କିଶୋରମାନେ କେବଳ ଭର୍ବାଟିମ୍ (verbatim) ଟ୍ରେସ୍ ଉପରେ ନିର୍ଭର କରନ୍ତି |
ଛୋଟ ପିଲାମାନେ ଅଧିକ ଭର୍ବାଟିମ୍ (verbatim) ଟ୍ରେସ୍ ଉପରେ ନିର୍ଭର କରନ୍ତି, ଯେଉଁଠାରେ ବୟସ୍କ ପିଲା ଏବଂ କିଶୋରମାନେ ସ୍ମୃତି ପ୍ରକ୍ରିୟାକରଣ ପାଇଁ ଅଧିକରୁ ଅଧିକ ଫଜି ଗିଷ୍ଟ (gist) ଟ୍ରେସ୍ ଉପରେ ନିର୍ଭର କରନ୍ତି |
ଭର୍ବାଟିମ୍ ଏବଂ ଗିଷ୍ଟ ଉଭୟ ଟ୍ରେସ୍ ପ୍ରାରମ୍ଭିକ ଶୈଶବରେ ଏକ ସମୟରେ ବିକଶିତ ହୁଏ ଏବଂ ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ବିକାଶ ସମୟରେ ଅପରିବର୍ତ୍ତିତ ରହେ |
କିଶୋରାବସ୍ଥାରେ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟକାରୀ ସ୍ମୃତି କ୍ଷମତା ବୃଦ୍ଧି ପାଇବା ସହିତ ଭର୍ବାଟିମ୍ ଟ୍ରେସ୍ ଗୁଡ଼ିକ ଗିଷ୍ଟ ଟ୍ରେସକୁ ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଭାବରେ ପ୍ରତିସ୍ଥାପିତ କରନ୍ତି |
or.explanation: ଫଜି-ଟ୍ରେସ୍ ସିଦ୍ଧାନ୍ତ ଦୁଇ ପ୍ରକାରର ସ୍ମୃତି ପ୍ରତିନିଧିତ୍ୱର ପ୍ରସ୍ତାବ ଦିଏ: ଭର୍ବାଟିମ୍ ଟ୍ରେସ୍ (ବିସ୍ତୃତ, ସଠିକ୍ ତଥ୍ୟ) ଏବଂ ଗିଷ୍ଟ ଟ୍ରେସ୍ (ମୂଳ, ଅସଲି ସାମାନ୍ୟ ଅର୍ଥ) | ପିଲାମାନଙ୍କ ବିକାଶ ସହିତ, ସେମାନେ ଭର୍ବାଟିମ୍ ଟ୍ରେସ୍ ଉପରେ ନିର୍ଭରଶୀଳତା କମାଇ ଗିଷ୍ଟ ଟ୍ରେସ୍ ଉପରେ ଅଧିକ ନିର୍ଭରଶୀଳ ହୁଅନ୍ତି, ଯାହା ଯୁକ୍ତିଯୁକ୍ତ ଚିନ୍ତନ ପାଇଁ ଅଧିକ ଦକ୍ଷ ଏବଂ ସମୟ ସହିତ ଭୁଲିଯିବାର ସମ୍ଭାବନା କମ୍ ଥାଏ |

questions.question: Which schedule of the Constitution of India contains provisions regarding the administration and control of Scheduled Areas and Scheduled Tribes in states other than Assam, Meghalaya, Tripura, and Mizoram?
questions.explanation: The Fifth Schedule of the Constitution of India deals with the administration and control of Scheduled Areas and Scheduled Tribes in all states except Assam, Meghalaya, Tripura, and Mizoram, which are governed under the Sixth Schedule.

or.question: ଭାରତୀୟ ସମ୍ବିଧାନର କେଉଁ ଅନୁସୂଚୀରେ ଆସାମ, ମେଘାଳୟ, ତ୍ରିପୁରା ଏବଂ ମିଜୋରାମ ବ୍ୟତୀତ ଅନ୍ୟ ରାଜ୍ୟଗୁଡ଼ିକରେ ଥିବା ଅନୁସୂଚିତ ଏରିଆ ଏବଂ ଅନୁସୂଚିତ ଜନଜାତିଙ୍କ ପ୍ରଶାସନ ଓ ନିୟନ୍ତ୍ରଣ ସମ୍ବନ୍ଧୀୟ ବ୍ୟବସ୍ଥା ରହିଛି?
or.explanation: ଭାରତୀୟ ସମ୍ବିଧାନର ପଞ୍ଚମ ଅନୁସୂଚୀରେ ଆସାମ, ମେଘାଳୟ, ତ୍ରିପୁରା ଏବଂ ମିଜୋରାମ ବ୍ୟତୀତ ଅନ୍ୟ ରାଜ୍ୟଗୁଡ଼ିକରେ ଅନୁସୂଚିତ ଏରିଆ ଏବଂ ଅନୁସୂଚିତ ଜନଜାତିଙ୍କ ପ୍ରଶାସନ ଏବଂ ନିୟନ୍ତ୍ରଣ ସମ୍ବନ୍ଧରେ ଆଲୋଚନା କରାଯାଇଛି।

questions.question: Who among the following founded the 'Anushilan Samiti' in Calcutta in 1902 as a revolutionary secret society?
questions.explanation: The Anushilan Samiti was established in Calcutta in March 1902 primarily by Pramathanath Mitra (P. Mitra), along with Jatindranath Banerjee, Barindra Kumar Ghosh, and Satish Chandra Basu. Pramathanath Mitra served as its first president.

or.question: ୧୯୦୨ ମସିହାରେ କୋଲକାତାରେ ଏକ ବିପ୍ଳବୀ ଗୁପ୍ତ ସଂଗଠନ ଭାବରେ 'ଅନୁଶୀଳନ ସମିତି' କିଏ ପ୍ରତିଷ୍ଠା କରିଥିଲେ?
or.explanation: ମାର୍ଚ୍ଚ ୧୯୦୨ରେ କୋଲକାତାରେ ପ୍ରମଥନାଥ ମିତ୍ର (ପି. ମିତ୍ର) ଜତୀନ୍ଦ୍ରନାଥ ବାନାର୍ଜୀ, ବାରୀନ୍ଦ୍ର କୁମାର ଘୋଷ ଏବଂ ସତୀଶ ଚନ୍ଦ୍ର ବସୁଙ୍କ ସହିତ 'ଅନୁଶୀଳନ ସମିତି' ପ୍ରତିଷ୍ଠା କରିଥିଲେ। ପ୍ରମଥନାଥ ମିତ୍ର ଏହାର ପ୍ରଥମ ସଭାପତି ଥିଲେ।

questions.question: According to Jean Piaget's theory of cognitive development, during which stage does a child typically develop the concept of 'Object Permanence'?
questions.explanation: Object permanence is the understanding that objects continue to exist even when they cannot be observed. According to Jean Piaget, children develop this understanding during the Sensorimotor Stage (birth to approximately 2 years of age).

or.question: ଜାଁ ପିଆଜେଙ୍କ ଜ୍ଞାନାତ୍ମକ ବିକାଶ ସିଦ୍ଧାନ୍ତ ଅନୁସାରେ, କେଉଁ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟାୟରେ ଶିଶୁ ସାଧାରଣତଃ 'ବସ୍ତୁ ସ୍ଥାୟିତ୍ୱ' (Object Permanence) ର ଧାରଣା ବିକଶିତ କରିଥାଏ?
or.explanation: ବସ୍ତୁ ସ୍ଥାୟିତ୍ୱ (Object Permanence) ହେଉଛି ଏପରି ଏକ ବୁଝାମଣା ଯେଉଁଥିରେ ବସ୍ତୁ ଦୃଶ୍ୟମାନ ନ ହେଲେ ମଧ୍ୟ ତାହାର ଅସ୍ତିତ୍ୱ ଥାଏ। ପିଆଜେଙ୍କ ଅନୁସାରେ, ଶିଶୁମାନେ ସେନ୍ସୋରୀମୋଟର ପର୍ଯ୍ୟାୟ (ଜନ୍ମରୁ ପ୍ରାୟ ୨ ବର୍ଷ) ମଧ୍ୟରେ ଏହି ଧାରଣା ହାସଲ କରନ୍ତି।

questions.question: According to Edgar Dale's 'Cone of Experience', which of the following learning experiences provides the highest level of directness and retention?
options: Participating in a direct, purposeful hands-on experience
Viewing static visual symbols and diagrams
questions.explanation: Edgar Dale's Cone of Experience places 'Direct Purposeful Experiences' at the base of the cone, representing first-hand experiences that engage multiple senses and result in the highest rate of learning retention (around 90%).

or.question: ଏଡଗାର ଡେଲଙ୍କ 'କୋନ୍ ଅଫ୍ ଏକ୍ସପେରିଏନ୍ସ' (Cone of Experience) ଅନୁସାରେ, ନିମ୍ନଲିଖିତ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ କେଉଁ ଶିକ୍ଷଣ ଅନୁଭୂତି ସବୁଠାରୁ ଅଧିକ ପ୍ରତ୍ୟକ୍ଷତା ଏବଂ ମନେରଖିବା କ୍ଷମତା ପ୍ରଦାନ କରିଥାଏ?
options: ପ୍ରତ୍ୟକ୍ଷ, ଉଦ୍ଦେଶ୍ୟମୂଳକ ବାସ୍ତବ ଅନୁଭୂତିରେ ଅଂଶଗ୍ରହଣ କରିବା
ସ୍ଥିର ଦୃଶ୍ୟ ପ୍ରତୀକ ଏବଂ ଡାୟାଗ୍ରାମ୍ ଦେଖିବା
or.explanation: ଏଡଗାର ଡେଲଙ୍କ 'କୋନ୍ ଅଫ୍ ଏକ୍ସପେରିଏନ୍ସ' ର ଭିତ୍ତିଭୂମିରେ 'ପ୍ରତ୍ୟକ୍ଷ ଉଦ୍ଦେଶ୍ୟମୂଳକ ଅନୁଭୂତି' ରହିଥାଏ, ଯାହା ପ୍ରତ୍ୟକ୍ଷ ବାସ୍ତବ ଅନୁଭବ ପ୍ରଦାନ କରିବା ସହ ସବୁଠାରୁ ଅଧିକ (ପ୍ରାୟ ୯୦%) ମନେରଖିବାରେ ସାହାଯ୍ୟ କରେ।

questions.question: According to the Debye-Hückel-Onsager equation, how does the molar conductivity (\Lambda_m) of a strong electrolyte vary with its concentration (c)?
questions.explanation: The Debye-Hückel-Onsager equation relates the molar conductivity (\Lambda_m) of a strong electrolyte to its concentration (c) as \Lambda_m = \Lambda_m^\circ - A \sqrt{c}, where \Lambda_m^\circ$ is the limiting molar conductivity and A is a constant that depends on solvent properties and temperature.

or.question: ଡେବାଇ-ହକେଲ-ଓନସାଗର (Debye-Hückel-Onsager) ସମୀକରଣ ଅନୁସାରେ, ଏକ ସବଳ ଇଲେକ୍ଟ୍ରୋଲାଇଟର ମୋଲାର ପରିବାହିତା (\Lambda_m) ଏହାର ଗାଢ଼ତା (c) ସହିତ କିପରି ପରିବର୍ତ୍ତିତ ହୁଏ?
or.explanation: ସବଳ ଇଲେକ୍ଟ୍ରୋଲାଇଟ୍ ପାଇଁ ଡେବାଇ-ହକେଲ-ଓନସାଗର ସମୀକରଣ ହେଉଛି \Lambda_m = \Lambda_m^\circ - A \sqrt{c}, ଯେଉଁଠାରେ \Lambda_m^\circ ହେଉଛି ସୀମାନ୍ତ ମୋଲାର ପରିବାହିତା, c ହେଉଛି ଗାଢ଼ତା ଏବଂ A ହେଉଛି ଦ୍ରାବକର ଗୁଣ ଏବଂ ତାପମାତ୍ରା ଉପରେ ନିର୍ଭର କରୁଥିବା ଏକ ସ୍ଥିରାଙ୍କ।

questions.question: What is the primary product formed when ferrocene reacts with acetyl chloride in a 1:1 molar ratio in the presence of anhydrous aluminium chloride (AlCl3)?
questions.explanation: When ferrocene undergoes Friedel-Crafts acylation with acetyl chloride and anhydrous AlCl3 in a 1:1 molar ratio, electrophilic aromatic substitution occurs on one cyclopentadienyl ring to yield acetylferrocene (monoacetylferrocene) as the major product.

or.question: ଅନାର୍ଦ୍ର ଆଲୁମିନିୟମ କ୍ଲୋରାଇଡ (AlCl3) ର ଉପସ୍ଥିତିରେ ଫେରୋସିନ୍ 1:1 ମୋଲାର ଅନୁପାତରେ ଏସେଟିଲ କ୍ଲୋରାଇଡ ସହିତ ପ୍ରତିକ୍ରିୟା କଲେ ମୁଖ୍ୟତଃ କେଉଁ ଉତ୍ପାଦ ଗଠିତ ହୁଏ?
or.explanation: ଯେତେବେଳେ ଫେରୋସିନ୍‌କୁ 1:1 ମୋଲାର ଅନୁପାତରେ ଏସେଟିଲ କ୍ଲୋରାଇଡ୍ ଏବଂ ଅନାର୍ଦ୍ର AlCl3 ସହିତ ଫ୍ରାଇଡେଲ-କ୍ରାଫ୍ଟସ ଏସିଲେସନ୍ କରାଯାଏ, ଏହା ଇଲେକ୍ଟ୍ରୋଫିଲିକ୍ ଆରୋମାଟିକ୍ ପ୍ରତିସ୍ଥାପନ ପ୍ରକ୍ରିୟା ଦେଇ ଗତି କରି ମୁଖ୍ୟ ଉତ୍ପାଦ ଭାବରେ ଏସେଟିଲଫେରୋସିନ୍ (ମୋନୋଏସେଟିଲଫେରୋସିନ୍) ପ୍ରଦାନ କରେ।

questions.question: According to Noam Chomsky's theory of language acquisition, what innate biological mechanism enables human children to naturally acquire language and comprehend its universal grammar?
questions.explanation: Noam Chomsky proposed that human children are born with a Language Acquisition Device (LAD), an innate biological capacity that allows them to effortlessly acquire language and extract grammatical rules from their environment.

or.question: ନୋଆମ୍ ଚୋମ୍ସ୍କିଙ୍କ (Noam Chomsky) ଭାଷା ଅଧିଗ୍ରହଣ ସିଦ୍ଧାନ୍ତ ଅନୁଯାୟୀ, କେଉଁ ସହଜାତ ଜୈବିକ ପ୍ରକ୍ରିୟା ମାନବ ଶିଶୁମାନଙ୍କୁ ସ୍ଵାଭାବିକ ଭାବରେ ଭାଷା ଶିଖିବା ଏବଂ ଏହାର ସାର୍ବଜନୀନ ବ୍ୟାକରଣ ବୁଝିବାରେ ସାହାଯ୍ୟ କରେ?
options: ସମୀପସ୍ଥ ବିକାଶର କ୍ଷେତ୍ର (Zone of Proximal Development)
or.explanation: ନୋଆମ୍ ଚୋମ୍ସ୍କି ପ୍ରସ୍ତାବ ଦେଇଥିଲେ ଯେ ମାନବ ଶିଶୁମାନେ 'ଲାଙ୍ଗୁଏଜ୍ ଏକ୍ୟୁଜିସନ୍ ଡିଭାଇସ୍' (LAD) ସହିତ ଜନ୍ମଗ୍ରହଣ କରନ୍ତି, ଯାହା ଏକ ସହଜାତ ଜୈବିକ ପ୍ରକ୍ରିୟା ଅଟେ ଏବଂ ଏହା ସେମାନଙ୍କୁ ସ୍ଵାଭାବିକ ଭାବରେ ଭାଷା ଶିଖିବାରେ ଏବଂ ବ୍ୟାକରଣଗତ ନିୟମଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ସହଜରେ ଗ୍ରହଣ କରିବାରେ ସାହାଯ୍ୟ କରେ।

questions.question: According to Sandra Scarr and Kathleen McCartney's theory of genotype-environment effects, which type of gene-environment correlation occurs when a child's inherited characteristics elicit specific environmental responses from caregivers and peers?
questions.explanation: Evocative (or reactive) genotype-environment correlation occurs when a child's genetically influenced characteristics (such as a cheerful temperament or high intelligence) evoke specific reactions and social responses from individuals in their environment.

or.question: ସାଣ୍ଡ୍ରା ସ୍କାର୍ (Sandra Scarr) ଏବଂ କ୍ୟାଥଲିନ୍ ମ୍ୟାକକାର୍ଟନିଙ୍କ (Kathleen McCartney) ଜେନୋଟାଇପ୍-ପରିବେଶ ସିଦ୍ଧାନ୍ତ ଅନୁଯାୟୀ, କେଉଁ ପ୍ରକାରର ଜିନ୍-ପରିବେଶ ସମ୍ବନ୍ଧ ସେତେବେଳେ ଘଟିଥାଏ ଯେତେବେଳେ ଜଣେ ଶିଶୁର ଆନୁବଂଶିକ ଲକ୍ଷଣ ପିତାମାତା, ଶିକ୍ଷକ କିମ୍ବା ସାଥୀମାନଙ୍କଠାରୁ ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦିଷ୍ଟ ପ୍ରତିକ୍ରିୟା ସୃଷ୍ଟି କରିଥାଏ?
or.explanation: ଇଭୋକେଟିଭ୍ (Evocative) ଜେନୋଟାଇପ୍-ପରିବେଶ ସମ୍ବନ୍ଧ ସେତେବେଳେ ଘଟିଥାଏ ଯେତେବେଳେ ଜଣେ ଶିଶୁର ଆନୁବଂଶିକ ଲକ୍ଷଣ (ଯେପରିକି ହସଖୁସି ସ୍ଵଭାବ କିମ୍ବା ଉଚ୍ଚ ବୁଦ୍ଧିମତ୍ତା) ପରିବେଶର ଅନ୍ୟ ବ୍ୟକ୍ତିମାନଙ୍କଠାରୁ ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦିଷ୍ଟ ପ୍ରତିକ୍ରିୟା ଏବଂ ସାମାଜିକ ସହଯୋଗ ଆକର୍ଷିତ କରିଥାଏ।

questions.question: An Epidiascope is a teaching aid used in classrooms primarily for which of the following purposes?
options: Projecting both opaque objects and transparent slides/images onto a screen
Displaying moving 3D digital animations with synchronized audio
Recording audio-visual responses of students during microteaching sessions
Measuring the auditory perception threshold of students with special needs
questions.explanation: An epidiascope is an optical device capable of projecting magnified images of both opaque materials (such as printed pages, diagrams, or physical specimens) and transparent slides or transparencies onto a screen.

or.question: ଏପିଡିଆସ୍କୋପ୍ (Epidiascope) ହେଉଛି ଶ୍ରେଣୀଗୃହରେ ବ୍ୟବହୃତ ଏକ ଶିକ୍ଷଣ ଉପକରଣ, ଯାହା ମୁଖ୍ୟତଃ ନିମ୍ନଲିଖିତ କେଉଁ ଉଦ୍ଦେଶ୍ୟ ପାଇଁ ବ୍ୟବହୃତ ହୁଏ?
options: ସ୍କ୍ରିନ୍‌ରେ ଅସ୍ୱଚ୍ଛ (opaque) ବସ୍ତୁ ଏବଂ ସ୍ୱଚ୍ଛ ସ୍ଲାଇଡ୍/ଛବି ଦୁଇଟିଯାକ ପ୍ରଦର୍ଶିତ (project) କରିବା ପାଇଁ
ସମକାଳୀନ ଅଡିଓ ସହିତ ଗତିଶୀଳ 3D ଡିଜିଟାଲ୍ ଆନିମେସନ୍ ପ୍ରଦର୍ଶନ କରିବା ପାଇଁ
ମାଇକ୍ରୋଟିଚିଂ ସମୟରେ ଛାତ୍ରମାନଙ୍କର ଦୃଶ୍ୟ-ଶ୍ରାବ୍ୟ ପ୍ରତିକ୍ରିୟା ରେକର୍ଡ କରିବା ପାଇଁ
ସ୍ୱତନ୍ତ୍ର ଆବଶ୍ୟକତା ଥିବା ଛାତ୍ରମାନଙ୍କର ଶ୍ରବଣ ଶକ୍ତି ମାପିବା ପାଇଁ
or.explanation: ଏପିଡିଆସ୍କୋପ୍ ହେଉଛି ଏକ ଅପ୍ଟିକାଲ୍ ଉପକରଣ, ଯାହା ସ୍କ୍ରିନ୍ ଉପରେ ଅସ୍ୱଚ୍ଛ ବସ୍ତୁ (ଯେପରିକି ବହିର ପୃଷ୍ଠା, ପ୍ରିଣ୍ଟ) ଏବଂ ସ୍ୱଚ୍ଛ ସ୍ଲାଇଡ୍ ଦୁଇଟିଯାକର ଛବି ପ୍ରଦର୍ଶନ (project) କରିବା ପାଇଁ ବ୍ୟବହୃତ ହୁଏ।

questions.question: In J.P. Guilford's Structure of Intellect (SI) model, human intelligence is categorized along three fundamental dimensions. Which option correctly identifies these three dimensions?
questions.explanation: J.P. Guilford's Structure of Intellect (SI) model organizes intellectual traits along three major dimensions: Operations (the mental processes performed), Contents (the broad areas of information/media), and Products (the forms in which information is processed by the discipline).

or.question: ଜେ.ପି. ଗିଲଫୋର୍ଡଙ୍କ (J.P. Guilford) ବୁଦ୍ଧିମତ୍ତାର ସଂରଚନା (Structure of Intellect - SI) ମଡେଲରେ, ବୌଦ୍ଧିକ ଗୁଣଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ତିନୋଟି ମୌଳିକ ଆୟାମ (dimensions) ଅଧୀନରେ ବର୍ଗୀକୃତ କରାଯାଇଛି। ଏହି ତିନୋଟି ଆୟାମ କ’ଣ?
or.explanation: ଜେ.ପି. ଗିଲଫୋର୍ଡ ବୁଦ୍ଧିମତ୍ତାର ସଂରଚନା (SI) ମଡେଲ୍ ପ୍ରସ୍ତାବ କରିଥିଲେ, ଯାହା ବୁଦ୍ଧିମତ୍ତାକୁ ତିନୋଟି ମୁଖ୍ୟ ଆୟାମରେ ବିଭକ୍ତ କରେ: ପ୍ରକ୍ରିୟା/ସଞ୍ଚାଳନ (Operations), ବିଷୟବସ୍ତୁ (Contents), ଏବଂ ଉତ୍ପାଦ (Products)।

questions.question: What is the half-life period (t_1/2) of a first-order reaction if its rate constant (k) is 6.93 x 10^-3 s^-1?
questions.explanation: For a first-order reaction, the half-life is calculated using the formula t_1/2 = 0.693 / k. Substituting k = 6.93 x 10^-3 s^-1 gives t_1/2 = 0.693 / (6.93 x 10^-3) = 100 s.

or.question: ଯଦି ଗୋଟିଏ ପ୍ରଥମ-କ୍ରମ (first-order) ପ୍ରତିକ୍ରିୟାର ହାର ସ୍ଥିରାଙ୍କ (k) 6.93 x 10^-3 s^-1 ହୁଏ, ତେବେ ଏହାର ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ-ଜୀବନ କାଳ (t_1/2) କେତେ ହେବ?

questions.question: According to Wade's rules (polyhedral skeletal electron pair theory), what is the structural classification of the borane cluster B5H9?
questions.explanation: Boranes of the formula B_n H_(n+4) are classified as nido-boranes. For B5H9, n = 5 and it has (n + 2) = 7 skeletal electron pairs, which corresponds to a nido geometry.

or.question: ୱେଡ୍‌ଙ୍କ ନିୟମ (Wade's rules) ଅନୁସାରେ, ବୋରେନ୍ କ୍ଲଷ୍ଟର୍ B5H9 ର ସଂରଚନାତ୍ମକ ବର୍ଗୀକରଣ କ’ଣ?
or.explanation: B_n H_(n+4) ସାଧାରଣ ସୂତ୍ର ବିଶିଷ୍ଟ ବୋରେନ୍‌ଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ନିଡୋ-ବୋରେନ୍ (nido-borane) ଭାବରେ ବର୍ଗୀକୃତ କରାଯାଏ। B5H9 ପାଇଁ n = 5 ଏବଂ ଏହାର (n + 2) = 7 ସ୍କେଲେଟାଲ୍ ଇଲେକ୍ଟ୍ରନ୍ ଯୁଗଳ ଥାଏ, ଯାହା ନିଡୋ ଜ୍ୟାମିତି ସହ ସମାନ।

questions.question: Which directional trend in motor development describes the pattern where motor control progresses from the center of the body outward toward the extremities?
questions.explanation: The proximodistal trend describes the sequence in which growth and motor control proceed from the center of the body outward (e.g., control of the trunk and arms before fine control of the fingers). Cephalocaudal refers to head-to-toe development.

or.question: ମୋଟର ବିକାଶର କେଉଁ ଦିଗଗତ ପ୍ରବୃତ୍ତି (directional trend) ସେହି ଢାଞ୍ଚାକୁ ବର୍ଣ୍ଣନା କରେ ଯେଉଁଥିରେ ନିୟନ୍ତ୍ରଣ ଶରୀରର କେନ୍ଦ୍ରରୁ ବାହାର ଆଡ଼କୁ ଅଙ୍ଗପ୍ରତ୍ୟଙ୍ଗ ଆଡ଼କୁ ଅଗ୍ରସର ହୁଏ?
or.explanation: ପ୍ରୋକ୍ସିମୋଡିଷ୍ଟାଲ୍ ପ୍ରବୃତ୍ତି ଶରୀରର କେନ୍ଦ୍ରରୁ ବାହାର ଆଡ଼କୁ (ଅଙ୍ଗପ୍ରତ୍ୟଙ୍ଗ ଆଡ଼କୁ) ହେଉଥିବା ମୋଟର ବିକାଶକୁ ଦର୍ଶାଏ। ସେଫାଲୋକଡାଲ୍ ପ୍ରବୃତ୍ତି ମୁଣ୍ଡରୁ ପାଦ ଆଡ଼କୁ ହେଉଥିବା ବିକାଶକୁ ବୁଝାଏ।

questions.question: According to Esther Thelen's Dynamic Systems Theory of motor development, how do infants acquire new motor capabilities?
options: Motor skills emerge strictly as a preprogrammed result of neurological maturation independent of environmental context.
Motor skills are self-organized patterns assembled by actively combining existing abilities to meet specific goals within environmental constraints.
Motor skills are acquired exclusively through social imitation and direct reinforcement provided by primary caregivers.
Motor skills progress through fixed cognitive stages directly tied to linear increases in total brain volume.
questions.explanation: Esther Thelen's Dynamic Systems Theory posits that motor skills are not genetically hardwired or driven solely by brain maturation. Instead, infants actively assemble motor behaviors by self-organizing multiple components (neurological, physical, developmental goals, environmental possibilities) to adaptively solve task problems.

or.question: ଏଷ୍ଟର ଥେଲେନ୍ (Esther Thelen)ଙ୍କ ମୋଟର ବିକାଶର 'ଡାଇନାମିକ୍ ସିଷ୍ଟମ୍ସ ଥିଓରୀ' (Dynamic Systems Theory) ଅନୁସାରେ, ଶିଶୁମାନେ ନୂତନ ମୋଟର ଦକ୍ଷତା କିପରି ହାସଲ କରନ୍ତି?
options: ମୋଟର କୌଶଳଗୁଡ଼ିକ ପରିବେଶରୁ ସ୍ୱାଧୀନ ଭାବରେ କେବଳ ସ୍ନାୟୁଗତ ପରିପକ୍ୱତାର ଏକ ପୂର୍ବ-ନିର୍ଦ୍ଧାରିତ ପରିଣାମ ଭାବରେ ପ୍ରକାଶ ପାଏ।
ପରିବେଶର ସୀମା ମଧ୍ୟରେ ନିର୍ଦ୍ଧିଷ୍ଟ ଲକ୍ଷ୍ୟ ହାସଲ ପାଇଁ ବିଦ୍ୟମାନ ଦକ୍ଷତାଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ସକ୍ରିୟ ଭାବରେ ସଂଯୋଗ କରି ଶିଶୁମାନେ ସ୍ୱୟଂ-ସଂଗଠିତ ମୋଟର କୌଶଳ ଗଠନ କରନ୍ତି।
ମୋଟର କୌଶଳଗୁଡ଼ିକ କେବଳ ସାମାଜିକ ଅନୁକରଣ ଏବଂ ପ୍ରାଥମିକ ଯତ୍ନନେବାକାରୀଙ୍କ ପ୍ରତ୍ୟକ୍ଷ ଦୃଢ଼ୀକରଣ ମାଧ୍ୟମରେ ହାସଲ କରାଯାଏ।
ମୋଟର କୌଶଳଗୁଡ଼ିକ ମସ୍ତିଷ୍କର ମୋଟ ଆୟତନ ବୃଦ୍ଧି ସହିତ ନିର୍ଦ୍ଧାରିତ ସ୍ଥାୟୀ ଜ୍ଞାନାତ୍ମକ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟାୟ ଦେଇ ଅଗ୍ରସର ହୁଏ।
or.explanation: ଏଷ୍ଟର ଥେଲେନ୍‌ଙ୍କ ଡାଇନାମିକ୍ ସିଷ୍ଟମ୍ସ ଥିଓରୀ ଅନୁସାରେ, ମୋଟର ବିକାଶ କେବଳ ଏକ ନିଷ୍କ୍ରିୟ ଜୈବିକ ପରିପକ୍ୱତା ନୁହେଁ। ଶିଶୁମାନେ ନିଜର ନିର୍ଦ୍ଧିଷ୍ଟ ଲକ୍ଷ୍ୟ ହାସଲ କରିବା ପାଇଁ ଶରୀର, ପରିବେଶ ଏବଂ ମାନସିକ ସାମର୍ଥ୍ୟର ପାରସ୍ପରିକ କ୍ରିୟା ଦ୍ୱାରା ସକ୍ରିୟ ଭାବରେ ନୂତନ କୌଶଳ ସଂଗଠିତ କରନ୍ତି।

questions.question: Which educational scheme, formulated by Mahatma Gandhi at the Wardha Conference in 1937, emphasized craft-centric and mother-tongue-based education?
questions.explanation: Mahatma Gandhi introduced the Wardha Scheme of Basic Education, popularised as 'Nai Talim', in 1937. It advocated craft-centered, free, and compulsory education taught in the child's mother tongue.

questions.question: In which year did Rabindranath Tagore formally establish the experimental school 'Brahmacharyasrama' (later known as Patha Bhavana) at Santiniketan?
questions.explanation: Rabindranath Tagore established his experimental school at Santiniketan on December 22, 1901, with five students. It later developed into Patha Bhavana under Visva-Bharati.

questions.question: Which German educator is universally recognized as the founder of the 'Kindergarten' system of early childhood education?
questions.explanation: Friedrich Froebel created the 'Kindergarten' (Garden of Children) system in Germany in 1837, emphasizing play, self-activity, and social interaction.

questions.question: According to John Dewey's pragmatic philosophy, how is 'education' formally defined in his seminal work 'Democracy and Education'?
options: The gradual acquisition of universal truths and permanent values
The continuous reconstruction or reorganization of experience
The preparation of the individual for ultimate spiritual salvation
The systematic conditioning of responses to environmental stimuli
questions.explanation: John Dewey famously defined education as 'that reconstruction or reorganization of experience which adds to the meaning of experience, and which increases ability to direct the course of subsequent experience.'

questions.question: In Maria Montessori's framework of human development, which age period constitutes the 'Second Plane of Development', characterized by the emergence of the 'Reasoning Mind' and moral consciousness?
questions.explanation: Montessori identified four distinct planes of development: First Plane (0–6 years: Absorbent Mind), Second Plane (6–12 years: Reasoning Mind), Third Plane (12–18 years: Humanistic Mind), and Fourth Plane (18–24 years: Specialized Mind).

questions.question: Which specific neurodevelopmental learning disability primarily impairs a student's ability to understand, process, and perform mathematical calculations?
questions.explanation: Dyscalculia is a specific learning disorder that affects a person's ability to understand number concepts, learn arithmetic rules, and perform mathematical calculations.

questions.question: A student who consistently struggles with fine motor skills required for handwriting, letter spacing, line orientation, and spatial organisation on paper is diagnosed with:
questions.explanation: Dysgraphia is a neurological condition affecting written expression, fine motor coordination, spatial line management, and spelling ability.

questions.question: Under the Rights of Persons with Disabilities (RPwD) Act, 2016 in India, what minimum degree of disability is required to classify an individual as having a 'benchmark disability'?
questions.explanation: Section 2(r) of the RPwD Act, 2016 defines a person with 'benchmark disability' as an individual with not less than 40% of a specified disability.

questions.question: In co-teaching instructional models for inclusive classrooms, which model involves both general and special educators presenting the exact same lesson simultaneously as equal leaders to the whole class?
questions.explanation: In Team Teaching (or Teaming), two teachers share equal responsibility for planning, instructing, and assessing the entire class together without dividing the room or students.

questions.question: In the Revised Bloom's Taxonomy of Cognitive Domain (Anderson & Krathwohl, 2001), which level represents the highest order of cognitive process?
questions.explanation: In Anderson and Krathwohl's 2001 revision of Bloom's Taxonomy, 'Creating' replaced 'Evaluation' at the top of the cognitive hierarchy.

questions.question: In the 4-Quadrant approach designed for SWAYAM MOOC courses by the Ministry of Education, India, which quadrant specifically provides 'Self-Assessment' tools like quizzes and tests?
questions.explanation: The 4 Quadrants of SWAYAM are: Quadrant I (E-Tutorial/Video), Quadrant II (E-Content/Reading), Quadrant III (Self-Assessment/Tests & Quizzes), and Quadrant IV (Discussion Forum).

questions.question: What is the primary technical objective of SCORM (Shareable Content Object Reference Model) in e-learning content administration?
options: Ensuring interoperability and reusability of learning content across different Learning Management Systems (LMS)
Automatically translating text-based lessons into localized spoken audio
questions.explanation: SCORM is a standard set of technical specifications for e-learning content that ensures learning materials are interoperable, reusable, and transferable across any SCORM-compliant Learning Management System (LMS).

questions.question: Which curriculum developer proposed an 'inductive' or 'grassroots' model, arguing that curriculum should be designed by teachers starting from specific learning units rather than top-down administrators?
questions.explanation: Hilda Taba advocated for an inductive (bottom-up/grassroots) approach to curriculum development, where teachers design learning units first before generalizing them into a broader curriculum.

questions.question: Who introduced the foundational conceptual distinction between 'Formative' and 'Summative' evaluation in curriculum and program evaluation in 1967?
questions.explanation: Michael Scriven introduced the concepts and terms 'formative evaluation' and 'summative evaluation' in his 1967 paper 'The Methodology of Evaluation'.

questions.question: Carl Rogers is widely recognized as the pioneer of which major approach to guidance and counseling?
questions.explanation: Carl Rogers pioneered Person-Centered (Non-Directive) Counseling, emphasizing unconditional positive regard, congruence, and counselor empathy to allow the client to lead self-discovery.

questions.question: According to the Indian model of micro-teaching developed by NCERT, what is the standard duration specified for the 'Teaching' phase?
questions.explanation: In the NCERT model of micro-teaching, the standard time allocated for the 'Teaching' phase is 6 minutes. The entire micro-teaching cycle lasts for 36 minutes (Teach: 6 min, Feedback: 6 min, Re-plan: 12 min, Re-teach: 6 min, Re-feedback: 6 min).

or.question: NCERT ଦ୍ୱାରା ବିକଶିତ ମାଇକ୍ରୋ-ଟିଚିଂ (ସୂକ୍ଷ୍ମ ଶିକ୍ଷଣ) ର ଭାରତୀୟ ମଡେଲ୍ ଅନୁଯାୟୀ, 'ଶିକ୍ଷଣ' (Teaching) ପର୍ଯ୍ୟାୟ ପାଇଁ ନିର୍ଦ୍ଧାରିତ ମାନକ ସମୟ କେତେ?
or.explanation: NCERT ର ମାଇକ୍ରୋ-ଟିଚିଂ ମଡେଲରେ 'ଶିକ୍ଷଣ' ପର୍ଯ୍ୟାୟ ପାଇଁ ନିର୍ଦ୍ଧାରିତ ସମୟ ହେଉଛି ୬ ମିନିଟ୍। ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ମାଇକ୍ରୋ-ଟିଚିଂ ଚକ୍ର ୩୬ ମିନିଟର ଅଟେ (ଶିକ୍ଷଣ: ୬ ମିନିଟ୍, ପ୍ରତିପୋଷଣ: ୬ ମିନିଟ୍, ପୁନଃ-ଯୋଜନା: ୧୨ ମିନିଟ୍, ପୁନଃ-ଶିକ୍ଷଣ: ୬ ମିନିଟ୍, ପୁନଃ-ପ୍ରତିପୋଷଣ: ୬ ମିନିଟ୍)।

questions.question: Which specific Model of Teaching was designed by Richard Suchman to train students in causal reasoning and independent scientific inquiry?
questions.explanation: The Inquiry Training Model was developed by Richard Suchman to help learners inquire independently, identify cause-and-effect relationships, and process information logically using scientific procedures.

or.question: ଛାତ୍ରଛାତ୍ରୀମାନଙ୍କୁ କାରଣ-ଏବଂ-ପ୍ରଭାବ ଯୁକ୍ତି ଏବଂ ସ୍ୱାଧୀନ ବୈଜ୍ଞାନିକ ଅନୁସନ୍ଧାନରେ ପ୍ରଶିକ୍ଷିତ କରିବା ପାଇଁ ରିଚାର୍ଡ ସଚମ୍ୟାନ୍ (Richard Suchman) ଙ୍କ ଦ୍ୱାରା କେଉଁ ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦିଷ୍ଟ ଶିକ୍ଷଣ ମଡେଲ୍ (Model of Teaching) ପ୍ରସ୍ତୁତ କରାଯାଇଥିଲା?
or.explanation: ରିଚାର୍ଡ ସଚମ୍ୟାନ୍ ଇନକ୍ୱାରୀ ଟ୍ରେନିଂ ମଡେଲ୍ (Inquiry Training Model) ବିକଶିତ କରିଥିଲେ, ଯାହା ଛାତ୍ରଛାତ୍ରୀମାନଙ୍କୁ ସ୍ୱାଧୀନ ଭାବରେ ଅନୁସନ୍ଧାନ କରିବାକୁ, କାରଣ-ଏବଂ-ପ୍ରଭାବ ସମ୍ପର୍କ ଚିହ୍ନଟ କରିବାକୁ ଏବଂ ବୈଜ୍ଞାନିକ ପଦ୍ଧତି ବ୍ୟବହାର କରି ତଥ୍ୟ ପ୍ରସେସ୍ କରିବାକୁ ସାହାଯ୍ୟ କରେ।

questions.question: According to VSEPR theory, what is the molecular shape of Xenon difluoride (XeF2)?
questions.explanation: In XeF2, Xenon has 8 valence electrons, forming 2 single bonds with fluorine atoms and leaving 3 lone pairs. The 5 electron pairs adopt a trigonal bipyramidal electron geometry with the 3 lone pairs in equatorial positions to minimize repulsion, resulting in a linear molecular shape.

or.question: VSEPR ସିଦ୍ଧାନ୍ତ ଅନୁଯାୟୀ, ଜେନନ୍ ଡାଇଫ୍ଲୋରାଇଡ୍ (XeF2) ଅଣୁର ଆକୃତି (molecular shape) କ’ଣ?
or.explanation: XeF2 ରେ Xenon ପାଖରେ 8 ଟି ସଂଯୋଜକ ଇଲେକ୍ଟ୍ରନ୍ ଥାଏ। ଏହା 2 ଟି ଫ୍ଲୋରିନ୍ ପରମାଣୁ ସହିତ ଏକକ ବନ୍ଧନ ଗଠନ କରେ ଏବଂ 3 ଟି ଏକାକୀ ଇଲେକ୍ଟ୍ରନ୍ ଯୁଗଳ (lone pairs) ରହେ। 3 ଟି ଏକାକୀ ଯୁଗଳ ବିଷୁବରେଖୀୟ ସ୍ଥାନ ଗ୍ରହଣ କରନ୍ତି, ଯାହା ଫଳରେ ଅଣୁର ଆକୃତି ରେଖୀୟ (Linear) ହୋଇଥାଏ।

questions.question: For one mole of an ideal gas undergoing a reversible isothermal expansion from an initial volume V1 to a final volume V2 at temperature T, what is the change in entropy of the surroundings (\Delta S_surr)?
questions.explanation: For an isothermal expansion of one mole of an ideal gas, \Delta S_sys = R ln(V2 / V1). Since the process is reversible, the total entropy change of the universe is zero (\Delta S_total = \Delta S_sys + \Delta S_surr = 0). Therefore, \Delta S_surr = -\Delta S_sys = -R ln(V2 / V1).

or.question: T ତାପମାତ୍ରାରେ ପ୍ରାରମ୍ଭିକ ଆୟତନ V1 ରୁ ଅନ୍ତିମ ଆୟତନ V2 କୁ ପ୍ରତ୍ୟାବର୍ତ୍ତୀ ସମତାପୀୟ (reversible isothermal) ସମ୍ପ୍ରସାରଣ ହେଉଥିବା ଏକ ମୋଲ୍ ଆଦର୍ଶ ଗ୍ୟାସ୍ ପାଇଁ, ପାରିପାର୍ଶ୍ୱିକର ଏଣ୍ଟ୍ରୋପି ପରିବର୍ତ୍ତନ (\Delta S_surr) କେତେ?
or.explanation: ସମତାପୀୟ ସମ୍ପ୍ରସାରଣ ପାଇଁ, ସିଷ୍ଟମର ଏଣ୍ଟ୍ରୋପି ପରିବର୍ତ୍ତନ \Delta S_sys = R ln(V2 / V1) ଅଟେ। ଯେହେତୁ ପ୍ରକ୍ରିୟାଟି ପ୍ରତ୍ୟାବର୍ତ୍ତୀ (reversible), ମୋଟ ଏଣ୍ଟ୍ରୋପି ପରିବର୍ତ୍ତନ \Delta S_total = \Delta S_sys + \Delta S_surr = 0। ତେଣୁ, \Delta S_surr = -\Delta S_sys = -R ln(V2 / V1) ଅଟେ।

questions.question: According to Albert Bandura's Social Learning Theory, what is the correct chronological sequence of the four primary processes involved in observational learning?
questions.explanation: Albert Bandura identified four interrelated sub-processes necessary for observational learning to occur: Attention (perceiving the model's behavior), Retention (remembering what was observed), Motor Reproduction (replicating the behavior), and Motivation (having an incentive to perform the learned behavior).

or.question: ଆଲବର୍ଟ ବାଣ୍ଡୁରାଙ୍କ ସାମାଜିକ ଶିକ୍ଷଣ ତତ୍ତ୍ୱ (Social Learning Theory) ଅନୁସାରେ, ଅବଲୋକନମୂଳକ ଶିକ୍ଷଣ (observational learning) ରେ ସାମିଲ ଥିବା ଚାରୋଟି ମୁଖ୍ୟ ପ୍ରକ୍ରିୟାର ସଠିକ୍ କାଳାନୁକ୍ରମିକ କ୍ରମ କେଉଁଟି?
options: ଧ୍ୟାନ (Attention) -> ଧାରଣ (Retention) -> ମୋଟର ପୁନରୁତ୍ପାଦନ (Motor Reproduction) -> ପ୍ରେରଣା (Motivation)
ପ୍ରେରଣା (Motivation) -> ଧ୍ୟାନ (Attention) -> ଧାରଣ (Retention) -> ମୋଟର ପୁନରୁତ୍ପାଦନ (Motor Reproduction)
ଧାରଣ (Retention) -> ଧ୍ୟାନ (Attention) -> ପ୍ରେରଣା (Motivation) -> ମୋଟର ପୁନରୁତ୍ପାଦନ (Motor Reproduction)
ଧ୍ୟାନ (Attention) -> ପ୍ରେରଣା (Motivation) -> ଧାରଣ (Retention) -> ମୋଟର ପୁନରୁତ୍ପାଦନ (Motor Reproduction)
or.explanation: ଆଲବର୍ଟ ବାଣ୍ଡୁରା ସଫଳ ଅବଲୋକନମୂଳକ ଶିକ୍ଷଣ ପାଇଁ ଚାରୋଟି ପରସ୍ପର ସମ୍ବନ୍ଧିତ ପ୍ରକ୍ରିୟା ଚିହ୍ନଟ କରିଥିଲେ: ଧ୍ୟାନ (ମଡେଲକୁ ଲକ୍ଷ୍ୟ କରିବା), ଧାରଣ (ବ୍ୟବହାରକୁ ମନେ ରଖିବା), ମୋଟର ପୁନରୁତ୍ପାଦନ (ଶାରୀରିକ ଭାବରେ ଆଚରଣର ପୁନରାବୃତ୍ତି କରିବା), ଏବଂ ପ୍ରେରଣା (ଆଚରଣ ପ୍ରଦର୍ଶନ କରିବା ପାଇଁ ଉତ୍ସାହ ରହିବା)।

questions.question: In Paul Baltes' framework of life-span developmental psychology, which key proposition asserts that development is a process involving continuous dynamic trade-offs between gains (growth) and losses (decline) across the entire life course?
questions.explanation: According to Paul Baltes' framework, 'Multidirectionality' refers to the proposition that development across the lifespan does not follow a simple, linear path of growth; rather, at any point in life, development is characterized by simultaneous gains (growth) and losses (decline) in different behavioral domains.

or.question: ପଲ୍ ବାଲ୍ଟେସ୍ (Paul Baltes) ଙ୍କ ଜୀବନବ୍ୟାପୀ ବିକାଶମୂଳକ ମନୋବିଜ୍ଞାନ ରୂପରେଖରେ, କେଉଁ ମୌଳିକ ପ୍ରସ୍ତାବନା ଦାବି କରେ ଯେ ବିକାଶ ହେଉଛି ସମଗ୍ର ଜୀବନକାଳ ମଧ୍ୟରେ ଲାଭ (ବୃଦ୍ଧି) ଏବଂ କ୍ଷତି (ହ୍ରାସ) ମଧ୍ୟରେ ନିରନ୍ତର ସମନ୍ୱୟ ସହିତ ଜଡ଼ିତ ଏକ ପ୍ରକ୍ରିୟା?
or.explanation: ପଲ୍ ବାଲ୍ଟେସ୍ ଙ୍କ ଅନୁଯାୟୀ, 'ବହୁଦିଗଗାମୀତା' (Multidirectionality) ର ନିୟମ ଦର୍ଶାଏ ଯେ ବିକାଶମୂଳକ ପରିବର୍ତ୍ତନଗୁଡ଼ିକ ଏକ ସରଳ, ରେଖୀୟ ପଥ ଅନୁସରଣ କରନ୍ତି ନାହିଁ; ବରଂ, ସମଗ୍ର ଜୀବନକାଳ ମଧ୍ୟରେ, ବିକାଶ ସଦାସର୍ବଦା କାର୍ଯ୍ୟକାରିତାର ବିଭିନ୍ନ କ୍ଷେତ୍ରରେ ଲାଭ (ବୃଦ୍ଧି) ଏବଂ କ୍ଷତି (ହ୍ରାସ) ର ଏକ ମିଳିତ ପ୍ରକାଶ ଅଟେ।

questions.question: Under the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020, what is the new pedagogical and curricular structure that replaces the earlier 10+2 system?
questions.explanation: NEP 2020 replaces the 10+2 structure with a new 5+3+3+4 structure corresponding to ages 3-8 (Foundational), 8-11 (Preparatory), 11-14 (Middle), and 14-18 (Secondary).

questions.question: According to Section 3 of the Right of Children to Free and Compulsory Education (RTE) Act, 2009, children of which age group have the fundamental right to free and compulsory education?
questions.explanation: The RTE Act 2009 guarantees free and compulsory education to all children aged 6 to 14 years in a neighbourhood school until the completion of elementary education.

questions.question: Which component of the human memory system is characterized by an virtually unlimited storage capacity and the ability to retain information over long periods?
questions.explanation: Long-term memory (LTM) has an unlimited capacity and duration, allowing storage of information ranging from days to a lifetime.

questions.question: Who among the following social psychologists is widely recognized for coining the term 'Action Research' in the mid-1940s?
questions.explanation: Kurt Lewin coined the term 'Action Research' around 1944 to describe a process of cyclical inquiry to solve practical social problems.

questions.question: In Jacob Kounin's classroom management model, which term describes a teacher's ability to demonstrate total awareness of classroom activities and student behavior at all times?
questions.explanation: Kounin defined 'Withitness' as the teacher's ability to communicate to students that they know what is going on in all parts of the classroom at all times.

questions.question: According to Noam Chomsky, human children are born with an innate biological capacity that allows them to acquire language naturally. What is this construct called?
questions.explanation: Noam Chomsky proposed the concept of the Language Acquisition Device (LAD), an innate mental mechanism that enables children to construct the grammar of their native language.

questions.question: In a standard normal distribution curve, approximately what percentage of total cases lie within one standard deviation above and below the mean (±1σ)?
questions.explanation: In a normal distribution, approximately 68.26% (roughly 68%) of the area/cases fall within ±1 standard deviation of the mean.

questions.question: The National Curriculum Framework for School Education (NCF-SE 2023) was developed under the leadership of the National Steering Committee headed by which eminent personality?
questions.explanation: Dr. K. Kasturirangan headed the National Steering Committee that drafted the National Curriculum Framework for School Education (NCF-SE 2023).

questions.question: Under the Schedule of the RTE Act 2009, what is the mandatory Pupil-Teacher Ratio (PTR) prescribed for primary classes (Classes I to V) for an enrolment up to 200 students?
questions.explanation: The RTE Act, 2009 specifies a Pupil-Teacher Ratio (PTR) of 30:1 for primary schools (Classes I to V) up to an enrolment of 200 students.

questions.question: When newly learned information prevents or interferes with the retrieval of previously stored information, what phenomenon is occurring?
questions.explanation: Retroactive interference occurs when new learning disrupts the recall of older information, whereas proactive interference occurs when older memories disrupt new learning.

questions.question: According to Stephen M. Corey, who adapted action research to education, which sequence correctly reflects the essential steps of an action research cycle?
options: Identification of problem -> Formulation of action hypothesis -> Execution of plan & data collection -> Evaluation
Formulation of hypothesis -> Problem identification -> Action plan implementation -> Data collection
Execution of plan -> Problem identification -> Hypothesis formulation -> Data collection -> Evaluation
Collection of baseline data -> Problem identification -> Hypothesis formulation -> Implementation
questions.explanation: Corey's classic action research steps follow: identifying a practical problem, formulating an action hypothesis, executing the plan while collecting data, and evaluating the outcome.

questions.question: In educational testing, what is the constant value of the standard deviation for any set of standardized Z-scores?
questions.explanation: Z-scores convert raw scores into a standard distribution where the mean is always 0 and the standard deviation is always 1.

questions.question: In Stephen Krashen's Monitor Model, which hypothesis asserts that language acquisition occurs best when the learner receives language input that is one step beyond their current stage of competence?
questions.explanation: Krashen's Input Hypothesis proposes that learners acquire language when exposed to 'comprehensible input' represented as 'i+1', where 'i' is the learner's current competence and '+1' is the next step.

questions.question: In Rudolf Dreikurs' Model of Social Discipline, misbehavior in school children is driven by four 'mistaken goals'. Which of the following correctly lists all four mistaken goals?
options: Attention, Power, Revenge, Display of Inadequacy
questions.explanation: Dreikurs identified four mistaken goals of student misbehavior: seeking Attention, seeking Power, seeking Revenge, and Displaying Inadequacy (or assumed disability).

questions.question: In item analysis of a norm-referenced achievement test, an item has a Difficulty Index (P) of 0.85 and a Discrimination Index (D) of 0.05. What is the most appropriate psychometric decision?
options: Retain the item as it demonstrates excellent discrimination between groups.
Modify the distractors slightly to increase its overall difficulty.
Discard or thoroughly revise the item because its discrimination power is unacceptably low.
Increase the testing time allotted to students to balance item performance.
questions.explanation: A Discrimination Index below 0.20 indicates poor ability to differentiate high-performing from low-performing students. Combined with a very high difficulty index (0.85 = very easy), the item fails norm-referenced criteria and must be discarded or revised.

questions.question: In Ned A. Flanders' Interaction Analysis Category System (FIACS) for analyzing classroom interaction, how many total categories are defined, and how many specifically belong to 'Teacher Talk'?
options: 10 total categories, with 7 belonging to Teacher Talk
10 total categories, with 5 belonging to Teacher Talk
12 total categories, with 8 belonging to Teacher Talk
8 total categories, with 6 belonging to Teacher Talk
questions.explanation: Flanders' Interaction Analysis Category System (FIACS) consists of 10 total categories: 7 categories for Teacher Talk (4 for Indirect Influence and 3 for Direct Influence), 2 categories for Student Talk, and 1 category for Silence or Confusion.

or.question: ନେଡ୍ ଏ. ଫ୍ଲାଣ୍ଡର୍ସଙ୍କ ଇଣ୍ଟରାକ୍ସନ୍ ଆନାଲିସିସ୍ କ୍ୟାଟେଗୋରୀ ସିଷ୍ଟମ୍ (FIACS) ରେ କ୍ଲାସରୁମ୍ ଆଲୋଚନାର ବିଶ୍ଲେଷଣ ପାଇଁ ମୋଟ କେତୋଟି ବର୍ଗ (categories) ରହିଛି, ଏବଂ ସେଥିମଧ୍ୟରୁ କେତୋଟି ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦିଷ୍ଟ ଭାବରେ 'ଶିକ୍ଷକଙ୍କ କଥା' (Teacher Talk) ଅନ୍ତର୍ଭୁକ୍ତ?
options: ମୋଟ ୧୦ଟି ବର୍ଗ, ସେଥିମଧ୍ୟରୁ ୭ଟି ଶିକ୍ଷକଙ୍କ କଥା ଅନ୍ତର୍ଭୁକ୍ତ
ମୋଟ ୧୦ଟି ବର୍ଗ, ସେଥିମଧ୍ୟରୁ ୫ଟି ଶିକ୍ଷକଙ୍କ କଥା ଅନ୍ତର୍ଭୁକ୍ତ
ମୋଟ ୧୨ଟି ବର୍ଗ, ସେଥିମଧ୍ୟରୁ ୮ଟି ଶିକ୍ଷକଙ୍କ କଥା ଅନ୍ତର୍ଭୁକ୍ତ
ମୋଟ ୮ଟି ବର୍ଗ, ସେଥିମଧ୍ୟରୁ ୬ଟି ଶିକ୍ଷକଙ୍କ କଥା ଅନ୍ତର୍ଭୁକ୍ତ
or.explanation: ଫ୍ଲାଣ୍ଡର୍ସଙ୍କ FIACS ରେ ମୋଟ ୧୦ଟି ବର୍ଗ ରହିଛି। ସେଥିମଧ୍ୟରୁ ୭ଟି 'ଶିକ୍ଷକଙ୍କ କଥା' (୪ଟି ପରୋକ୍ଷ ପ୍ରଭାବ ଏବଂ ୩ଟି ପ୍ରତ୍ୟକ୍ଷ ପ୍ରଭାବ), ୨ଟି 'ଛାତ୍ରଙ୍କ କଥା', ଏବଂ ୧ଟି 'ନୀରବତା କିମ୍ବା ଦ୍ୱନ୍ଦ୍ୱ' ଶ୍ରେଣୀରେ ଆସିଥାଏ।

questions.question: In David Ausubel's Subsumption Theory of meaningful verbal learning, which type of subsumption occurs when new information is learned as an extension, elaboration, modification, or qualification of previously learned concepts?
questions.explanation: According to Ausubel, correlative subsumption occurs when new material is an extension, elaboration, or modification of previously learned propositions or concepts. Derivative subsumption occurs when new material is merely a direct example or illustration of an established concept.

or.question: ଡେଭିଡ୍ ଆସୁବେଲଙ୍କ 'ସବସମ୍ପସନ୍ ଥିଓରୀ' (Subsumption Theory) ଅନୁଯାୟୀ, ଯେତେବେଳେ ନୂତନ ବିଷୟବସ୍ତୁ ପୂର୍ବରୁ ଶିଖାଯାଇଥିବା ଧାରଣାଗୁଡ଼ିକର ବିସ୍ତାର, ରୂପାନ୍ତର, ସଂଶୋଧନ କିମ୍ବା ବିଶେଷତା ଭାବରେ ଶିଖାଯାଏ, ସେତେବେଳେ କେଉଁ ପ୍ରକାରର ସବସମ୍ପସନ୍ ଘଟିଥାଏ?
or.explanation: ଆସୁବେଲଙ୍କ ମତରେ, କୋରିଲେଟିଭ୍ ସବସମ୍ପସନ୍ (Correlative subsumption) ସେତେବେଳେ ଘଟିଥାଏ ଯେତେବେଳେ ନୂତନ ତଥ୍ୟ ପୂର୍ବରୁ ଥିବା ଜ୍ଞାନର ସଂପ୍ରସାରଣ, ସଂଶୋଧନ କିମ୍ବା ପରିବର୍ତ୍ତନ କରେ। ଅନ୍ୟପକ୍ଷରେ, ଡେରିଭେଟିଭ୍ ସବସମ୍ପସନ୍ କେବଳ ପୂର୍ବରୁ ଜଣାଥିବା ଧାରଣାର ଏକ ସିଧାସଳଖ ଉଦାହରଣକୁ ଦର୍ଶାଇଥାଏ।

questions.question: According to the Arrhenius equation, what is the slope of the plot of ln k versus 1/T?
questions.explanation: The Arrhenius equation in logarithmic form is ln k = ln A - (E_a / R)(1/T). Plotting ln k on the y-axis versus 1/T on the x-axis yields a straight line with a slope equal to -E_a / R.

or.question: Arrhenius ସମୀକରଣ ଅନୁଯାୟୀ, ln k ଏବଂ 1/T ର ଆଲେଖ (plot) ର ସ୍ଲୋପ୍ (slope) କେତେ?
or.explanation: ଲୋଗାରିଦମିକ୍ ରୂପରେ Arrhenius ସମୀକରଣ ହେଉଛି ln k = ln A - (E_a / R)(1/T)। y-ଅକ୍ଷରେ ln k ଏବଂ x-ଅକ୍ଷରେ 1/T ର ଆଲେଖ ଅଙ୍କନ କଲେ ଏକ ସରଳରେଖା ମିଳେ, ଯାହାର ସ୍ଲୋପ୍ -E_a / R ସହିତ ସମାନ।

questions.question: In the Perkin reaction, benzaldehyde reacts with acetic anhydride in the presence of sodium acetate to yield cinnamic acid. Which species acts as the nucleophile in the first step of this reaction?
options: The carbanion generated by deprotonation of acetic anhydride
The acetate ion directly attacking benzaldehyde
An acylium ion formed from acetic anhydride
questions.explanation: Sodium acetate acts as a weak base that removes an alpha-proton from acetic anhydride to form a carbanion (enolate ion). This carbanion then acts as a nucleophile and attacks the carbonyl carbon of benzaldehyde.

or.question: ପର୍କିନ୍ (Perkin) ପ୍ରତିକ୍ରିୟାରେ, ସୋଡିୟମ୍ ଆସେଟେଟ୍ ର ଉପସ୍ଥିତିରେ ବେଞ୍ଜାଲ୍ଡିହାଇଡ୍ ଆସେଟିକ୍ ଆନହାଇଡ୍ରାଇଡ୍ ସହିତ ପ୍ରତିକ୍ରିୟା କରି ସିନାମିକ୍ ଏସିଡ୍ ଗଠନ କରେ। ଏହି ପ୍ରତିକ୍ରିୟାର ପ୍ରଥମ ପଦକ୍ଷେପରେ କେଉଁ ସ୍ପେସିଜ୍ ନ୍ୟୁକ୍ଲିଓଫାଇଲ୍ (nucleophile) ଭାବରେ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟ କରେ?
options: ଆସେଟିକ୍ ଆନହାଇଡ୍ରାଇଡ୍ ର ଡିପ୍ରୋଟୋନେସନ୍ ଦ୍ୱାରା ସୃଷ୍ଟି ହୋଇଥିବା କାର୍ବାନାୟନ୍
ସିଧାସଳଖ ବେଞ୍ଜାଲ୍ଡିହାଇଡ୍ କୁ ଆକ୍ରମଣ କରୁଥିବା ଆସେଟେଟ୍ ଆୟନ୍
ଆସେଟିକ୍ ଆନହାଇଡ୍ରାଇଡ୍ ରୁ ଗଠିତ ଏସିଲିୟମ୍ ଆୟନ୍
or.explanation: ସୋଡିୟମ୍ ଆସେଟେଟ୍ ଏକ ମୃଦୁ କ୍ଷାର ଭାବରେ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟ କରି ଆସେଟିକ୍ ଆନହାଇଡ୍ରାଇଡ୍ ରୁ ଏକ ଆଲଫା-ପ୍ରୋଟନ୍ ଅପସାରଣ କରେ, ଯାହାଦ୍ୱାରା କାର୍ବାନାୟନ୍ (ଏନୋଲେଟ୍ ଆୟନ୍) ସୃଷ୍ଟି ହୁଏ। ଏହି କାର୍ବାନାୟନ୍ ନ୍ୟୁକ୍ଲିଓଫାଇଲ୍ ଭାବରେ ବେଞ୍ଜାଲ୍ଡିହାଇଡ୍ ର କାର୍ବୋନିଲ୍ କାର୍ବନ୍ କୁ ଆକ୍ରମଣ କରେ।

questions.question: According to Jean Piaget's theory of cognitive development, at which stage do children typically master the concept of 'conservation' of mass, volume, and number?
questions.explanation: In Jean Piaget's theory, conservation—the understanding that basic physical properties of an object (such as mass, volume, or number) remain unchanged despite superficial changes in appearance—is typically acquired during the Concrete Operational Stage (around 7 to 11 years of age).

or.question: ଜାଁ ପିଆଜେ (Jean Piaget) ଙ୍କ ଜ୍ଞାନାତ୍ମକ ବିକାଶ ସିଦ୍ଧାନ୍ତ ଅନୁଯାୟୀ, ଶିଶୁମାନେ ସାଧାରଣତଃ କେଉଁ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟାୟରେ ବସ୍ତୁର ଓଜନ, ଆୟତନ ଏବଂ ସଂଖ୍ୟାର 'ସଂରକ୍ଷଣ' (Conservation) ଧାରଣା ହାସଲ କରନ୍ତି?
or.explanation: ଜାଁ ପିଆଜେଙ୍କ ଜ୍ଞାନାତ୍ମକ ବିକାଶ ସିଦ୍ଧାନ୍ତ ଅନୁଯାୟୀ, ସଂରକ୍ଷଣ (Conservation) ର ଧାରଣା ଶିଶୁମାନେ ମୂର୍ତ୍ତ-ସଂକ୍ରିୟାତ୍ମକ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟାୟ (ପ୍ରାୟ ୭ ରୁ ୧୧ ବର୍ଷ ବୟସ) ମଧ୍ୟରେ ହାସଲ କରିଥାନ୍ତି।

questions.question: In Urie Bronfenbrenner's Bioecological Model of Human Development, which specific system encompasses the socio-historical circumstances, transitions, and environmental events that occur across an individual's life course?
questions.explanation: The chronosystem in Bronfenbrenner's Bioecological Model represents the temporal dimension of development. It incorporates socio-historical context (such as economic depressions or wars), major developmental transitions (like parental divorce or entering school), and changes in life events over time.

or.question: ୟୁରି ବ୍ରୋନଫେନବ୍ରେନର (Urie Bronfenbrenner) ଙ୍କ ମାନବ ବିକାଶର ଜୈବ-ପାରିସ୍ଥିତିକ ମୋଡେଲ (Bioecological Model) ରେ, କେଉଁ ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦିଷ୍ଟ ପ୍ରଣାଳୀ ବ୍ୟକ୍ତିର ସମଗ୍ର ଜୀବନକାଳ ମଧ୍ୟରେ ଘଟୁଥିବା ସାମାଜିକ-ଐତିହାସିକ ପରିସ୍ଥିତି, ପରିବର୍ତ୍ତନ ଏବଂ ପରିବେଶଗତ ଘଟଣାବଳୀକୁ ଅନ୍ତର୍ଭୁକ୍ତ କରେ?
or.explanation: ବ୍ରୋନଫେନବ୍ରେନରଙ୍କ ଜୈବ-ପାରିସ୍ଥିତିକ ମୋଡେଲରେ, କ୍ରୋନୋସିଷ୍ଟମ୍ (Chronosystem) ସମୟର ପରିମାପକୁ ଦର୍ଶାଏ, ଯେଉଁଥିରେ ବ୍ୟକ୍ତିର ଜୀବନକାଳ ମଧ୍ୟରେ ଘଟୁଥିବା ସାମାଜିକ-ଐତିହାସିକ ପରିସ୍ଥିତି, ପ୍ରମୁଖ ଜୀବନ ପରିବର୍ତ୍ତନ ଏବଂ ପରିବେଶଗତ ପରିବର୍ତ୍ତନଗୁଡ଼ିକ ଅନ୍ତର୍ଭୁକ୍ତ।
